item.title: Lee Jun-seok: “If Hundreds of Ballots Were Missing, Any Outcome is Problematic… Vote Counting Must Be Suspended” (이준석 “수백표씩 용지 부족했다면 어떤 결과 나와도 문제… 개표 중지해야”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok: “If Hundreds of Ballots Were Missing, Any Outcome is Problematic… Vote Counting Must Be Suspended” (이준석 “수백표씩 용지 부족했다면 어떤 결과 나와도 문제… 개표 중지해야”)

Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, argued on the 3rd that “vote counting procedures should be suspended” in response to the incident where voting was halted in some areas of Seoul due to a shortage of local election ballots. (개혁신당 이준석 대표는 3일 서울 일부 지역에서 지방선거 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단된 사태가 벌어진 데 대해 “개표 절차를 중지해야 한다”고 주장했다.)

In a Facebook post that evening, Lee stated, “The shortage of ballots in this Seoul mayoral election and other various-level elections is not a matter to be taken lightly.” (이 대표는 이날 밤 페이스북에 글을 올려 “이번에 서울시장 선거 및 각급 선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 문제는 가볍게 다룰 문제가 아니다”라고 했다.)

Regarding the fact that the Songpa District Election Commission and others had prepared only about 50% of the ballots needed for the number of voters, Lee said, “Whether the decision to print fewer ballots was based on guidelines or was a judgment made by local election commissions themselves must be thoroughly addressed later in the National Assembly.” (이 대표는 송파구선관위 등이 투표용지를 유권자 수의 50% 정도만 준비한 것에 대해 “투표용지를 적게 인쇄한 것이 지침에 따른 것인지, 지역별 선관위의 자체적 판단인지는 국회에서 나중에 엄중하게 다뤄야 한다”고 했다.)

He then added, “Before that, the vote counting process must be halted.” Explaining his reasoning, Lee pointed out, “Given that these are local elections where multiple races are held simultaneously, elections other than the Seoul mayoral race—such as those for district heads, city councilors, and district councilors—will be impacted by the missing votes in determining the outcome.” (그러면서 “그 전에 개표 절차를 중지해야 한다”고 했다. 그 이유에 대해 이 대표는 “여러 선거가 동시에 치러지는 지방선거인 만큼, 서울시장이 아닌 (구청장·시의원·구의원 등) 다른 선거는 부족한 표가 당락에 영향을 미칠 것”이라고 지적했다.)

Lee also noted, “The fact that voting continued for a significant period after exit polls were reported creates potential for distorted results.” He argued, “While we have conventionally accepted minor discrepancies, such as people who entered polling stations before 6 p.m. voting after that time, it’s problematic if voters who had already seen exit polls continued voting for hours, as happened this time.” (이 대표는 “출구조사가 보도된 뒤에 한참 동안 그 투표들이 진행된 것 자체가 투표가 왜곡될 소지가 있다”고도 했다. 이 대표는 “그간 편의상 (6시에 출구조사 결과를 발표하면서도) 투표소에 입장한 사람들이 6시가 넘어서 투표하는 정도의 오차를 인정했지만, 이번처럼 출구조사를 이미 본 사람들이 몇 시간씩 투표했다면 문제가 있다”고 했다.)

In this regard, Lee stated, “The election commission might think, ‘If we assume the maximum number of voters at the affected polling stations voted, and the vote margin falls within that range, there’s no issue,’ but this situation is different. If ballot shortages occurred by the hundreds or thousands, any vote count outcome, regardless of what it is, will carry significant political implications.” (이와 관련해 이 대표는 “아마 선관위는 ‘문제가 된 투표소의 최대 인원이 투표했다고 가정하고, 그 범위 내에 표차가 있으면 문제가 안 된다고 하면 된다’고 생각하겠지만, 이 상황은 그런 상황이 아니다”라며 “수백, 수천 표 단위로 용지 부족이 발생했다면 그 자체로 어떤 개표 결과가 나오더라도 정치적 의미가 크다”고 했다.)

He further remarked, “Once the vote counting is completed, numbers are set, and subsequent judgments on how to handle it become retrospective, which in itself is problematic.” (“개표가 끝나버리면, 일단 숫자가 나오고 어떻게 처분할지에 대한 사후적 판단이 되기 때문에, 그 자체로 문제가 된다”고도 했다.)

Lee emphasized, “Vote counting should be suspended first, and the central election commission members should convene an emergency meeting to make an official judgment and provide direction on this situation. Local election commissions should not make their own decisions and proceed with counting.” (이 대표는 “개표를 우선 중지하고, 중앙선관위원들이 긴급 회의를 소집해서 이 상황에 대한 공식적인 판단 및 지휘를 해야 한다”며 “지역선관위 등이 이런 것에 대해 판단해서 (개표를) 진행하면 안 된다”고 강조했다.)

item.title: Gyeonggi: Choo Mi-ae, Daejeon: Heo Tae-jeong, Chungbuk: Shin Yong-han, Ulsan: Kim Sang-wook Leading in Election (경기 추미애·대전 허태정·충북 신용한·울산 김상욱 당선 유력)
item.description:
Gyeonggi: Choo Mi-ae, Daejeon: Heo Tae-jeong, Chungbuk: Shin Yong-han, Ulsan: Kim Sang-wook Leading in Election (경기 추미애·대전 허태정·충북 신용한·울산 김상욱 당선 유력)

In the vote counting results for the June 3 nationwide local elections for metropolitan and provincial governors, as of 11 p.m. on the 3rd, Choo Mi-ae, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor, is likely to be elected. (6·3전국동시지방선거 시·도지사 개표 결과, 3일 오후 11시 현재 추미애 더불어민주당 경기지사 후보의 당선이 유력하다.)

Additionally, Democratic Party candidates Heo Tae-jeong for Daejeon mayor, Shin Yong-han for Chungcheongbuk-do governor, and Kim Sang-wook for Ulsan mayor are also expected to win. Democratic Party candidates Min Hyeong-bae for the integrated special city of Jeonnam-Gwangju and Wi Seong-gon for Jeju governor, as well as People Power Party candidate Lee Cheol-woo for Gyeongsangbuk-do governor, are virtually certain to be elected. (또 민주당 소속 허태정 대전시장 후보, 신용한 충북지사 후보, 김상욱 울산시장 후보 등도 당선이 유력하다. 민주당 소속 민형배 전남광주통합특별시장 후보, 위성곤 제주지사 후보와 국민의힘 소속 이철우 경북지사 후보는 당선이 확실시된다.)

According to the National Election Commission, as of 11:02 p.m., based on a 24.94% vote count, candidate Choo secured 53.15% of the votes, leading Yang Hyang-ja (41.24%) of the People Power Party, making her election likely. If Choo’s victory is confirmed, she will become the first female head of a metropolitan government in history. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면, 추 후보는 오후 11시 2분 개표율 24.94% 기준 53.15%를 득표해 양향자(41.24%) 국민의힘 후보를 앞서며 당선이 유력한 상황이다. 추 후보가 당선을 확정지으면 사상 첫 여성 광역단체장으로 기록되게 된다.)

At the same time in Daejeon, based on a 30.24% vote count, Heo Tae-jeong candidate garnered 62.09% of the votes, significantly ahead of Lee Jang-woo (35.69%) of the People Power Party. In Chungcheongbuk-do, based on a 48.32% vote count, Shin Yong-han achieved 54.80%, defeating Kim Young-hwan (45.19%) of the People Power Party. In Ulsan, with a 31.03% vote count, Kim Sang-wook leads with 55.44%, outpacing Kim Du-gyeom (39.53%) of the People Power Party. (같은 시각 대전에선 개표율 30.24% 기준으로 허태정 후보가 62.09%를 득표해 이장우(35.69%) 국민의힘 후보를 크게 앞서고 있다. 또 충북에선 신용한 후보가 개표율 48.32% 기준 54.80%를 득표해 김영환(45.19%) 국민의힘 후보를 이기고 있다. 개표율 31.03%의 울산에선 김상욱 후보가 55.44%로 김두겸(39.53%) 국민의힘 후보를 누르고 있다.)

In the integrated special city of Jeonnam-Gwangju, where Democratic Party support is strong, Min Hyeong-bae leads with 81.53%, far ahead of Lee Jeong-hyeon (9.3%). In Gyeongsangbuk-do, where People Power Party support is strong, Lee Cheol-woo leads with 64.28%, ahead of Oh Joong-gi (35.71%) of the Democratic Party. In Jeju, Wi Seong-gon leads with 62.65%, ahead of Moon Seong-yu (34%) of the People Power Party. (민주당 지지세가 강한 전남광주통합특별시에선 민형배 후보가 81.53%으로 이정현(9.3%) 후보를 크게 앞서고 있고, 국민의힘 지지세가 강한 경북에선 이철우 후보가 64.28%로 오중기(35.71%) 민주당 후보를 앞섰다. 제주에선 위성곤 후보가 62.65%로 문성유(34%) 국민의힘 후보를 앞섰다.)

item.title: Representative Jang Dong-hyuk breaks through standoff to enter Noh Tae-ak Election Commission Chairman's office (장동혁 대표, 노태악 선관위원장 사무실 대치 뚫고 진입)
item.description:
Representative Jang Dong-hyuk breaks through standoff to enter Noh Tae-ak Election Commission Chairman's office (장동혁 대표, 노태악 선관위원장 사무실 대치 뚫고 진입)

Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, visited the National Election Commission office in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province, on the 3rd, the day of the June 3 local elections, to protest against Central Election Commission Chairman Noh Tae-ak. <<> Representative Jang plans to protest the ballot shortage that occurred at some polling stations, including in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Earlier, during a meeting with Election Commission Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon, Jang demanded the suspension of vote counting and the holding of re-elections in the areas where ballot-related issues arose. <<> Lawmaker Kim Jang-kyum, who accompanied Representative Jang, said, “This is an issue that could even bring up the question of whether the Central Election Commission should exist,” adding, “Where is the Election Commission chairman?” Park Jun-tae, chief secretary to the party leader, also said, “Tell Noh Tae-ak, the Central Election Commission chairman, to prepare for a meeting.” Supreme Council member Kim Min-soo protested, calling it “a problem of democracy” and asking, “Is this a joke?” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거가 실시된 3일 노태악 중앙선거관리위원장에 항의하기 위해 경기 과천 선관위 사무실에 방문했다.)

item.title: Cheon Ho-seong, Advocating for ‘Equal Education,’ Virtually Secures Election as Jeollabuk-do Education Superintendent (‘평등 교육’ 내세운 천호성 전북교육감 당선 확실)
item.description:
Cheon Ho-seong, Advocating for ‘Equal Education,’ Virtually Secures Election as Jeollabuk-do Education Superintendent (‘평등 교육’ 내세운 천호성 전북교육감 당선 확실)

In the June 3 election for the Jeollabuk-do Superintendent of Education, candidate Cheon Ho-seong (59) recorded a vote share of 56.5% as of 11:40 p.m., leading candidate Lee Nam-ho (67) who received 43.5%, making his victory virtually certain. (6·3 전북도교육감 선거에서는 천호성(59) 후보가 3일 오후 11시 40분 현재 56.5% 득표율을 기록하며, 43.5%를 얻은 이남호(67) 후보를 앞서며 당선이 확실시된다.)

As the vote tally surpassed the halfway mark and the gap between the two candidates gradually widened, the fierce two-way race between progressive contenders for the top education post in Jeollabuk-do appears to be solidifying into a win for Cheon Ho-seong. (개표율이 중반을 넘어서며 두 후보 간 격차가 서서히 벌어지기 시작한 가운데, 진보 성향 후보 간의 치열한 양자 대결로 이목을 모았던 전북 교육 수장 자리는 천호성 후보의 승리로 굳어지는 모양새다.)

This election is analyzed to have been decisively shaped by differing educational philosophies over the issue of abolishing or retaining autonomous private high schools, as well as a morality debate that persisted until the final stages of the campaign, swaying voters' choices. (이번 선거는 자율형 사립고(자사고) 존폐 문제를 둘러싼 교육 철학의 시각차와 선거 막판까지 이어진 도덕성 공방이 유권자들의 표심을 가른 결정적 분수령이 된 것으로 분석됐다.)

Cheon Ho-seong, a former teacher, prioritized “eliminating inequality” and “equal education” in elementary and secondary school settings as core values during his campaign. His key pledge is to “convert autonomous private high schools into general high schools.” He believes it is necessary to break the cycle that encourages educational hierarchy and deepens inequality of opportunity. (교사 출신인 천호성 후보는 선거 운동 기간 초·중등 교육 현장의 ‘불평등 해소’와 ‘평등 교육’을 최우선 가치로 내걸었다. 그의 핵심 공약은 ‘자사고의 일반고 전환’이다. 교육 서열화를 부추기고 기회의 불평등을 심화시키는 고리를 끊어내야 한다는 게 그의 생각이다.)

A local education industry insider commented, “Candidate Cheon’s argument to provide equal educational environments for all students appears to have drawn support from local parents who were concerned about disparities in their children’s education.” (지역 교육계 관계자는 “모든 학생에게 균등한 교육 환경을 제공하겠다는 천 후보의 주장은 자녀 교육 격차를 우려하던 지역 학부모층의 지지를 이끌어낸 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

In response, candidate Lee Nam-ho countered with a pledge to create “10 Sangsan High Schools,” aiming to foster top-tier high schools. His plan was to prevent the outflow of talented students from the region by developing prestigious schools and to elevate the overall quality of Jeollabuk-do education by sharing infrastructure with general high schools. However, it is interpreted that Jeollabuk-do voters showed greater support for Cheon, who advocated for equal education and strengthening public interest. (반면 이남호 후보는 최고 수준의 고등학교를 육성하는 이른바 ‘상산고 10개 만들기’ 공약으로 맞불을 놓았다. 명문 학교를 육성해 지역 내 우수 인재의 유출을 막고, 인프라를 일반고와 공유해 전북 교육 전반을 상향 평준화하겠다는 구상이었다. 하지만 전북 유권자들은 평등 교육과 공공성 강화를 주장한 천 후보에게 더 많은 지지를 보낸 것으로 풀이된다.)

Close to the main election, morality vetting and negative campaigning between both camps also contributed to a tight race until the end. When an official from Lee’s campaign suffered a blow to his credibility after police raided his office over suspicions of media bribery, Cheon’s side intensified pressure by demanding the candidate’s resignation. (본선거에 임박해 양측 캠프가 벌인 도덕성 검증과 네거티브 공방도 막판까지 혼전을 거듭하게 한 요인이었다. 이 후보 캠프 관계자가 언론 매수 의혹으로 경찰의 압수수색을 받으며 도덕성에 타격을 입자, 천 후보 측은 후보 사퇴를 압박하며 공세를 높였다.)

On the other hand, Cheon also faced a counterattack amid allegations of selling posts, stemming from controversy over a recorded phone call about a “promise of a policy director position” that emerged during the unification process. Both candidates flatly denied any political deals or misconduct, engaging in a war of truth. However, it is analyzed that voters ultimately made a strategic choice, weighing the substantive direction of education policy over the allegations themselves. <<>> (반면 천 후보 역시 단일화 과정에서 불거진 ‘정책국장 자리 약속’ 통화 녹음 논란으로 매관매직 의혹이라는 역공을 맞았다. 두 후보 모두 정치적 거래나 비위 의혹을 전면 부인하며 진실 공방을 벌였으나, 결과적으로 유권자들은 의혹 자체보다는 교육 정책의 실질적인 지향점에 무게를 두고 전략적 선택을 내린 것으로 분석된다.)

item.title: 24 Years After His Father... Projected Victory for Son as Taean County Mayor (아버지 이어 24년 만에... 아들이 충남 태안군수 당선 확실)
item.description:
24 Years After His Father... Projected Victory for Son as Taean County Mayor (아버지 이어 24년 만에... 아들이 충남 태안군수 당선 확실)

In the Taean County mayoral election in South Chungcheong Province, People Power Party candidate Yoon Hee-shin (58) secured 59.66% of the vote as of 00:00 on the 3rd (ballot count rate 75.82%), leading Democratic Party of Korea candidate Kang Cheol-min (69) who received 40.33%, with the victory appearing certain. If Yoon is elected, it will mark the first father-son county mayor in Taean since the start of local elections in 1995. Yoon’s father, former Taean County Mayor Yoon Hyung-sang, was elected twice as a member of the United Liberal Democrats in the 1st and 2nd local elections and served two terms as county mayor. After his father’s term ended in 2002, the son is set to take the county mayor’s position 24 years later. (충남 태안군수 선거에서는 국민의힘 윤희신(58) 후보가 3일 오전 0시 현재(개표율 75.82%) 59.66%를 득표해 40.33%를 얻은 더불어민주당 강철민(69) 후보를 앞서 당선이 확실시된다. 윤 후보가 당선되면 1995년 지방선거가 시작된 이후 태안에서 첫 부자(父子) 군수가 탄생하는 것이다. 윤 후보의 부친인 윤형상 전 태안군수는 지난 1·2회 지방선거에서 자유민주연합 소속으로 당선돼 두 차례 군수를 지냈다. 2002년 부친의 군수 임기가 끝난 후 24년 만에 아들이 군수 자리에 오르게 됐다.)

Yoon stated, “I acutely felt the residents’ desire to change Taean amid difficult realities such as population decline, regional economic stagnation, and youth exodus,” adding, “I will implement ‘management-oriented administration’ for the welfare of all residents and create a Taean that unites through harmony and integration, not conflict and division.” (윤 후보는 “인구 감소와 지역 경제 침체, 청년 유출 등 어려운 현실 속 태안을 바꿔야 한다는 군민들의 바람을 절실히 느꼈다”면서 “군민 전체의 복리를 위한 ‘경영 행정’을 실행하고, 갈등과 분열이 아닌 화합과 통합으로 하나 되는 태안을 만들겠다”고 말했다.)

Yoon served as an aide to National Assembly member Seong Il-jong and was elected to the South Chungcheong Provincial Council after running in the 2022 local elections. In this election, with Democratic Party of Korea incumbent Taean County Mayor Ka Se-ro, who was seeking a third term, eliminated in the primary, the race unfolded as a contest between candidates without an “incumbent premium.” (윤 후보는 성일종 국회의원 보좌관을 지내고, 2022년 지방선거에 출마해 충남도의원에 당선됐다. 이번 선거에선 3선을 노리던 더불어민주당 소속 가세로 태안군수가 경선에서 탈락한 가운데 ‘현직 프리미엄’ 없는 후보 간 대결로 펼쳐졌다.)

During his campaign, Yoon emphasized his strong execution capability, saying, “I learned from my father that politics is not about power but about responsibility.” (윤 후보는 선거 운동에서 “(부친에게) 정치는 권력이 아니고 책임이라는 것을 배웠다”면서 실행력 강한 후보임을 강조했다.)

As part of his pledges, he proposed forming a “Sales Planning Group” to provide one-stop administrative services from attracting corporate investment to obtaining permits, and prioritizing the construction of a section of a highway connecting to Anseong in Taean, which currently lacks a highway. He also vowed to attract a National Defense Future Aviation Research Center to draw defense companies to Taean. (그는 공약으로 ‘세일즈 기획단’을 구성해 기업의 투자 유치부터 인허가까지 이뤄지는 원스톱 행정을 펼치고, 고속도로 없는 태안에 안성까지 연결하는 고속도로 일부 구간을 우선 건설하겠다고 했다. 국방미래항공연구센터도 유치해 방산 기업들이 태안으로 몰려오도록 하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Yoon said, “I will shift the collapsing industrial structure toward future industries and focus all capabilities on attracting businesses and creating quality jobs,” adding, “I will realize an administration that serves the residents, not one that rules over them, and finds answers on the ground.” (윤 후보는 “무너지는 산업구조를 미래산업 중심으로 전환하고, 기업 유치와 양질의 일자리 창출에 모든 역량을 집중하겠다”면서 “군민 위에 군림하는 행정이 아니라 군민을 섬기는 행정, 현장에서 답을 찾는 행정을 실현하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Standoff over Ballot Box in Jamsil 7-dong... Election Commission Calls Emergency Meeting at Midnight (잠실7동 투표함 놓고 대치중... 선관위 0시 긴급위원회 소집)
item.description:
Standoff over Ballot Box in Jamsil 7-dong... Election Commission Calls Emergency Meeting at Midnight (잠실7동 투표함 놓고 대치중... 선관위 0시 긴급위원회 소집)

The National Election Commission has decided to hold an emergency meeting to discuss countermeasures regarding the shortage of local election ballots in some areas of Seoul on the 3rd. (중앙선거관리위원회가 3일 서울 일부 지역에서 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 것과 관련해 대응책 논의를 위한 긴급 회의를 열기로 했다.)

Heo Cheol-hoon, Secretary-General of the National Election Commission, stated during a meeting with Jang Dong-hyuk, a representative of the People Power Party who visited the election commission office in Gwacheon, Gyeonggi Province to protest, “We plan to convene an emergency committee at 12:00 AM (midnight on the 4th).” (중앙선관위 허철훈 사무총장은 이날 밤 경기 과천에 있는 중앙선관위 청사를 항의 방문한 국민의힘 장동혁 대표와의 면담 자리에서 “12시(4일 0시)에 긴급 위원회를 소집하려고 한다”고 말했다.)

According to the election commission, as of 6:20 PM on that day, voters were forced to wait at a total of 14 polling stations in Seoul alone—including 12 stations in the Jamsil area of Songpa-gu and others in Gangnam-gu (1 station) and Gwangjin-gu (1 station)—due to ballot shortages. (선관위에 따르면 이날 오후 6시20분 기준 서울 송파구 잠실 일대를 비롯한 투표소 12곳과 강남구 투표소 1곳, 광진구 투표소 1곳 등 서울에서만 총 14곳의 투표소에서 투표용지 부족으로 유권자들이 대기하는 일이 벌어졌다.)

In particular, at the 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, set up at the senior center of Woosung Apartment in Songpa-gu, Seoul, a ballot shortage occurred. When election commission staff attempted to remove the ballot boxes after 6 PM, residents gathered to protest, leading to a standoff with police. (특히 서울 송파구 우성아파트 경로당에 마련된 잠실7동 제2투표소에선 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생했는데도 오후 6시 이후 선관위 직원들이 투표함을 반출하려고 하자 이에 항의하는 주민들이 몰려들면서 경찰과 대치하는 상황이 벌어졌다.)

In response, Secretary-General Heo Cheol-hoon held a press conference at the election commission office that afternoon, bowing his head and saying, “I deeply feel responsible and offer my sincere apologies.” (이와 관련 허철훈 총장은 이날 오후 선관위 청사에서 기자회견을 열어 “책임을 통감하며 깊이 사과드린다”며 고개를 숙였다.)

item.title: Do Seong-hun Superintendent of Education, on Track to Become Incheon's First Three-Term Winner (‘인천 첫 3선 도전’ 도성훈 교육감, 당선 확실)
item.description:
Do Seong-hun Superintendent of Education, on Track to Become Incheon's First Three-Term Winner (‘인천 첫 3선 도전’ 도성훈 교육감, 당선 확실)

In the June 3 Incheon Superintendent of Education election, incumbent superintendent Do Seong-hun (66) is expected to win a third term. If confirmed, Superintendent Do will become Incheon's first three-term superintendent since the direct election system for superintendents was introduced in 2010. (6·3 인천시교육감 선거에서 도성훈(66) 현 교육감의 3선 당선이 확실시 되고 있다. 당선이 확정될 경우, 도 교육감은 2010년 교육감 직선제 도입 후 인천 첫 3선 교육감으로 이름을 남기게 된다.)

According to the National Election Commission, as of 2:30 a.m. on the 4th (with a vote tally rate of 68.94%), Superintendent Do Seong-hun recorded a vote share of 37.3%, leading candidates Lee Dae-hyeong (65), with a vote share of 34.14%, and Im Byeong-gu (62), with a vote share of 28.55%. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면, 도성훈 교육감은 4일 오전 2시 30분 현재(개표율 68.94%) 37.3%의 득표율을 기록하면서, 이대형(65) 후보(득표율 34.14%)와 임병구(62) 후보(득표율 28.55%)를 앞서고 있다.)

Superintendent Do appealed to voters by saying, "Based on a 99.1% public pledge fulfillment rate, please support me to complete the ‘Student Success Era.’" (도 교육감은 “99.1% 공약 이행률을 바탕으로 ‘학생 성공시대’를 완수할 수 있도록 지지해달라”며 표심을 공략했다.)

He also pledged "education that grows according to one’s own path" and "education that gives up on no single child," promoting promises such as the "Full Responsibility System for Basic Education" based on the "Reading, Walking, Writing (Read, Walk, Write)" education initiative pursued during his term, along with "AI-Integrated Education," "Ecological and Peace Education," and "Democratic Citizenship Education." (또 ‘결대로 성장하는 교육’ ‘한 아이도 포기하지 않는 교육’을 다짐하며 임기 중 추진한 ‘읽걷쓰(읽기·걷기·쓰기)’ 교육 기반 ‘기본교육 완전 책임제’와 ‘AI융합교육 및 생태‧평화교육’, ‘민주시민교육’ 등을 공약했다.)

In a statement, Superintendent Do Seong-hun said, "I will open a united Incheon education for the future of our children," adding, "I will take citizens' voices as my compass and tackle serious challenges such as full responsibility for basic academic skills, narrowing the educational gap between old and new downtown areas, protecting teachers, and resolving overcrowded classrooms." (도성훈 교육감은 입장문에서 “우리 아이들의 미래를 위해 하나로 뭉치는 화합의 인천 교육을 열어가겠다”며 “시민의 목소리를 나침반으로 삼고, 기초 학력의 완전한 책임, 원도심과 신도심 간 교육 격차 해소, 교사 보호, 과밀 학급 해소 등 엄중한 과제들을 해결해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

Superintendent Do, who ran as a progressive candidate in 2018 and 2022 and was elected consecutively, previously worked as a teacher at GwanGyo Middle School, Buga High School, and Dongincheon High School, and served as the head of the Incheon branch of the Korean Teachers and Education Workers Union (KTU) and as a standing co-chair of the Incheon School Meal Citizens' Association. (2018년과 2022년 진보 진영 후보로 출마해 연이어 당선된 도 교육감은 관교중과 부개고, 동인천고 등에서 교사로 활동하고, 전교조 인천지부장과 인천학교급식시민모임 상임 공동대표를 지냈다.)

item.title: 'ABC+E' 'Jemunbu Project'… Pro-Lee Park Chan-dae, Former Floor Leader, Certain to Win Incheon Mayor (‘ABC+E’ ‘제문부 프로젝트’… 친명 박찬대 전 원내대표, 인천시장 당선 확실)
item.description:
'ABC+E' 'Jemunbu Project'… Pro-Lee Park Chan-dae, Former Floor Leader, Certain to Win Incheon Mayor (‘ABC+E’ ‘제문부 프로젝트’… 친명 박찬대 전 원내대표, 인천시장 당선 확실)

In the June 3 Incheon mayoral election, former Democratic Party floor leader Park Chan-dae (59) is confirmed to have won. (6·3 인천시장 선거에서 더불어민주당 박찬대(59) 전 원내대표의 당선이 확실시된다.)

According to the National Election Commission, as of 2:40 a.m. on the 4th (with 80.01% of votes counted), former floor leader Park Chan-dae recorded a 53.66% vote share, leading incumbent People Power Party Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok (69, with a 45.26% vote share) by about 8 percentage points. Reform Party Incheon chapter chairman Lee Gi-bung (63) is recording a 1.06% vote share. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면 박찬대 전 원내대표는 4일 오전 2시 40분 현재(개표율 80.01%) 53.66%의 득표율을 기록하면서, 국민의힘 유정복(69) 현 시장(득표율 45.26%)을 약 8%포인트 차이로 앞서고 있다. 개혁신당 이기붕(63) 인천시당위원장은 1.06%의 득표율을 기록 중이다.)

In a media interview, former floor leader Park stated, "A year ago, the people chose the Lee Jae-myung People's Sovereignty government, saving the Republic of Korea that was on the brink. Today, the citizens of Incheon have once again made a decision for a great Incheon." (박 전 원내대표는 언론 인터뷰에서 “1년 전 국민들이 이재명 국민주권정부를 선택해 벼랑 끝에 선 대한민국을 구해주셨고, 오늘 인천시민 여러분께서 다시 한번 위대한 인천을 향한 결단을 내려 주셨다”고 했다.)

He continued, "I believe that your choice of me is a command from the citizens to properly lead Incheon, which has been stagnant for a long time and needs to take another leap forward," adding, "I will adopt a more humble attitude to meet the citizens' love and expectations, and I will devote all my strength to leading Incheon's leap forward." (이어 “저를 선택해 주신 건 오랜 기간 정체돼 있고, 한 단계 더 도약해야 할 인천을 잘 이끌어달라는 시민의 명령이라고 생각된다”며 “더욱 겸손한 자세로 시민의 사랑과 기대에 부응하고, 인천의 도약을 이끌어 내는 데 혼신의 힘을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

During this election campaign, former floor leader Park pledged to foster industries such as artificial intelligence (AI), bio (BIO), culture (Culture), and energy (Energy) through the so-called 'ABC+E' strategy, aiming to transform Incheon into a self-sufficient high-tech city with many high-wage jobs. (박 전 원내대표는 이번 선거 과정에서 인공지능(AI), 바이오(BIO), 컬처(Culture), 에너지(Energy) 등 산업을 집중 육성하는 이른바 ‘ABC+E’ 전략을 추진해 인천을 고임금 일자리가 많고 첨단산업 자족도시로 만들겠다고 공약했다.)

He also promised to implement the 'Jemunbu Project' for a major leap forward in the three old downtown areas of Jemulpo, Munhak, and Bupyeong, expand railway and road networks, and expand medical care and welfare networks. (또 제물포와 문학, 부평 등 3대 원도심의 대도약을 위한 ‘제문부 프로젝트’ 추진과 철도·도로망 확충, 의료 돌봄 복지망 확대 등을 약속했다.)

Former floor leader Park, who served three terms as a National Assembly member for the Yeonsu-gu A district in Incheon, is considered a key pro-Lee figure, having served as a Supreme Council member and floor leader when President Lee Jae-myung was the Democratic Party leader. (인천 연수구갑 선거구에서 3선 국회의원을 한 박 전 원내대표는 이재명 대통령이 민주당 대표를 할 때 최고위원, 원내대표 등으로 활동하는 등 친명계 핵심 인사로 꼽힌다.)

Incumbent People Power Party Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok released a statement saying, "I humbly accept the stern choice of the citizens," and added, "It seems my earnest desire to work more for Incheon was not enough to win the citizens' hearts." He continued, "Incheon has been my entire life, and that feeling will never change," adding, "I will continue to spare no effort for Incheon's development and the happiness of its citizens." (국민의힘 유정복 현 시장은 입장문을 내 “시민 여러분의 준엄한 선택을 겸허히 받아들인다”며 “인천을 위해 더 일하고 싶었던 간절함이 시민 여러분의 마음을 얻기에는 부족했던 것 같다”고 했다. 이어 “인천은 제 삶의 전부였고, 그 마음은 결코 변하지 않을 것”이라며 “앞으로도 인천 발전과 시민 행복을 위한 노력을 아끼지 않겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: [Episode 9] Sariel's Counterattack ([9화] 사리엘의 반격)
item.description:
[Episode 9] Sariel's Counterattack ([9화] 사리엘의 반격)

☞ See from Episode 1 (☞ 1화부터 보기)

☞ Character Introduction (☞ 등장인물 소개)

Before leaving the house at 5 a.m., Park Gwan-gyu, Director of the Defense Ministry's Power Resource Management Office, bit into a slice of apple his wife had cut for him. The apple was sweet. That morning's situation was the exact opposite. (국방부 전력자원관리실장 박관규는 새벽 5시 집을 나서기 전에 아내가 깎아준 사과 한 조각을 베어 물었다. 사과는 달았다. 이날 아침 상황은 정반대였다.)

Park Gwan-gyu's fingers, rapidly scrolling through dozens of morning news clippings, stopped at one article. A headline that had simply copied TaeSan Defense's press release. (수십매의 조간 기사 스크랩을 빠른 속도로 넘기던 박관규의 손가락이 한 기사에서 멈췄다. 태산디펜스 보도자료를 그대로 받아 쓴 기사 제목.)

"Ha, give me a break." (“허, 참나.”)

The corner of Park Gwan-gyu's mouth twisted. He vividly remembered the performance of Duael's Sariel at the London ExCeL exhibition just a few months ago. Sentinel? From Park Gwan-gyu's perspective, their algorithm was a shell that completely failed to understand Korea's unique circumstances. (박관규의 입 끝이 한 번 비틀렸다. 불과 몇 달 전, 런던 엑셀 전시장에서 듀다엘의 사리엘이 보여준 성능을 그는 생생히 기억했다. 센티넬? 박관규 입장에서 그들의 알고리즘은 한국의 특수성을 전혀 이해하지 못하는 껍데기였다.)

Director Park was an elite bureaucrat with the titles of Korea Military Academy graduate and Ph.D. in engineering. Looking at data and firepower before political rhetoric was his long-standing work habit. (박 실장은 육사 출신에 공학 박사라는 수식어가 따라붙는 엘리트 관료였다. 정치적 수사보다 데이터와 화력을 먼저 보는 게 그의 오랜 업무 습관이었다.)

"Senior, it's me. Did you see the morning papers?" (“선배님, 접니다. 조간 보셨습니까?”)

It was a protest without any preamble. (서론 따위는 없는 항의였다.)

"The Sentinel engine is not reliable. It's an algorithm deployed on NATO's Eastern Front that got retired due to false alarm issues. The disposal report is still circulating. They just changed the label and brought it to Korea." (“센티넬 엔진은 신뢰할 수 없습니다. NATO 동부 전선에 배치됐다가 오탐률 문제로 퇴출된 알고리즘이에요. 폐기 처분 보고서까지 아직 돌아다닙니다. 그걸 라벨만 바꿔서 한국에 들고 온 겁니다.”)

Park Gwan-gyu put down the remaining apple. (박관규는 먹다 남은 사과를 내려놓았다.)

"An algorithm that couldn't even last on the European plains will never work in Korea's mountainous terrain. Ask the chairman directly if TaeSan is trying to gamble with national defense. Tell him if we'd ever approve a business deal with stuff like this." (“유럽 평원에서도 못 버틴 알고리즘이 한국 산악 지형에서 될 리가 없어요. 태산이 지금 국방을 담보로 장난을 치겠다는 건지 회장님께 직접 물어보십시오. 우리가 이따위 물건에 사업 승인 내줄 것 같냐고 말입니다.”)

Adviser Choi paused for a moment. (최 고문이 잠시 뜸을 들였다.)

"Director Park, I just got briefed too. The internal business departments are in chaos right now. The chairman reportedly ordered the press release distribution directly this morning as soon as he arrived, without even an executive meeting. I wasn't told anything in advance either." (“박 실장, 나도 방금 보고받았어. 내부 사업부서들도 지금 난리야. 회장님이 아침에 출근하자마자 임원 회의도 없이 직접 보도자료 배포를 지시했다더라고. 나도 사전에 한마디 못 들었어.”)

"Alright, understood." (“일단 알겠습니다.”)

Park Gwan-gyu hung up and summoned his aide. (박관규는 전화를 끊고 전속 부관을 호출했다.)

"Find the contact information for Evan, the team leader at Duael Tech I met in London before. If TaeSan is going to play it this way, we need to notify them at the ministry level that we will be reviewing the entire business rights from scratch." (“일전에 런던에서 만났던 듀다엘 테크의 에반 팀장 연락처 알아봐. 태산이 이런 식으로 나온다면, 국방부 차원에서 사업권 전체를 원점에서 재검토하겠다고 통보할 필요가 있어.”)

At 5:15 a.m., Evan ultimately hadn't slept a wink. The dawn of Pangyo was breaking outside his window. The laptop had never been closed all night. (새벽 5시 15분, 에반은 결국 한숨도 자지 못했다. 창밖으로 판교의 새벽이 밝아왔다. 밤새 노트북은 한 번도 덮이지 않았다.)

It was a blank document with only a title. Below it was empty space. (제목만 있는 빈 문서였다. 그 아래는 공백이었다.)

Evan took a shower and drank instant coffee. Beyond the bitterness, there was no taste. He opened the laptop again. There was one more new message in his inbox. (에반은 샤워를 하고 인스턴트 커피를 마셨다. 쓴맛 너머에 아무 맛도 없었다. 노트북을 다시 열었다. 메일함에 새 메시지 하나가 더 왔다.)

Evan read the email twice. Two words were stuck in his eyes. (에반은 이메일을 두 번 읽었다. 두 단어가 눈에 박혔다.)

Internal audit. Resource reallocation. (내부 감사. 리소스 재배분.)

Headquarters was preparing to cut him loose. Evan closed the email. He didn't write a reply. (본사는 그를 떼어낼 준비를 하고 있었다. 에반은 메일을 닫았다. 답장은 쓰지 않았다.)

Evan looked out the window at the Pangyo morning. Clean streets, delivery motorcycles weaving through intersections, offices beginning to light up floor by floor. This planned city, as always, was swallowing its own complexity and turning it into calm. Until ten minutes ago, so was Evan. (에반은 창밖의 판교 아침을 바라봤다. 깨끗한 거리, 교차로 사이를 엮어가는 배달 오토바이, 층층이 불이 켜지기 시작하는 사무실. 이 계획 도시는 늘 그랬듯 자기의 복잡함을 스스로 삼켜 차분함으로 바꾸는 중이었다. 10분 전까지는 에반도 그랬다.)

The screen went dark. Evan sat in front of the blank glass. (화면이 어두워졌다. 에반은 꺼진 유리 앞에 앉아 있었다.)

The phone rang. He checked the time. 7:30 a.m. It was an unknown number. (전화벨이 울렸다. 시계를 봤다. 7시 30분. 모르는 번호였다.)

"Hello?" (“Hello?”)

"Team Leader Evan, this is Park Gwan-gyu from the Ministry of National Defense." (“에반 팀장님, 국방부 박관규입니다.”)

Evan's back straightened. (에반의 등이 곧게 펴졌다.)

"Yes, Director. I remember." (“네, 실장님. 기억합니다.”)

"Sorry for calling so early. It's urgent. Did you see the TaeSan Defense article? About their partnership with Sentinel." (“아침 일찍 죄송합니다. 급한 일이라서요. 태산디펜스 기사 봤습니까? 센티넬과 파트너십 한다는 거.”)

"...Yes, I saw it." (“······봤습니다.")

"I'll be honest. I was angry reading that article." (“솔직히 말하겠습니다. 저는 그 기사를 보고 화가 났어요.”)

Evan's throat rumbled lowly. (에반의 목이 낮게 울렸다.)

"I saw Sariel in London. It was impressive. Sentinel? It's no comparison. It's a system that doesn't consider Korea's terrain or climate conditions at all. It wasn't designed with this peninsula in mind from the start. I don't understand what TaeSan is doing." (“런던에서 사리엘 봤습니다. 인상적이었어요. 센티넬? 비교가 안 됩니다. 한국 지형, 기후 조건 전혀 고려 안 된 시스템이에요. 애초에 이 반도를 염두에 두고 만든 물건이 아닙니다. 태산이 지금 뭘 하는 건지 이해가 안 갑니다.”)

Park Gwan-gyu paused for a moment. (박관규가 잠시 말을 끊었다.)

"That's why I'm calling. Is Duael still interested in the Korean market?" (“그래서 전화한 겁니다. 듀다엘은 아직 한국 시장에 관심 있습니까?”)

Evan's hand clenched into a fist on his knee. (에반의 손이 무릎 위에서 주먹을 쥐었다.)

"Of course." (“물론입니다.”)

"Then let's meet. Is today possible?" (“그럼 만납시다. 오늘 가능합니까?”)

"...Yes." (“······예.")

"The Ministry of National Defense building in Samgakji. 10 a.m. Can you come?" (“삼각지 국방부 청사. 오전 10시. 올 수 있습니까?”)

Evan checked the time on his smartphone. It was 7:30 a.m. (에반이 스마트폰 시계를 봤다. 7시 30분이었다.)

"I'll be there." (“가겠습니다.”)

"Good. I'll be waiting." (“좋습니다. 기다리겠습니다.”)

Evan put down his smartphone. He picked it up again briefly, then set it down once more. (에반이 스마트폰을 내려놓았다. 이내 다시 들었다가, 다시 내려놓았다.)

With the fatigue from last night still settled behind his eyes, his blood began to circulate. It felt like dopamine was hitting his brain before the coffee. His pulse quickened. His fingertips felt like starting something. There was no one in the room. There was no one to show it to. (어제 밤의 피로가 눈 뒤쪽에 아직 앉아 있는 상태에서 피가 돌기 시작했다. 도파민이 커피보다 먼저 뇌리를 스치는 느낌이었다. 맥박도 올라갔다. 손끝이 무언가를 시작하고 싶은 기분이었다. 방 안에는 아무도 없었다. 보여줄 사람이 없었다.)

Evan kept his breathing steady. (에반은 호흡을 일정하게 유지했다.)

'Park Gwan-gyu contacted me first. He criticized TaeSan. He's interested in Sariel. This is an opportunity. An unexpected opportunity.' (‘박관규가 먼저 연락을 했다. 태산을 비판했다. 사리엘에 관심이 있다. 이것은 기회다. 예상치 못한 기회.’)

But Evan was still anxious. (하지만 에반은 여전히 불안했다.)

'Yesterday, I froze in front of Shin Jae-hyuk. I could do the same in front of Park Gwan-gyu today.' (‘어제 신재혁 앞에서 나는 얼어붙었다. 오늘 박관규 앞에서도 그럴 수 있다.’)

Evan leaned away from the backrest. (에반은 등받이에서 몸을 떼었다.)

'No. Today is different. Park Gwan-gyu is different from Shin Jae-hyuk. He's a technician. An engineer. I can speak the same language as him.' (‘아니다. 오늘은 다르다. 박관규는 신재혁과 다르다. 그는 기술자다. 엔지니어다. 나는 그와 같은 언어를 쓸 수 있다.’)

Evan began packing his laptop. The blank document was still open. (에반은 노트북을 챙기기 시작했다. 빈 문서는 여전히 열려 있었다.)

🎧 Listen to the brilliant performances of AI voice actors in audio. <<>> (🎧 AI 성우들의 명연기를 음성으로 들어보세요.)

]]>

item.title: Kim Seok-jun Becomes Nation's First Four-Term Superintendent in Busan (김석준, 부산서 전국 최초 4선 교육감 탄생)
item.description:
Kim Seok-jun Becomes Nation's First Four-Term Superintendent in Busan (김석준, 부산서 전국 최초 4선 교육감 탄생 )

In the June 3 Busan Superintendent election, progressive incumbent Kim Seok-jun (69) was elected. With his victory in this election, Kim has become the nation’s first “four-term superintendent.” (6·3 부산교육감 선거는 진보 성향의 김석준(69) 현 교육감이 당선됐다. 이번 선거에서 김 교육감이 당선되면서 전국 최초의 ‘4선 교육감’이 됐다.)

Superintendent Kim Seok-jun was consecutively elected as Busan Superintendent in 2014 and 2018, but lost to former conservative Superintendent Ha Yun-su in 2022. However, Ha’s election was invalidated in December 2024 due to early campaigning violations, leading to a by-election in April of last year. Kim won that election, becoming a three-term superintendent. (김석준 교육감은 2014년과 2018년 연속 부산교육감에 당선됐고 2022년 하윤수 전 교육감(보수)에게 패해 낙선했다. 그러나 하 전 교육감은 사전 선거운동 혐의 등으로 2024년 12월 당선 무효형이 확정돼 작년 4월 재선거를 치렀다. 이 선거에서 김 교육감이 당선돼 3선 교육감이 됐다.)

Kim stated, “With proven ability and competence, I will show that the citizens’ choice was right,” adding, “I will bring hope to students, pride to teachers, and trust to parents.” (김 교육감은 “검증된 능력과 실력으로 시민 여러분의 선택이 옳았음을 증명해 보이겠다”며 “아이들에게 희망을, 선생님들에겐 자긍심을, 학부모님들에겐 믿음을 안겨드리겠다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Kim faces legal risks. He received an eight-month prison sentence with a two-year suspended sentence in the first trial for illegally hiring dismissed teachers from the Korean Teachers and Education Workers Union. The second trial is currently underway. (한편, 김 교육감은 사법 리스크를 안고 있다. 그는 전교조 해직 교사를 특별 채용한 혐의로 1심 재판에서 징역 8개월에 집행유예 2년을 선고받았다. 현재 2심이 진행 중이다.)

]]>

item.title: Choo Kyung-ho of People Power Party Likely to Win Daegu Mayoral Election... Democratic Party’s Kim Boo-kyum Concedes Defeat (국힘 추경호, 대구시장 당선 유력... 민주 김부겸 낙선인사)
item.description:
Choo Kyung-ho of People Power Party Likely to Win Daegu Mayoral Election... Democratic Party’s Kim Boo-kyum Concedes Defeat (국힘 추경호, 대구시장 당선 유력... 민주 김부겸 낙선인사)

In Daegu, a key battleground in the June 3 local elections, Choo Kyung-ho, the People Power Party candidate, is expected to defeat Kim Boo-kyum of the Democratic Party of Korea and win the mayoral election. <<> As of 2:28 AM on the 4th (with 65.12% of votes counted), Choo garnered 52.36% of the vote, leading Kim (46.6%) by a margin of 5.76 percentage points. Initially, Kim was ahead of Choo, but as counting progressed, the gap narrowed, and around 1 AM, Choo overtook Kim. <<> Kim appeared at his campaign office early in the morning and stated, “I humbly accept the election results given by the citizens. I congratulate candidate Choo, who competed with me to the end, on his victory.” He added, “This is a personal defeat for me, not a defeat for the citizens of Daegu who yearn for change. I thank the citizens of Daegu who trusted me until the end.” (6·3 지방선거 격전지인 대구에서 추경호 국민의힘 후보가 김부겸 더불어민주당 후보를 꺾고 시장 당선이 유력시됐다.)

item.title: As ballot count surpasses 50%, Daegu mayoral race leans toward Choo Kyung-ho (대구시장은 개표율 50% 넘기면서 추경호로 기울어져)
item.description:
As ballot count surpasses 50%, Daegu mayoral race leans toward Choo Kyung-ho (대구시장은 개표율 50% 넘기면서 추경호로 기울어져)

In the Daegu mayoral election, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho is pulling ahead of Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum in vote difference, making his victory all but certain. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th (with 61.28% of votes counted), Choo had 51.91% of the vote, leading Kim (47.05%) by 4.86 percentage points. The two candidates were neck-and-neck until late at night, but as the ballot count exceeded 50%, the likelihood of Choo’s victory increased significantly. (대구시장 선거에서는 국민의힘 추경호 후보가 더불어민주당 김부겸 후보와 표 차이를 벌리며 당선이 확실시된다. 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 61.28%) 추 후보가 51.91%를 득표해 김 후보(47.05%)를 4.86%포인트 앞섰다. 두 후보는 이날 밤늦게까지 경합했으나, 개표율이 50%를 넘어가며 추 후보 승리 가능성이 크게 높아졌다.)

Daegu has been called a "conservative stronghold," as no Democratic Party-affiliated candidate has ever won a local election there since the first local elections in 1995. If Choo is elected, it would be a dramatic comeback from his early disadvantage. Early in the campaign, opinion polls showed Kim with a considerable lead, but Choo gradually closed the gap, making it a tight race within the margin of error. As Choo’s victory became likely in the early hours of the morning, he said, “The collective support is being reflected in the current ballot count.” (대구는 1995년 제1회 지방선거 이후 현재까지 단 한 번도 민주당 계열 후보가 당선된 적이 없어 ‘보수의 텃밭’으로 불린다. 추 후보가 당선되면 선거 초반 열세를 뒤집는 역전극이 된다. 선거 초반 여론조사에선 김 후보가 상당히 앞섰으나, 이후 추 후보가 추격해 오차 범위 안팎의 접전이 벌어지기 시작했다. 추 후보는 이날 새벽 당선이 유력해지자 “마음을 모아준 것이 현재 개표 상황에 반영되고 있다”고 했다.)

According to exit polls from three broadcasters on the 3rd, Choo led Kim by 0.8 percentage points, with 49.9% to Kim’s 49.1%. Choo, a former economic bureaucrat, was first elected in the Dalseong district of Daegu in the 20th general election in 2016 and has served three consecutive terms. During the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, he served as the first Deputy Prime Minister for the Economy and Minister of Economy and Finance, as well as the floor leader of the People Power Party. In April, he defeated lawmaker Yoo Young-ha in the party primary runoff to advance to the general election. <<> Kim, Choo’s rival, was first elected as a candidate for the Grand National Party (now the People Power Party) in Gunpo, Gyeonggi Province, during the 16th general election in 2000. He later switched to the Uri Party (now the Democratic Party) and served three terms through the 18th general election. He ran in Daegu’s Suseong-gu District in the 19th general election but lost, and also lost the Daegu mayoral election two years later. However, he was elected to a fourth term in the 20th general election by defeating former Gyeonggi Governor Kim Moon-soo in the Suseong-gu District. He later served as Prime Minister during the Moon Jae-in administration. <<> Meanwhile, in the Gyeongbuk Province gubernatorial election, People Power Party candidate Lee Cheol-woo, seeking a third term, appeared certain of victory as of 2 a.m. on the 4th (with 71.42% of votes counted), winning 67.27% of the vote. He led Democratic Party candidate Oh Jung-ki, who had 32.72%, by over 30 percentage points. As his victory became likely, Lee said, “This victory is an order from the people to protect Gyeongbuk and make it the center of Korea’s local era,” adding, “I will turn scattered strengths into energy to open Gyeongbuk’s future.” <<> (3일 방송 3사 출구 조사 결과 추 후보는 49.9%로 김 후보(49.1%)를 0.8%포인트 차로 앞섰다. 경제 관료 출신인 추 후보는 2016년 20대 총선 때 대구 달성에서 당선돼 내리 3선을 했다. 윤석열 정부 땐 초대 경제부총리 겸 기획재정부 장관, 국민의힘 원내대표를 역임했다. 지난 4월 당 경선 결선에서 유영하 의원을 꺾고 본선에 나왔다.)

]]>

item.title: Six-term lawmaker and former party chair, minister Choo Mi-ae... Now the first female provincial governor (당대표·장관 지낸 6선 의원 추미애… 이번엔 첫 여성 도지사)
item.description:
Six-term lawmaker and former party chair, minister Choo Mi-ae... Now the first female provincial governor (당대표·장관 지낸 6선 의원 추미애… 이번엔 첫 여성 도지사)

In the Gyeonggi Province gubernatorial election held on the 3rd, Choo Mi-ae, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, decisively defeated Yang Hyang-ja, the People Power Party candidate, with a significant margin, securing an early victory. Candidate Choo made history by becoming the first female head of a regional government in constitutional history. In the Incheon mayoral election, Park Chan-dae, a key pro-Lee Jae-myung figure and Democratic Party candidate, outperformed Yoo Jeong-bok, the People Power Party candidate. (3일 실시된 경기도지사 선거에선 추미애 더불어민주당 후보가 양향자 국민의힘 후보를 큰 격차로 따돌리고 일찌감치 승리를 확정 지었다. 추 후보는 헌정 사상 첫 여성 광역자치단체장으로 이름을 올리게 됐다. 인천시장 선거에선 친명계 핵심인 박찬대 민주당 후보가 유정복 국민의힘 후보를 제쳤다.)

As of 2:00 PM on the 4th, Candidate Choo had secured 55.30% of the vote, leading Candidate Yang (39.17%) by a margin of 16.13 percentage points. In exit polls conducted by three major broadcasters, Candidate Choo led with 60.4% compared to Candidate Yang’s 34.1%, a difference of 26.3 percentage points. At the election office in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, Candidate Choo and her campaign staff erupted in applause and cheers upon seeing the exit poll results. In contrast, silence prevailed at Candidate Yang’s office. <<> In her victory speech, Candidate Choo said, "I, Choo Mi-ae, have never taken the easy path," adding, "No matter how difficult the path to uphold principles and convictions, I have silently carried out politics with only the people in mind." She also expressed, "I am deeply grateful that the residents of Gyeonggi Province chose my sincerity," and described the result as "the aspiration of Gyeonggi residents for the normalization of South Korea and significant change in Gyeonggi Province." She further promised, "I will tackle one by one the issues of transportation, housing, jobs, and balanced development that Gyeonggi Province faces." <<> Candidate Choo worked as a judge before entering politics in 1995 at the encouragement of former President Kim Dae-jung. She served as a National Assembly member for Seoul's Gwangjin-gu District across the 15th, 16th, 18th, 19th, and 20th terms and chaired the Democratic Party from 2016 to 2018. During the Moon Jae-in administration, she was appointed Minister of Justice in 2020, where she clashed with then-Prosecutor General Yoon Suk Yeol. In the 2024 general election, Candidate Choo moved her constituency to Hanam-gap in Gyeonggi Province, securing a sixth term and becoming the most senior female lawmaker. In the race for the first half of the National Assembly speaker position, she was outperformed by lawmaker Woo Won-shik. <<> In August last year, she was appointed chair of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee, succeeding lawmaker Lee Choon-seok, who had left the party amid controversy over proxy stock trading. On the committee, she led the unilateral processing of prosecutorial and judicial reform plans, gaining support from hardliners. Subsequently, she declared her candidacy for Gyeonggi governor, defeating incumbent Governor Kim Dong-yeon and pro-Lee Jae-myung lawmaker Han Jun-ho by a wide margin in the primary to become the official candidate. <<> Meanwhile, in the Incheon mayoral election, based on vote counting as of 2:00 PM on the 4th, Candidate Park Chan-dae led with 55.41%, ahead of incumbent Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok (43.51%) by 11.90 percentage points. In exit polls by three major broadcasters, Candidate Park was ahead with 53.7% to Candidate Yoo’s 45.5%. <<> Candidate Park stated on the day, "I will take the citizens’ command to move from regression to leap, from stagnation to growth, as my directive," and added, "I will immediately launch an emergency 100-day project for restoring livelihoods, as promised. I will not miss Incheon's golden time." He said, "Embracing diverse lives, from air and sea routes to historic old downtowns and vibrant new cities, I will perfectly coordinate with the central government." <<> A former accountant by profession, Candidate Park served three terms as a lawmaker for Incheon’s Yeonsu-gu District. Originally with faint factional ties, he emerged as a key pro-Lee Jae-myung figure as the Democratic Party was restructured under Lee’s system. Elected as a Supreme Council member in the party convention in August 2022, he took the lead in defending then-Democratic Party leader Lee Jae-myung against legal risks. In May 2024, he was elected as the floor leader of the Democratic Party in the 22nd National Assembly. Candidate Park lost to Representative Jeong Cheong-rae in the party leadership election in August last year, and in March this year, he was single-nominated as the Democratic Party candidate for Incheon mayor. (4일 2시 현재, 추 후보는 55.30%를 얻어 양 후보(39.17%)를 16.13%포인트 차로 크게 앞섰다. 방송 3사 출구조사에선 추 후보가 60.4%로 양 후보(34.1%)를 상대로 26.3%포인트 차이로 앞섰다. 경기 수원의 선거사무소에 모인 추 후보와 캠프 관계자들은 출구조사 결과가 나오자 박수와 함성을 보냈다. 반면 양 후보 사무소에선 정적이 흘렀다.)

item.title: South Chungcheong, Daejeon, North Chungcheong, Sejong... DP sweeps Chungcheong region's top local government posts (충남·대전·충북·세종… 與, 충청권 광역단체장 휩쓸어)
item.description:
South Chungcheong, Daejeon, North Chungcheong, Sejong... DP sweeps Chungcheong region's top local government posts (충남·대전·충북·세종… 與, 충청권 광역단체장 휩쓸어)

In the June 3 local elections, Democratic Party candidates running for the four top local government positions in the Chungcheong region—North and South Chungcheong, Daejeon, and Sejong—comfortably outpaced their People Power Party rivals as of 2 p.m. on the 4th. Even in South Chungcheong, where a tight race had been expected, the People Power Party fell behind, allowing the Democratic Party to sweep the entire region. (6·3 지방선거에서 충·남북, 대전, 세종 등 충청권 광역단체장 네 곳에 출마한 민주당 후보는 4일 2시 기준 국민의힘 후보들을 여유 있게 따돌렸다. 접전으로 예상했던 충남에서도 국민의힘이 밀려 민주당이 충청권을 석권하게 됐다.)

As of 2 p.m. that day, Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun was leading with 53.50%, ahead of People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum (46.49%) by 7.01 percentage points, making his victory all but certain. Park, a former two-term lawmaker representing his hometown of Gongju in South Chungcheong, has served multiple times as a spokesperson for the party and its election campaign. (이날 2시 현재, 민주당 박수현 후보가 53.50%로 국민의힘 김태흠 후보(46.49%)를 7.01%포인트(p) 앞서며 당선이 확실시됐다. 박 후보는 고향인 충남 공주 지역 재선 국회의원 출신으로 당과 선거 캠프 등에서 대변인을 수차례 맡았다.)

In the Daejeon mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Heo Tae-jeong was leading with 56.13%, far ahead of People Power Party candidate Lee Jang-woo (41.59%) by 14.54 percentage points, securing an early victory. Heo reclaimed the Daejeon mayoralty after four years, achieving a second term. He previously served as an administrative officer in the Roh Moo-hyun administration's Blue House, was re-elected as the head of Yuseong District, and won the Daejeon mayoral election in the 7th local elections in 2018. That day, Heo stated, "Today's victory is a stern order to create a Daejeon where citizens are the masters and to revive the collapsed livelihoods," adding, "I will move forward only focusing on the citizens." (대전시장 선거에서는 민주당 허태정 후보가 56.13%로, 국민의힘 이장우 후보(41.59%)를 14.54%포인트로 크게 앞서며 일찌감치 당선이 확실시됐다. 허 후보는 4년 만에 대전시장을 탈환하며 재선에 성공하게 됐다. 그는 노무현 정부 청와대 행정관으로 일했고 유성구청장을 연임한 뒤 2018년 7회 지방선거에서 대전시장에 당선됐다. 허 후보는 이날 “오늘의 승리는 시민이 주인인 대전을 만들고 무너진 민생을 살리라는 준엄한 명령”이라며 “오로지 시민만 바라보고 나아가겠다”고 했다.)

In the North Chungcheong governor election, Democratic Party candidate Shin Yong-han garnered 55.20% of the vote as of 2 p.m., leading People Power Party candidate Kim Young-hwan (44.79%) by 10.41 percentage points. Shin, formerly from a conservative party, resigned after overseeing policy operations for the Yoon Seok-youl campaign and joined the Democratic Party in 2024 as a recruit recruited by then-party leader Lee Jae-myung. After three attempts to become North Chungcheong governor since his time with the Bareunmirae Party in 2018, Shin succeeded, saying, "This election result is not a victory for a specific party or candidate, but the outcome of the aspirations of the residents for a new North Chungcheong," and "We will move toward the common goal of developing North Chungcheong." (충북지사 선거에서는 민주당 신용한 후보가 2시 현재 55.20%를 득표해 국민의힘 김영환 후보(44.79%)를 10.41%포인트 차로 앞섰다. 보수 계열 정당 출신인 신 후보는 윤석열 캠프에서 정책 실무를 총괄하다 사표를 낸 뒤 2024년 이재명 당시 민주당 대표의 영입 인재로 민주당에 합류했다. 2018년 바른미래당 시절부터 충북지사 도전 세 번 만에 당선에 성공한 신 후보는 “이번 선거 결과는 특정 정당이나 후보의 승리가 아니라, 새로운 충북을 향한 도민 여러분의 열망이 만들어낸 결과”라며 “충북 발전이라는 공동의 목표를 향해 나아가겠다”고 했다.)

In the Sejong mayoral election, as of 2 p.m., Democratic Party candidate Jo Sang-ho recorded a vote share of 59.68%, leading incumbent People Power Party candidate Choi Min-ho (37.26%) by 22.42 percentage points. Jo, who served as an aide to former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan during his time as a lawmaker and as Sejong's deputy mayor for economic affairs, among other roles. (세종시장 선거에서는 2시 기준으로 민주당 조상호 후보가 현직인 국민의힘 최민호 후보(37.26%)를 상대로 득표율 59.68%를 기록하며 22.42%포인트 앞섰다. 이해찬 전 총리의 국회의원 시절 보좌관을 지낸 조 후보는 세종시 전 경제부시장 등을 거쳤다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Cho Kuk: "Failed to accomplish 'Zero People Power Party' in Pyeongtaek... All my responsibility" ([속보] 조국 “평택서 ‘국힘 제로’ 완수 못해...모두 제 책임”)
item.description:
[Breaking] Cho Kuk: "Failed to accomplish 'Zero People Power Party' in Pyeongtaek... All my responsibility" ([속보] 조국 “평택서 ‘국힘 제로’ 완수 못해...모두 제 책임”)

Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, who ran in the by-election for Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, held alongside the June 3 local elections but lost to Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party candidate, stated in the early hours of the 4th, "I humbly accept the election results." <<> Candidate Cho visited the Pyeongtaek election office around 2:50 a.m. that day and said, "The citizens of Pyeongtaek embraced me as a warm neighbor, but I failed to meet their expectations." <<> Candidate Cho stated, "The top priority of this June election was the realization of 'Zero People Power Party.' While there were meaningful achievements nationwide, I was unable to complete that mission in Pyeongtaek. This is entirely my inadequacy and entirely my responsibility." <<> Candidate Cho added, "This result is my failure, not a mistake in the vision and values you projected onto me. I will always walk with you to ensure those hopes come true." <<> (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러진 경기 평택을 재선거에 출마했다가 유의동 국민의힘 후보에 밀려 낙선한 조국 조국혁신당 대표는 4일 새벽 “선거 결과를 겸허히 받아들인다”고 말했다.)

item.title: The Power of a Local… Yoo Ui-dong Defies Expectations, Beats Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk (토박이의 힘… 유의동, 예상 깨고 김용남·조국 눌렀다)
item.description:
The Power of a Local… Yoo Ui-dong Defies Expectations, Beats Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk (토박이의 힘… 유의동, 예상 깨고 김용남·조국 눌렀다)

In the by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul parliamentary seat, Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party is confirmed to have won. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, with vote counting in progress, Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party of Korea secured 29.12%, Yoo Ui-dong of the People Power Party 33.89%, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party 27.92%, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party 3.03%, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party 6.02%. Political circles commented, "This is a result of conservative voters rallying behind candidate Yoo amid the fierce clashes between candidates Kim and Cho, which split the ruling camp." Notably, Yoo is the only one among the five candidates who is a native of Pyeongtaek and has served as a three-term lawmaker for the district. <<> In his victory speech, Yoo said, "I once again extend my gratitude to the citizens of Pyeongtaek for allowing me to be here once more," and added, "I offer my sincere condolences to candidates Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk, Kim Jae-yeon, and Hwang Kyo-ahn, who competed with me." Yoo further stated, "The country is in a very difficult situation. I believe there is a reason the citizens have entrusted me with this critical task during such trying times. I will take my given duty seriously and walk step by step, following the orders given by the citizens." <<> The Pyeongtaek-eul by-election, which was previously a Democratic Party stronghold, was contested in a five-way race. Initially, there were prospects for a unification of candidates—including the ruling camp's Kim Yong-nam, Cho Kuk, and Kim Jae-yeon, and the opposition's Yoo Ui-dong and Hwang Kyo-ahn—but unification efforts fell through on both sides. Various opinion polls showed Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk trading first and second place within the margin of error, with Yoo Ui-dong trailing in third place also within the margin of error. Exit polls by three major broadcasters showed Kim Yong-nam at 30.3%, Yoo Ui-dong at 30.6%, and Cho Kuk at 31.1%, an extremely tight race within a 0.8-percentage-point range. <<> However, during the actual vote count, Yoo defied predictions and emerged victorious. Political observers noted, "This is the result of the ruling camp being split in half due to the rivalry between candidates Kim and Cho." Although there was even talk of a potential unification within the ruling camp between the two candidates, tensions between the parties were high from the early stages of the election. <<> Throughout the campaign, Cho Kuk's camp persistently raised controversies about Kim Yong-nam's past remarks—given his background from a conservative party—as well as allegations of assault by his aides, land speculation, and operating loan companies under false names. In doing so, they highlighted Cho as the ruling camp candidate. Kim's camp, in turn, characterized these as negative tactics and attacked Cho as a "pseudo-Democratic Party candidate." This fractured the ruling camp into two. The Democratic Party and the Cho Kuk Innovation Party had once discussed a merger, but there was even talk that this election made such a merger unlikely. While pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions openly supported Cho, the pro-Lee faction actively backed Kim, who had joined the party by supporting President Lee in the last presidential election. <<> Meanwhile, the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election emerged as a 'hot spot' due to the candidacy of Cho Kuk, a leading figure in the ruling camp, but the actual voter turnout was low. The final turnout stood at 54.7%, which was 6.2 percentage points lower than the average of 60.9% for the 14 by-elections nationwide. Political circles offered interpretations such as "due to the district's characteristics—a large, urban-rural complex area" and "voters grew fatigued from the continuous negative campaigning." (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에선 유의동 국민의힘 후보의 당선이 확실시됐다. 4일 오전 2시 현재 개표 진행 결과, 김용남 더불어민주당 후보 29.12%, 유의동 국민의힘 후보 33.89%, 조국 조국혁신당 후보 27.92%, 김재연 진보당 후보 3.03%, 황교안 자유와혁신 후보 6.02%였다. 정치권에선 “김 후보와 조 후보가 거센 공방을 벌이며 여권이 쪼개진 가운데, 보수 표심이 유 후보로 결집된 결과”라는 말이 나왔다. 특히 유 후보는 후보 5명 중 유일한 평택 토박이로 이 지역에서 3선 국회의원을 지냈다.)

]]>

item.title: Defeat Looms Across Key Battlegrounds… Calls for Jang Dong-hyuk’s Resignation Emerge Before Vote Counting Even Ends (경합지 곳곳서 패색… 개표 끝나기도 전에 ‘장동혁 사퇴론’ 나와)
item.description:
Defeat Looms Across Key Battlegrounds… Calls for Jang Dong-hyuk’s Resignation Emerge Before Vote Counting Even Ends (경합지 곳곳서 패색… 개표 끝나기도 전에 ‘장동혁 사퇴론’ 나와)

With the People Power Party’s crushing defeat in the June 3 local elections, internal conflicts over party leadership are expected to escalate. As the party lost in most key battlegrounds, some lawmakers have called for Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk to step down, and some members of the party leadership are considering resigning. Jang’s term runs until August next year, but he had previously stated, “My political life depends on the Seoul and Busan mayoral elections.” However, some observers suggest he may delay announcing his decision under the pretext of handling the shortage of ballots in the Seoul election. (국민의힘이 6·3 지방선거에서 대패하면서 향후 당권을 둘러싼 갈등이 커질 전망이다. 주요 경합지에서 대부분 패하면서 의원들 사이에선 장동혁 대표 사퇴 주장이 나왔고, 당 지도부 중 일부는 사퇴를 검토하고 있다. 장 대표의 임기는 내년 8월까지지만 장 대표는 “서울·부산시장 선거에 내 정치 생명이 달렸다”고 했었다. 다만 서울 선거 투표용지 부족 사태 수습 명목으로 거취 표명을 미룰 수 있다는 관측도 나온다.)

On this day, Chairman Jang watched the exit polls from three major broadcasters at the party headquarters situation room in Yeouido, Seoul. When the results showed the People Power Party leading in only one of 16 metropolitan and provincial governor races (North Gyeongsang Province), Jang clasped his hands together with a grim expression. In a somber atmosphere, party leadership figures began leaving one by one, and Jang himself departed the situation room after 40 minutes. (장 대표는 이날 서울 여의도 당사 상황실에서 방송 3사 출구조사를 지켜봤다. 시·도지사 16곳 가운데 국민의힘이 1곳(경북)에서만 앞선다는 결과가 발표되자, 장 대표는 침통한 표정으로 두 손을 모았다. 적막한 분위기 속에서 당 지도부 인사들이 하나둘 자리를 떴고, 장 대표도 40분 만에 상황실을 떠났다.)

Even before the vote counting concluded, calls for Chairman Jang’s resignation emerged among People Power Party lawmakers. Han Ki-ho (Gangwon Chuncheon, Cheorwon, Hwacheon, Yanggu-eul), a four-term lawmaker, said, “Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk should resign not only as party leader but also from his parliamentary seat.” A lawmaker from Seoul commented, “It has become clear that a party representing only hardline supporters cannot win nationwide elections.” Another lawmaker from Busan added, “During this election, many candidates were deeply stung by the cold public sentiment that said, ‘Because of Jang Dong-hyuk, I can’t vote for the People Power Party.’” (이날 개표가 끝나기도 전에 국민의힘 의원들 사이에선 장 대표 사퇴 주장이 나왔다. 4선인 한기호(강원 춘천·철원·화천·양구을) 의원은 “장동혁 대표는 당 대표가 아니라 의원직에서 사퇴해야 한다”고 했다. 서울 지역 한 의원은 “강성 지지층만 대변해서는 전국 단위 선거를 치를 수 없다는 점이 명확해졌다”고 했고, 부산 지역의 또 다른 의원도 “이번 선거 과정에서 많은 후보들이 ‘장동혁 때문에 국민의힘은 찍어줄 수 없다’는 차가운 민심에 가슴을 쳤다”고 말했다.)

Floor Leader Song Eon-seok is reportedly expected to soon announce his position, including a potential resignation. If Song steps down, the calls for Jang’s resignation from both within and outside the party are likely to intensify. A People Power Party lawmaker from the former pro-Yoon faction said, “In the process of electing a new floor leader, candidates will inevitably have to differentiate themselves from Chairman Jang. He may want to hold on, but he has reached a point where he can no longer endure.” (송언석 원내대표는 조만간 사퇴까지 포함한 거취 표명에 나설 것으로 전해졌다. 송 원내대표가 물러나면 장 대표를 향한 당 안팎의 사퇴 요구는 거세질 전망이다. 옛 친윤계인 국민의힘 한 의원은 “새 원내대표를 뽑는 과정에서 후보들은 장 대표와의 차별화에 나설 수밖에 없다”며 “장 대표는 버티고 싶겠지만, 더는 버틸 수 없는 지경까지 왔다”고 했다.)

On the other hand, some within the party’s leadership circle suggest that if the party wins in a few close races, Jang might refuse to resign. The ballot shortage in the Seoul election is also expected to become a factor in the fate of the party leadership. In an emergency press conference that day, Jang made no specific remarks about the election results or his own position, only stating, “Based on the findings of the investigation, the Seoul mayoral election must be held again.” (반면 당권파 일각에선 일부 접전지에서 승리한다면 장 대표가 사퇴를 거부할 가능성도 제기되고 있다. 서울 선거 투표용지 부족 사태 또한 국민의힘 지도부 진퇴에 변수로 작용할 전망이다. 장 대표는 이날 긴급 기자회견에서 선거 결과나 본인 거취에 대한 별다른 언급 없이 “진상 파악 결과에 따라서 서울시장 선거는 다시 실시해야만 한다”고 했다.)

]]>

item.title: In Jeonbuk Nomination Controversy, Pro-Chung Lee Won-taek Elected… ‘Green Light’ for Jung Cheong-rae’s Re-election (공천논란 전북서 친청 이원택 당선… 정청래 연임 ‘파란불’)
item.description:
In Jeonbuk Nomination Controversy, Pro-Chung Lee Won-taek Elected… ‘Green Light’ for Jung Cheong-rae’s Re-election (공천논란 전북서 친청 이원택 당선… 정청래 연임 ‘파란불’)

As the Democratic Party of Korea is predicted to win the June 3 local elections, there are forecasts that a green light has been lit for Representative Jung Cheong-rae, who oversaw the elections, to be re-elected as party leader. In particular, in Jeonbuk, a Democratic stronghold that was rocked by nomination issues, pro-Chung candidate Lee Won-taek defeated independent candidate Kim Gwan-young, who was seeking re-election, solidifying Representative Jung’s advantageous position in the race for party leadership. <<> Initially, a sense of crisis surrounded Representative Jung as various opinion polls showed an increasing number of tight races. Early in the election, Representative Jung faced a situation where he could not actively engage in supporting campaigns in the Yeongnam region until the end, having sparked controversy over an "oppa (older brother) title" during a rally in Busan. As a result, he focused entirely on the Seoul metropolitan area, Chungcheong, and South Jeolla. A party official said, “There was an atmosphere where people felt burdened by Representative Jung’s election support, to the point where the phrase ‘Jung Cheong-rae risk’ was circulating.” <<> However, with the actual vote count showing the Democratic Party taking a clear lead in the Seoul metropolitan area and parts of Yeongnam, except for some regions in the 16 provincial and metropolitan mayoral elections, internal trust in the Jung Cheong-rae leadership is expected to deepen further. A ruling party official stated, “This election served both as a mid-term evaluation of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which has been in office for a year, and as a vote of confidence in the Jung Cheong-rae leadership,” adding, “There will be an assessment by party members of Representative Jung, who oversaw the elections.” <<> In particular, with the Democratic Party candidate virtually securing victory in the Jeonbuk gubernatorial election, Representative Jung has been relieved of the heaviest political burden he had been carrying. Earlier, the Jung Cheong-rae leadership expelled incumbent Jeonbuk Governor Kim Gwan-young over the ‘proxy payment controversy’ and then nominated pro-Jung Cheong-rae candidate Lee Won-taek as the Jeonbuk gubernatorial candidate through a primary. Subsequently, candidate Lee Won-taek faced allegations of ‘covering meal expenses,’ but a ‘no charges’ conclusion was reached, sparking a controversy over unfairness. Various opinion polls also showed Lee trailing Kim Gwan-young within the margin of error. However, with Lee’s election confirmed, Representative Jung has once again secured the support of the Jeonbuk public sentiment. A party official said, “Although Representative Jung could not frequently visit Jeonbuk due to local opposition, he mobilized the party’s full force to shift grassroots sentiment,” adding, “Now, momentum for re-election as party leader will accelerate.” <<> Based on this, Representative Jung is expected to challenge for re-election as party leader at the national convention, likely in late August or, at the latest, early September. Potential contenders for the party leadership race include Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, former National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, former leader Song Young-gil, and lawmakers Lee In-young and Kim Yong-min. A key aide to Representative Jung said, “Since this party leader will wield immense power, including control over nominations for the 2028 general election, it will be a fight without any concessions,” and added, “With the election victory, the number of party leadership contenders is expected to increase significantly, but Representative Jung’s strong support among party members suggests he will have the advantage.” In last year’s party leadership election, Representative Jung won the party member vote, significantly defeating then-lawmaker Park Chan-dae, who was backed by the pro-Myung faction. <<> However, the pro-Myung faction, which has been at odds with Representative Jung, is showing a strong determination to win the party leadership race, claiming, “This election is President Lee Jae-myung’s victory, not Jung Cheong-rae’s,” leaving the convention outcome uncertain. A senior pro-Myung lawmaker said, “Even though candidate Lee Won-taek won in Jeonbuk, attention should be paid to the fact that local support for candidate Kim Gwan-young remained high until the end,” adding, “The controversy over nominations in Honam, including Jeonbuk, may persist for a while.” <<> A political insider commented, “Looking at the trends so far, Representative Jung has indeed secured the most advantageous position,” but noted, “However, with over two months remaining until the national convention and factors like the movements of competitors such as Prime Minister Kim Min-seok also being variables, the party leadership race is unlikely to end prematurely.” Prime Minister Kim is known to be preparing to resign from his post immediately after the election and enter the party leadership race. A party official said, “This local election was both an evaluation of the Lee Jae-myung administration and an assessment of the Jung Cheong-rae leadership,” adding, “From Representative Jung’s perspective, it’s clear that a favorable environment for re-election has been created.” <<> (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거에서 승리하는 것으로 예측되면서 선거를 총괄 지휘한 정청래 대표의 당대표 연임에 파란불이 켜졌다는 전망이 나온다. 특히 공천 문제로 시끄러웠던 민주당 텃밭인 전북에서 친청계 이원택 후보가 연임 도전에 나섰던 무소속 김관영 후보를 꺾으면서 정 대표가 당권 경쟁에서 유리한 위치를 확보하게 됐다.)

item.title: Government Stability Argument Prevails, Backed by Stock Market Records… Disorganized Opposition Faces Judgment (증시 신기록 앞세운 국정 안정론 먹혀… 지리멸렬 野가 심판 당해)
item.description:
Government Stability Argument Prevails, Backed by Stock Market Records… Disorganized Opposition Faces Judgment (증시 신기록 앞세운 국정 안정론 먹혀… 지리멸렬 野가 심판 당해)

Analyses suggest that the Democratic Party of Korea secured its victory in the local elections held on the 3rd, marking one year since the inauguration of the Lee Jae-myung administration, because a majority of voters supported the ruling bloc's arguments for "government stability" and "judgment of insurrection." The People Power Party suffered defeat in three consecutive national elections, following the 2024 22nd general election and the 2025 presidential election. Political circles commented that "this is the result of the People Power Party's failure to reform itself even after the 'Yoon Suk Yeol impeachment' incident, coupled with a desire for stability and expectations for the early stages of the new administration's governance." (이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 치러진 3일 지방선거에서 더불어민주당이 승기를 굳힌 것은 여권이 내세운 ‘국정 안정론’과 ‘내란 심판론’에 다수 유권자가 손을 들어줬기 때문이란 분석이다. 국민의힘은 2024년 22대 총선과 2025년 대선에 이어 세 번 연속 전국 선거에서 패배하게 됐다. 정치권에선 “‘윤석열 탄핵’ 사태 이후로도 쇄신없이 지리멸렬한 국민의힘 내부 상황과 정부 출범 초기 국정 운영에 대한 기대감 등이 더해진 결과”라는 이야기가 나왔다.)

The Democratic Party is expected to win not only the metropolitan mayoral elections but also the basic local government head elections. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, Democratic Party candidates were leading in 59.5% (135 out of 227) of basic local government head positions nationwide. In the 2022 local elections, the Democratic Party had only won 63 (27.9%) out of 226 positions nationwide. Public sentiment has reversed completely in four years. (민주당은 광역단체장 선거에 이어 기초단체장 선거에서도 승리할 것으로 보인다. 4일 오전 2시 기준 전국 기초단체장 227명 중 민주당 후보 59.5%(135명)가 우세한 것으로 집계됐다. 민주당은 지난 2022년 지방선거에선 전국 226명 중 63명(27.9%)만 당선됐었다. 4년만에 민심이 뒤바뀐 것이다.)

Notably, in the Seoul district office chief elections for all 25 districts, the Democratic Party was leading in 21 districts as of 2 a.m. on the 4th. This is a complete reversal from the 2022 local elections, where the People Power Party won 17 out of 25 districts. At that time, the People Power Party swept the traditional strongholds of the Gangnam Three Districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa) as well as the riverside districts of the so-called "Han River Belt" including Mapo, Yongsan, Dongjak, Yeongdeungpo, and Gwangjin. However, in this election, the Democratic Party gained the upper hand in most areas of Seoul. (특히 서울 25개 구청장 선거에서도 민주당은 4일 2시 기준 21곳에서 앞서고 있다. 2022년 지방선거 때 국민의힘이 25곳 중 17곳에서 승리했던 것과 정반대 결과인 것이다. 당시 국민의힘은 전통적 텃밭인 강남 3구(강남·서초·송파)와 함께 ‘한강 벨트’로 불리는 마포·용산·동작·영등포·광진 등 한강변 지역구를 싹쓸이했다. 하지만 이번 선거에선 민주당이 서울 대부분 지역에서 승기를 잡았다.)

Experts analyzed the Democratic Party's victory as a result of President Lee's approval rating maintaining around 60%, which allowed the "government stability" argument to operate advantageously. The Democratic Party has recently highlighted the stock market's strong rally as an achievement of the current administration, appealing to voters to "strengthen the driving force of the Lee Jae-myung administration's governance." (전문가들은 이날 민주당 승리를 두고 이 대통령의 국정 지지율이 60% 안팎을 유지하면서 ‘정부 안정론’이 우세하게 작동한 데 따른 결과라고 분석했다. 민주당은 최근 고공 행진 중인 주식 시장을 현 정부 성과로 내세우면서 “이재명 정부의 국정 동력에 힘을 실어달라”고 호소해 왔다.)

Issues such as the government's real estate policies, the special counsel bill for "fabricated indictment" that leaves open the possibility of withdrawing the indictment in President Lee's case, and the administration-level boycott of Starbucks, highlighting the ruling party's unilateral approach to governance, emerged as election issues. This led to an increase in closely contested areas and a consolidation of the conservative support base. Additionally, the "three highs" (high prices, high exchange rates, high interest rates) emerged as negative factors for the ruling party. However, political insiders analyzed that "the heightened security and economic instability caused by the Middle East war, along with the ongoing internal strife within the People Power Party, which should have presented alternatives, strengthened the 'government stability' argument and suppressed the opposition's 'government checks' narrative." (정부의 부동산 정책과 이 대통령 사건의 공소 취소 가능성을 열어둔 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법, 정권 차원의 스타벅스 불매 운동 등 집권 여당의 일방적 국정 운영 방식이 선거 쟁점으로 부각하면서 접전지가 늘고 보수 지지층이 결집하는 흐름도 감지됐다. 이와 함께 고물가·고환율·고금리 등 ‘3고(高)’도 여당으로선 악재로 떠올랐다. 하지만 정치권 관계자들은 “중동 전쟁 등으로 야기된 안보·경제 불안 고조와 함께 대안을 제시해야 할 국민의힘의 지속된 내분이 ‘국정 안정론’을 강화해 야당의 ‘정부 견제론’을 누른 것”이라고 분석했다.)

Observers also point out that while the Democratic Party placed "judgment on insurrection forces" at the forefront of its election campaign, the People Power Party repeatedly exposed internal divisions, contributing to its own decline in approval ratings. The People Power Party failed to stabilize itself after the December 3 martial law declaration and the impeachment of former President Yoon, with ongoing internal conflicts involving factions aligned with Yoon and Han, ousting of internal opponents, and infighting surrounding the party leader. Subsequent events, including the nominations fiasco for Daegu and North Chungcheong Province governors and the unprecedented withdrawal of the candidate nomination for the Siheung City mayor, led to further defections from its support base. (민주당이 ‘내란 세력 심판’을 선거 캠페인 전면에 내세운 반면, 국민의힘은 거듭된 내부 분란을 노출해 지지율 하락을 자초했다는 지적도 나온다. 국민의힘은 작년 12·3 계엄과 윤 전 대통령 탄핵 이후 당을 수습하지 못하고 친윤·친한 계파 갈등과 당내 반대파 축출 등 당 대표를 둘러싼 내홍이 계속됐다. 이후 이어진 대구·충북지사 공천 파동과 사상 초유의 경기도 시흥시장 후보 공천 포기 등도 지지층 추가 이탈로 이어졌다.)

As the People Power Party's approval rating fell to an all-time low (15%), raising crisis alarms, voices within the party grew louder demanding Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk's resignation. However, Jang refused, stating it would be "inconsistent with responsible politics." (국민의힘 지지율이 창당 이후 최저(15%)로 떨어지며 위기감이 커지자 당내에선 장동혁 대표에게 사퇴를 요구하는 목소리가 커졌다. 그러나 장 대표는 “책임 정치와 맞지 않는다”며 거부했다.)

Kang Won-taek, director of Seoul National University's Institute for Future Strategy, stated, "The People Power Party failed to properly take responsibility for the martial law and impeachment crisis, nor did it present a new vision on future growth engines or youth employment. The election results largely reflect voters' judgment on these failures." Shin Yul, a professor at Myongji University, said, "Rather than voters punishing the ruling party's arrogance, they delivered a harsher judgment on the People Power Party, which, lacking alternatives, was mired in internal strife." (강원택 서울대 국가미래전략원장은 “국민의힘은 계엄 및 탄핵 사태에 제대로 책임지는 모습을 보이지 않은 데다 미래 먹거리, 청년 일자리 등에 대한 새로운 비전을 내놓지도 못했다”며 “이에 대한 유권자들 심판 성격이 크다”고 했다. 신율 명지대 교수는 “유권자들이 거대 여당의 오만함에 회초리를 들기보다는 ‘대안 부재’ 상태에서 내분에 휩싸인 국민의힘에 더 엄중한 심판을 내린 것”이라고 했다.)

As this election was held under the "big ruling party, small opposition" structure where the Democratic Party holds a majority in the National Assembly, the Lee Jae-myung administration is likely to seize local power in addition to its legislative and executive powers by winning the local elections. Consequently, the Lee Jae-myung administration, entering its second year, is expected to see a significant boost in its governance momentum and President Lee's control over the party. (민주당이 국회 과반 의석을 쥔 여대야소(與大野小) 구도에서 치러진 이번 선거를 통해 이재명 정권은 입법·행정 권력에 이어 지방 권력까지 장악할 가능성이 커졌다. 이에 따라 집권 2년 차를 맞은 이재명 정부의 국정 운영 동력과 함께 이 대통령의 당 장악력도 대폭 강화될 것으로 보인다.)

Conversely, the People Power Party is expected to face immense pressure for sweeping political restructuring, including personnel shakeups. The party's reputation of being confined to the "Yeongnam region party" is also expected to solidify. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, the People Power Party was leading in its traditional stronghold of Yeongnam region in the metropolitan mayoral elections for Daegu, North Gyeongsang Province, and South Gyeongsang Province. (반면 국민의힘은 인적 쇄신 등 대대적인 정계 개편 압박에 직면할 것이란 전망이다. 국민의힘은 ‘영남당’에 갇혔다는 평가도 더 굳어질 전망이다. 4일 2시 기준 국민의힘은 ‘텃밭’인 영남권 광역단체장 선거 중 대구, 경북, 경남에서 앞서고 있다.)
