item.title: People Power Party: "Violation of Suffrage, Seoul Election Invalid"... Democratic Party: "No Vote Counting Halt or Re-election" (국힘 “참정권 침해, 서울 선거 무효”… 민주 “개표중단·재투표 없다”)
item.description:
People Power Party: "Violation of Suffrage, Seoul Election Invalid"... Democratic Party: "No Vote Counting Halt or Re-election" (국힘 “참정권 침해, 서울 선거 무효”… 민주 “개표중단·재투표 없다”)

The unprecedented shortage of ballot papers occurred most frequently in Seoul, the biggest battleground of the June 3 local elections. The People Power Party stated that among the 17 locations identified as having ballot paper shortages, 14 were in Seoul. (사상 초유의 투표 용지 부족 사태는 6·3 지방선거의 최대 승부처인 서울에서 가장 많이 발생했다. 국민의힘은 투표 용지 부족 사태가 있었던 것으로 파악된 17곳 중 14곳이 서울이라고 했다.)

Among them, at the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, voting was delayed and continued until 10 PM that night. Voting took place while vote counting had already begun in other parts of Seoul and election broadcasts were airing. When the National Election Commission attempted to retrieve the ballot box from this polling station, a standoff occurred between citizens protesting and blocking the move and police and election commission staff. This incident also delayed vote counting in Seoul; as of 2 AM on the 4th, the vote counting rate for the Seoul mayoral election was 43.75%. (그중 서울 송파구 잠실7동 제2투표소에서는 투표 지연으로 이날 밤 10시까지 투표가 진행됐다. 서울 다른 지역에서 개표가 시작돼 개표 방송이 나오는 상황에서 투표가 이뤄진 것이다. 선거관리위원회가 이곳 투표소의 투표함을 반출하려 하자, 항의·저지하는 시민과 경찰·선관위 직원들의 대치 상황도 일어났다. 이번 사태로 서울 지역 개표도 늦어져 4일 2시 기준 서울시장 선거 개표율은 43.75%였다.)

While voters in delayed polling stations were waiting to vote, the exit poll results from three major broadcasters were announced. Separately from the voting delay, the election commission also began counting votes in areas where voting had been completed. This means some voters cast their ballots aware of the exit polls and the vote counting situation. In the count as of 2 AM on the 4th, Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh received 55.59%, while People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon received 41.75%. (투표가 지연된 곳의 유권자가 투표를 대기하던 중, 방송 3사 출구 조사 결과가 발표됐다. 선관위는 투표 지연 사태와 별도로 투표 완료 지역의 개표도 시작했다. 투표 전 출구 조사와 개표 상황을 알고 투표한 유권자가 있었다는 얘기다. 4일 2시 기준 개표에서 더불어민주당 정원오 후보가 55.59%, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보는 41.75%를 얻었다.)

The People Power Party called for halting the vote counting in Seoul and holding a re-election. Candidate Oh Se-hoon also stated, "The vote counting should be halted until prior measures for areas where voting was not possible are completed." In response, the Democratic Party countered, "Calls to stop counting votes or hold a re-election are utterly groundless." (국민의힘은 서울 개표 중단과 재선거를 주장했다. 오세훈 후보도 “투표를 못 한 지역에 대한 선 조치가 완료되기 전까지 개표는 중단돼야 한다”고 했다. 반면 더불어민주당은 “개표 중단, 재투표는 일고의 가치가 없다”고 맞섰다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk held an emergency press conference around 9:30 PM that day and said, "This Seoul election is one where voters' right to vote and political rights have been seriously violated," adding, "The contaminated Seoul election is invalid. Vote counting should be stopped immediately, and based on the findings of the investigation, the Seoul election must be held again." Floor leader Song Eon-seok joined the call to halt counting and demanded, "Postpone the election in accordance with Article 196 of the Public Official Election Act." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 이날 오후 9시 30분쯤 긴급 회견을 열고 “이번 서울 투표는 유권자의 투표권과 참정권이 심각하게 침해된 선거”라며 “오염된 서울시 선거는 무효다. 즉시 개표를 중단하고, 진상 파악 결과에 따라 서울시 선거는 다시 해야 한다”고 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 개표 중단 요구와 함께 “공직선거법 196조에 의거해 선거를 연기하라”고 했다.)

Senior Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook stated, "This could lead to a constitutional complaint." Lawmaker Joo Jin-woo said, "All election commission members deserve impeachment. Resign immediately." The leadership of the People Power Party visited the National Election Commission and engaged in a physical altercation while demanding a meeting with NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak. (신동욱 최고위원은 “헌법 소원으로 이어질 수 있는 문제”라고 했다. 주진우 의원은 “선관위원 전원이 탄핵감이다. 즉각 사퇴하라”고 했다. 국민의힘 지도부는 중앙선관위를 찾아 노태악 중앙선관위원장과의 면담을 요구하며 몸싸움을 벌였다.)

According to the People Power Party's Seoul chapter's own assessment, the ballot paper shortage occurred in five districts (gu) of Seoul: Songpa, Gangnam, Seocho, Dongjak, and Gwangjin. Many of the polling stations affected by this incident are known to be in areas with strong conservative tendencies. In particular, Songpa-gu, which has the largest population among Seoul's 25 districts (650,000 people), saw the most incidents at its polling stations. Bae Hyun-jin, chairperson of the Seoul chapter, said in a phone call, "Many voters who took waiting numbers and waited even tore up their ballot papers and went home." (국민의힘 서울시당의 자체 파악에 따르면, 이번 투표 용지 부족 사태는 서울 송파·강남·서초·동작·광진 등 5구(區)에서 발생했다. 이번 사태가 일어난 투표소들 상당수는 보수세가 강한 것으로 알려진 지역이다. 특히 서울 25구 중 최다 인구(65만명)인 송파구의 투표소들에서 이번 사태가 가장 많이 벌어졌다. 배현진 서울시당위원장은 통화에서 “대기표를 받고 기다리다 투표 용지를 찢고 돌아가는 유권자들도 많았다”고 했다.)

Candidate Oh Se-hoon previously won the 2010 Seoul mayoral election by a narrow margin of 0.6 percentage points over Democratic Party candidate Han Myeong-sook, boosted by support from the three affluent southern districts of Gangnam. For this reason, Oh's campaign urged citizens waiting to vote that day to "please make sure to vote," and told the election commission, "This is a strong warning. Mobilize all means to ensure citizens can vote immediately." (오세훈 후보는 지난 2010년 서울시장 선거에서 강남 3구의 표심에 힘입어 민주당 한명숙 후보에게 0.6%p(포인트) 차로 신승한 적이 있다. 이 때문에 오 후보 캠프는 이날 투표 대기를 하는 시민들을 향해 “투표를 꼭 해달라”고 했고, 선관위엔 “강력 경고한다. 모든 수단을 총동원해 즉각 시민이 투표할 수 있게 하라”고 했다.)

As voting delays continued in various parts of Seoul until late that night, the three broadcasters' exit poll results were released at 6 PM, predicting 51.4% for candidate Jeong Won-oh and 46% for candidate Oh Se-hoon. The election commission maintained that releasing the results was fine since the survey targeted only certain areas. However, Oh's campaign and Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok argued that day, "If people who have already seen the exit polls voted for several hours, that's a problem," and demanded, "The counting process should be stopped." (서울 곳곳에서 투표 지연이 이날 밤까지 이어지던 가운데, 오후 6시에 정원오 후보 51.4%, 오세훈 후보 46%로 예측된다는 방송 3사 출구 조사 결과가 발표됐다. 선관위는 일부 지역을 대상으로 한 조사라 발표해도 문제없다는 입장이다. 그러나 오 후보 캠프와 개혁신당 이준석 대표는 이날 “출구 조사를 이미 본 사람들이 몇 시간씩 투표했다면 문제가 있다”며 “개표 절차를 중지해야 한다”고 했다.)

In contrast, Democratic Party Secretary General Jo Seung-rae stated, "The People Power Party's calls to halt vote counting and hold a re-election are utterly groundless." He added, "Many Seoul citizens not affected by the ballot paper shortage have already voted and the process has ended; vote counting is proceeding through proper procedures, so there is no need to stop it." (반면, 민주당 조승래 사무총장은 “국민의힘이 주장하는 개표 중단과 재투표 요구는 일고의 가치가 없다”고 했다. 그는 “투표 용지 부족 문제와 관계없는 많은 서울 시민이 투표해 마감됐고, 절차를 거쳐 개표가 진행 중이라 중단할 필요가 없다”고 했다.)

Nevertheless, there are claims that the unprecedented ballot paper shortage and voting delays are bound to impact the results of the Seoul mayoral and superintendent of education elections. In particular, it is expected to spark serious controversy over the procedural legitimacy of the election results. This incident could also lead to confusion in elections for district mayors, Seoul city councilors, and district councilors in the five affected districts of Seoul. In races such as district mayor elections, outcomes are often decided by margins of hundreds or thousands of votes. For example, in the 2022 local elections in Gwangjin-gu, the district mayor race was decided by 3,747 votes, a city councilor in the first district by 333 votes, and a district councilor in the first constituency (where three are elected) by 171 votes. (그러나 초유의 투표 용지 부족, 투표 지연 사태는 서울시장·교육감 선거 결과에 영향을 미칠 수밖에 없다는 말이 나온다. 특히 선거 결과를 두고 절차적 정당성 등 심각한 논란을 불러일으킬 것으로 예상된다. 이번 사태가 일어난 서울 5구의 구청장, 서울시의원, 구의원 선거에서도 혼란이 이어질 수 있다. 구청장 등 선거는 천·백 단위 표차로 당락이 결정되기도 한다. 예컨대 지난 2022년 지방선거에서 광진구의 경우 구청장은 3747표, 1선거구 시의원은 333표, 가선거구 구의원(3명 선출)은 171표 차이로 당락이 결정됐다.)

item.title: Following the “basket ballot” controversy… Election Commission only printed ballots for 50% of Songpa voters (소쿠리 투표 이어… 선관위, 송파 유권자의 50%만 용지 인쇄)
item.description:
Following the “basket ballot” controversy… Election Commission only printed ballots for 50% of Songpa voters (소쿠리 투표 이어… 선관위, 송파 유권자의 50%만 용지 인쇄)

Heo Cheol-hoon, Secretary-General of the National Election Commission, apologized on the 3rd for the suspension and delays in voting due to a shortage of ballot papers at some polling stations in Seoul, stating, “I deeply feel responsible for undermining public trust in fair election management and offer my sincere apology.” Appearing in a public apology at 9 p.m. that day, Secretary-General Heo said, “We are taking the matter seriously” and “We will identify the causes and problems to establish measures to prevent recurrence.” (허철훈 중앙선거관리위원회 사무총장은 3일 서울 일부 투표소에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표가 중단·지연되는 사태가 벌어진 데 대해 “공정한 선거 관리에 대한 국민의 신뢰를 훼손한 점에 대해 책임을 통감하며 깊이 사과드린다”고 했다. 이날 밤 9시 대국민 사과에 나선 허 사무총장은 “사안을 엄중히 인식하고 있다”며 “원인과 문제점을 파악해 재발 방지 대책을 마련하겠다”고 했다.)

The Election Commission explained that the ballot shortage occurred because more voters than expected participated, adding, “In the case of Songpa District, it was found that ballots were printed for about 50% of the total number of voters.” The Commission convened an emergency meeting at midnight on the 4th to discuss these issues. (선관위는 예상보다 많은 유권자가 투표에 참여해 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생했다며 “송파구의 경우 전체 유권자 수의 50%(정도 투표용지를) 인쇄한 것으로 파악했다”고 했다. 선관위는 이런 문제들을 논의하기 위해 4일 0시 긴급위원회를 소집했다.)

However, critics argue that the ballot shortage issue cannot be resolved simply with an apology. Under current election laws, objections to the validity of an election can be raised not only by the political parties that nominated candidates or the candidates themselves, but also by general voters. This means any voter in Seoul, not just the People Power Party or Seoul Mayor candidate Oh Se-hoon, can file a lawsuit challenging the election’s validity. (그러나 투표용지 부족 사태는 ‘사과’로 마무리될 문제가 아니라는 지적이 나온다. 현행 선거법에 따르면, 선거의 효력에 대한 이의 제기는 후보자를 낸 정당이나 후보자 본인만이 아니라 일반 선거인도 할 수 있다. 국민의힘이나 오세훈 서울시장 후보가 아니라, 서울 유권자 중 누구라도 선거의 효력을 다투는 소송을 제기할 수 있는 것이다.)

At some polling stations where the ballot shortage occurred, controversy also arose over the Election Commission delivering ballots in ziplock bags or shopping bags. During the 2022 presidential election, the Commission faced criticism for what was termed “basket ballot” voting, as it transported advance voting ballots for COVID-19 patients and those in isolation in simple containers. The practice of election officials placing marked ballots into ballot boxes on behalf of infected voters, rather than allowing voters to do so themselves, also sparked legal disputes. In last year’s presidential election, it was revealed that voters at a polling station in Seoul received ballots, left to eat due to long lines, and then returned, leading to an apology from the Commission. (이날 투표 용지 부족 사태가 벌어진 일부 투표소에서는 선관위 측이 투표 용지를 지퍼백이나 쇼핑백에 담아 왔다는 논란도 일었다. 2022년 대선에서도 선관위는 코로나19 확진자·격리자의 사전투표 용지를 간이 용기에 담아 나르면서 이른바 ‘소쿠리 투표’라는 비판을 받았다. 확진자가 기표한 투표지를 투표함에 직접 넣지 못하고 선관위 담당자들이 넣는 방식도 위법 논란을 일으켰다. 지난해 대선에서는 서울 한 투표소에 줄을 선 유권자들이 줄이 길다는 이유로 투표용지를 받은 채 식사하고 돌아온 것으로 드러나 선관위가 사과하는 일이 벌어졌다.)

Although not directly related to election management, from 2023 onward, high-ranking Election Commission officials were found to have illegally hired their children and relatives, causing public controversy. In 2022, the Secretary-General of the Election Commission was found to have used an anonymous mobile phone to contact politicians ahead of the presidential and local elections, sparking debates over impartiality. (선거 관리와 직접적 연관은 없으나 2023년부터는 선관위 고위 간부들이 자녀와 친인척을 선관위에 부정 채용한 것으로 잇따라 드러나 물의를 빚었다. 2022년에는 선관위 사무총장이 대선과 지선을 앞둔 시점에 익명으로 휴대전화를 개통해 정치인들과 연락을 주고받은 것으로 드러나 공정성 논란을 일으켰다.)

In Germany, during elections held in Berlin on September 26, 2021, serious flaws such as ballot shortages and incorrect ballot distribution were discovered, leading to lawsuits that nullified the election and triggered a rerun. This resulted in changes to the mayor’s position and the number of parliamentary seats for each party. (독일에서는 2021년 9월 26일 수도 베를린에서 치러진 선거에서 투표용지 부족과 잘못된 투표용지 배부 등 심각한 결함이 발견돼, 소송을 통해 선거가 무효화되고 재선거가 치러지는 일이 벌어졌다. 이로 인해 시장과 각 당의 국회 의석 수까지 바뀌었다.)

At that time, Berlin simultaneously held federal, local, and referendum votes. Due to the Berlin State Election Commission’s poor preparation, there were shortages of voting booths, causing voters to wait for hours outside polling stations or receive ballots listing candidates unrelated to their electoral district. (당시 베를린에서는 총선과 지방선거 투표, 주민 투표가 한꺼번에 진행됐다. 그런데 베를린주 선관위의 준비 부실로 기표소가 부족해 몇 시간씩 투표소 밖에서 기다리거나, 자기 선거구와 무관한 후보자가 적힌 투표용지를 배부받는 일이 벌어졌다.)

As in the Seoul city election, ballot shortages led to voting suspensions. When voting resumed at these polling stations, it extended beyond the statutory closing time of 6 p.m., meaning some voters cast their ballots after exit poll results had been reported. (서울시 선거에서처럼 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단되는 일도 있었다. 이런 투표소에서 다시 투표를 재개하면서 법정 투표 종료 시각인 오후 6시를 넘겨, 일부 유권자는 출구조사 결과가 보도된 상황에서 투표했다.)

Opposition parties challenged the election results, and the Berlin State Constitutional Court ruled the entire elections for city and district councilors invalid. The court stated, “Voters were left uncertain about when polling stations would reopen, and it is impossible to determine how many voters simply went home” and added, “In some districts, a difference of just over 100 votes could have been enough to change seat allocations.” The Federal Constitutional Court also invalidated the results of the federal election in 455 out of Berlin’s 2,256 electoral districts. (야당들이 선거 결과에 이의를 제기했고, 베를린주 헌법재판소는 시의원·구의원 선거 전체가 무효라고 판단했다. 베를린주 헌재는 “유권자들은 투표소가 언제 다시 문을 열지 알 수 없는 상황이었고, 집으로 돌아가 버린 유권자가 몇 명인지 파악하는 것은 불가능하다”면서 “일부 선거구에서는 100여 표만 다르게 집계됐더라도 의석 배분을 바꾸기에 충분했을 것”이라고 했다. 연방헌법재판소도 베를린 2256개 선거구 가운데 455개 선거구의 총선 결과를 무효화했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon in Busan North Gap, Yoo Ui-dong in Pyeongtaek-eul Elected (부산 북갑 한동훈, 평택을 유의동 당선)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon in Busan North Gap, Yoo Ui-dong in Pyeongtaek-eul Elected (부산 북갑 한동훈, 평택을 유의동 당선)

The Democratic Party of Korea struggled in the 14 by-elections and re-elections for National Assembly seats held concurrently with local elections on the 3rd. Of the 14 districts, 13 were previously held by Democratic Party lawmakers, but as of 2 a.m. on the 4th, only about 8 were confirmed as wins for Democratic Party candidates. (더불어민주당은 3일 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 14곳의 국회의원 재·보궐선거에서 고전했다. 14곳 중 13곳이 민주당 의원 지역구였는데, 4일 새벽 2시 현재 민주당 후보 당선이 확실시되는 곳은 8곳 정도였다.)

The Democratic Party secured victories in Gwangju Gwangsan-eul (candidate Im Moon-young), Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-eul (candidate Park Ji-won), and Jeju Seogwipo (candidate Kim Seong-beom). Districts where wins were likely included five areas: Incheon Yeonsu-gap (candidate Song Young-gil), Incheon Gyeyang-eul (candidate Kim Nam-jun), Gyeonggi Ansan-gap (candidate Kim Nam-guk), Gyeonggi Hanam-gap (candidate Lee Gwang-jae), and Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-gap (candidate Kim Ui-gyeom). In Chungnam Asan-eul, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Eun-su failed to secure a victory. (민주당은 광주 광산을(임문영 후보), 전북 군산·김제·부안을(박지원 후보), 제주 서귀포(김성범 후보)에서 당선을 확정했다. 당선이 유력한 곳은 인천 연수갑(송영길 후보), 인천 계양을(김남준 후보), 경기 안산갑(김남국 후보), 경기 하남갑(이광재 후보), 전북 군산·김제·부안갑(김의겸 후보) 등 5곳이었다. 충남 아산을에서는 민주당 전은수 후보가 승리를 확정 짓지 못했다.)

In contrast, the People Power Party confirmed wins for candidate Yoo Ui-dong (Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul) and candidate Lee Jin-sook (Daegu Dalseong). Independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who ran in the Busan North Gap by-election, was also elected. Yoo secured a fourth term, while Han, who had no prior experience as a lawmaker, entered the National Assembly for the first time. (반면, 국민의힘에서는 유의동(경기 평택을) 후보, 이진숙(대구 달성) 후보가 당선을 확정했다. 부산 북갑 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보도 당선됐다. 유 후보는 4선에 성공하게 됐고 국회의원 경력이 없던 한 후보는 원내에 처음으로 입성하게 됐다.)

In Ulsan Nam-gap, also a Democratic Party stronghold, Democratic candidate Jeon Tae-jin and People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-gyu were in a tight race, as were Democratic candidate Kim Young-bin and People Power Party candidate Yun Yong-geun in Chungnam Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang. Except for Daegu Dalseong, all districts were previously held by Democratic Party lawmakers. (역시 민주당 의원 지역구였던 울산 남갑에서는 민주당 전태진 후보와 국민의힘 김태규 후보가, 충남 공주·부여·청양에서는 민주당 김영빈 후보와 국민의힘 윤용근 후보가 접전을 펼쳤다. 대구 달성을 빼고 모두 민주당 의원 지역구였다.)

item.title: Election Commission: "Ballot Paper Shortage Not Grounds for Re-election... Vote Counting Cannot Be Stopped" (선관위 “투표용지 부족 사태, 재선거 사유 아냐... 개표 중단 불가”)
item.description:
Election Commission: "Ballot Paper Shortage Not Grounds for Re-election... Vote Counting Cannot Be Stopped" (선관위 “투표용지 부족 사태, 재선거 사유 아냐... 개표 중단 불가”)

The National Election Commission (NEC) stated that the suspension of voting in some polling stations in the Seoul metropolitan area on the main voting day of the June 3 local elections due to a shortage of ballot papers does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or holding a re-election. The NEC added that "it is also impossible to halt the ongoing vote counting." (6·3 지방선거 본투표 당일 수도권 일부 투표함에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표가 중단된 것은 선거 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다는 중앙선거관리위원회 입장이 나왔다. 선관위는 “현재 진행 중인 개표를 중단하는 것도 불가능하다”고 했다.)

The NEC made this announcement in a statement released after holding an emergency meeting early on the 4th, chaired by NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak. (선관위는 4일 새벽 노태악 중앙선관위원장 주재로 긴급위원회를 연 뒤 낸 입장에서 이같이 밝혔다.)

"We deeply apologize for causing great confusion and inconvenience to the citizens who visited polling stations on the 3rd due to a shortage of ballot papers at some polling stations," the NEC said. "We feel a profound sense of responsibility for causing great disappointment and concern to voters who visited the polling stations." (선관위는 “지난 3일 일부 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족해 해당 투표소에 방문한 국민 여러분의 참정권 행사에 많은 혼란과 불편을 드려 깊이 사과드린다”면서 “투표소를 방문하신 유권자에게 큰 실망과 염려를 끼쳐 드리게 되어 크나큰 책임을 통감한다”고 했다.)

The NEC further stated, "This matter does not constitute grounds for postponing the election or a re-election under the Public Official Election Act," adding, "Therefore, it is impossible to stop the ongoing vote counting." It added, "To ensure the intentions of voters who voted at the affected polling stations can be identified, the ballot boxes should be transported to the counting centers." (선관위는 그러면서도 “이번 사안은 공직선거법에 따른 선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다”면서 “따라서 현재 진행되는 개표를 중단하는 것은 불가하다”고 했다. 이어 “해당 투표소에서 투표한 유권자의 의사를 확인할 수 있도록 투표함은 개표소로 이송되어야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

The NEC stated, "When the vote counting is complete, the National Election Commission has decided to immediately make the best possible efforts to investigate the truth of this matter and prepare measures to prevent recurrence." (선관위는 “개표가 종료되면 중앙선거관리위원회는 즉시 이번 사안에 대한 진상 규명 및 재발방지 대책을 마련하기 위해 가능한 최선의 노력을 다 하기로 결정했다”고 했다.)

The previous day, an unprecedented situation occurred where voting was suspended at at least 14 polling stations in locations such as Songpa-gu and Gangnam-gu in Seoul due to a shortage of ballot papers. In some areas, voters waited for two to three hours, and some gave up voting and went home. In response, the People Power Party visited the NEC to protest and demanded that the vote counting be halted until the facts of the matter were clarified. (전날 서울 송파구·강남구 등에 위치한 투표소 최소 14곳에서 투표용지 부족으로 투표가 중단되는 초유의 사태가 발생했다. 일부 지역에선 유권자들이 2~3시간씩 대기했고, 일부는 투표를 포기하고 귀가하기도 했다. 이에 국민의힘은 선관위를 항의 방문하고 관련 진상이 파악될 때까지 개표 중단을 요구해왔다.)

In the case of the 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, where voting hours had been extended until 10 p.m. the previous day, the ballot box had not been moved to the counting center as of 4 a.m. on the 4th due to protests from citizens even after voting ended. An NEC official said, "The ballot box for the 2nd polling station in Jamsil 7-dong will not be forcibly transported until the counting of other ballot boxes is completed." (투표 시간이 전날 오후 10시까지 연장됐던 서울 송파구 잠실7동 제2투표소의 경우 투표 종료 뒤에도 시민들의 항의로 4일 새벽 4시 현재까지 투표함을 개표소로 이동하지 못하고 있다. 선관위 관계자는 “잠실7동 제2투표소의 투표함은 다른 투표함의 개표가 완료될 때까지 이송을 강행하지 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who was visiting the NEC to protest, met with reporters immediately after the NEC's statement was released and said, "This is an election that cannot be recognized. Citizens' right to vote has been violated, and this is a seriously tainted election." He added, "We express strong regret over the NEC's decision. We will fight to the end alongside the people." (한편 선관위를 항의 방문 중이던 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 선관위 입장이 발표된 직후 기자들과 만나 “이번 선거는 인정할 수 없는 선거다. 국민 참정권이 침해됐고 심각하게 오염된 선거”라면서 “선관위 결정에 강력한 유감을 표한다.국민들과 함께 끝까지 싸우겠다”고 했다.)

]]>

item.title: U.S. Secretary of State: "South Korea's Attitude Toward Our Companies Affects Trade Agreement" (美국무 “우리 기업에 대한 한국 태도 때문에 무역 합의 영향”)
item.description:
U.S. Secretary of State: "South Korea's Attitude Toward Our Companies Affects Trade Agreement" (美국무 “우리 기업에 대한 한국 태도 때문에 무역 합의 영향”)

Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on the 3rd that certain attitudes of the South Korean government toward U.S. companies operating in South Korea are causing disruptions to the Korea-U.S. trade agreement. Although the two countries announced a trade agreement in November last year, it took until early this month—six months later—to form a working group and hold a "kickoff meeting," with the Coupang personal information leak incident in the process negatively impacting the implementation of bilateral trade and security agreements. Regarding claims that the Lee Jae-myung administration has become pro-China and left-leaning, Rubio said, "That's a feature of democracy," adding, "Sometimes they elect leaders more friendly to us, like Japan." Such remarks reflect the perception that Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is more friendly toward the U.S. than President Lee Jae-myung, despite both being Indo-Pacific allies. <<> Rubio responded to a question from Republican Representative Darrell Issa, who noted during his appearance before the House Foreign Affairs Committee that day, "The South Korean government has taken a strong left-leaning stance, expanded ties with China more, and begun to suppress many of our companies like Meta (Facebook) and Coupang." In U.S. political circles, a narrative is gaining traction that regulations on U.S. tech companies, including Coupang, only benefit Chinese companies. Rubio acknowledged, "The companies you mentioned are not only facing difficulties in South Korea," but added, "Unfair measures targeting tech companies have become a major issue in relations with South Korea. We have clearly raised these issues, and I believe South Korea's attitude toward U.S. companies is causing disruptions to the trade agreement." <<> The fact sheet jointly announced by the U.S. and South Korea last year covers items such as South Korea's introduction of nuclear-powered submarines, reprocessing of spent nuclear fuel, and expansion of uranium enrichment authority. Although the National Security Office and Ministry of Foreign Affairs led the formation of a task force for follow-up measures, the Coupang incident worsened public opinion in U.S. political circles, resulting in minimal progress. It took seven months after the fact sheet's announcement for U.S. State Department Assistant Secretary for Political Affairs Allison Hooker to visit South Korea from the 1st to the 3rd, leading a cross-agency delegation for the first working-level discussions. In April, about 50 members of the Republican Study Committee (RSC), including Issa, sent a letter to South Korean Ambassador to the U.S. Kang Kyung-wha, demanding "an immediate halt to attacks targeting U.S. companies like Coupang." The fact sheet states that there will be no disadvantages or discrimination against U.S. tech companies. <<> On the 1st, the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) published a co-authored article by Nicholas Eberstadt of the conservative think tank in Washington, D.C., and Lawrence Peck, an advisor to the Free North Korea Coalition, titled "South Korea Switches to Hard Left Line on the U.S." Issa, who has strongly opposed South Korea's online platform regulations, requested that this column be included in the meeting record that day. Regarding the claim that South Korea has become "pro-China and left-leaning," Rubio said, "This is a unique aspect of dealing with democratic countries," adding, "Sometimes they elect leaders more favorable to U.S. interests, as in the case of Japan; sometimes they elect leaders with different perspectives. If a legitimate election was held and they are the ones chosen, we respect the sovereign choice of that country's people." (마코 루비오 국무장관은 3일 한국 내 사업을 영위하는 미국 기업에 대한 한국 정부의 일부 태도 때문에 한미 간 무역 협정이 차질을 빚고 있다고 했다. 한미는 지난해 11월 무역 합의를 발표했지만 반년이 지난 이달 초에서야 실무 그룹을 꾸려 ‘킥오프 회의’를 가졌는데, 이 과정에서 벌어진 쿠팡의 개인정보 유출 사건이 양국 간 통상·안보 합의 이행에도 부정적인 영향을 미쳤다는 것이다. 루비오는 이재명 정부가 친중(親中) 성향에 좌경화됐다는 주장에는 “그게 민주주의의 특징”이라며 “일본처럼 우호적인 지도자를 뽑기도 한다”고 했다. 이런 발언에는 같은 인도·태평양 우방임에도 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리가 이재명 대통령보다 미국에 우호적이라는 인식이 깔려 있다.)

]]>

item.title: ‘Ballot Paper Shortage’ Rare Even in the US… Lawsuits Mount and Conspiracy Theories Flourish (美서도 드문 ‘투표용지 부족’… 소송 줄잇고 음모론 기승)
item.description:
‘Ballot Paper Shortage’ Rare Even in the US… Lawsuits Mount and Conspiracy Theories Flourish (美서도 드문 ‘투표용지 부족’… 소송 줄잇고 음모론 기승)

U.S. Deputy Secretary of State for Political Affairs Alison Hooker, who visited South Korea from the 1st to the 3rd, stated on X (formerly Twitter) on the 3rd after meeting with Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, “I reflected with Minister Cho on the importance of preserving our vibrant democracy.” Hooker noted that the day was South Korea’s local election day, saying, “It’s especially relevant because today is South Korea’s election day.” Coincidentally, an unprecedented incident occurred where voting was suspended at some polling stations in Seoul’s Songpa and Gwangjin districts due to a shortage of prepared ballots. A ‘ballot paper shortage’—where voters cannot exercise their suffrage and must wait for long periods or return home—is even rare in U.S. elections. (1~3일 한국을 방문한 앨리슨 후커 미 국무부 정무 담당 차관은 조현 외교부 장관과 만난 뒤 3일 X(옛 트위터)에 “조 장관과 우리의 활기찬 민주주의를 보존하는 중요성에 대해 성찰했다”고 밝혔다. 후커는 한국의 지방선거가 치러진 이날 “오늘이 한국의 선거일이기 때문에 더욱 관련이 깊다”고 했는데, 공교롭게도 서울 송파·광진 등 일부 투표소에서 준비된 투표용지가 부족해 투표가 중단되는 사상 초유의 사태가 벌어졌다. 투표용지가 부족해 유권자가 참정권을 행사하지 못하고 장시간 대기하거나 집에 돌아가야 하는 ‘밸럿 페이퍼 쇼티지(ballot paper shortage)’는 미국 선거에서도 보기 드문 일이다.)

In 2022, Luzerne County in northeastern Pennsylvania experienced voting interruptions due to a ballot paper shortage. Two voters who were unable to cast their ballots filed a lawsuit against the county. The lawsuit was settled when the county agreed to pay $30,000 (approximately 45 million won) in legal costs and to provide election management training, including on how to order sufficient ballots. The ballot shortage caused significant confusion on the day, leading a court to order an extension of voting hours by two hours. The following June, the county district attorney released findings that the election supervisors lacked experience, though it was not found to be intentional obstruction of voting. (2022년 펜실베이니아주(州) 북동부의 루체른 카운티에서는 투표용지가 부족해 일부 투표가 중단되는 일이 벌어졌다. 이로 인해 투표를 못 한 유권자 2명이 카운티를 상대로 소송을 제기했는데, 카운티가 소송 비용으로 3만 달러(약 4500만원)를 지급하고 ‘충분한 투표 용지 발주 방법’ 등을 포함한 선거 관리 요원 교육을 약속하는 조건으로 합의를 하며 소송을 종결했다. 투표용지가 부족해 투표를 못 하자 법원이 2시간 운영 연장을 명령하는 등 당일 혼선이 상당했는데, 이듬해 6월 카운티 지방 검사는 투표를 방해하려는 고의는 없었다면서도 선거 감독관들이 경험이 부족했다는 조사 결과를 발표했다.)

In August 2022, ahead of the midterm elections, a primary election in Pinal County, Arizona, saw more than 20 polling stations run out of ballots, forcing up to 2,000 voters to leave without voting. The county later apologized, stating they had “witnessed a massive error on a large scale,” and pledged a complete overhaul of election procedures. An unexpectedly high voter turnout emptied ballot supplies at some stations, worsened by limited performance of older printers, which caused long delays in printing or delivering new ballots. Some voters were given waiting tickets with instructions to “come back later.” This incident is seen as having fueled the ‘election transparency’ movement championed by former President Donald Trump and the Republican Party. (2022년 8월 중간선거를 앞두고 애리조나 피널 카운티에서 치러진 예비 선거에서도 20개가 넘는 투표소에서 투표용지가 부족해 최대 2000명의 유권자가 투표를 하지 못한 채 돌아가는 사태가 발생했다. 이후 카운티 측은 “대규모로 발생한 엄청난 실수를 목격했다”고 사과한 뒤 선거 절차에 대한 전면 개편을 다짐했다. 예상보다 많은 유권자들이 몰려들면서 일부 투표소에서 투표용지가 동이 났고, 설상가상으로 구형 프린터의 성능이 제한돼 새 용지를 인쇄하거나 이를 전달받는 데 오랜 시간이 걸렸다. 일부 유권자에게는 ‘나중에 다시 오라’는 취지의 대기표가 발급됐다고 한다. 이 사건은 도널드 트럼프 대통령을 비롯해 공화당이 강조하는 ‘선거 투명성’ 운동에 불을 붙였다는 평가를 받는다.)

While not a ballot paper shortage, in November of the same year in Maricopa County, Arizona—a key swing state in U.S. politics—at least 30% of polling stations experienced machine malfunctions on election day, causing issues with scanning and printing ballots. Some outdated machines failed to recognize ballots, partly due to a higher-than-expected voter turnout. The county’s decision to separately store ballots from polling station drop boxes and count them separately undermined trust in the election’s integrity. This became a pivotal point for figures like Kari Lake, the MAGA (Make America Great Again) candidate who lost the gubernatorial race and was nominated as U.S. ambassador to Jamaica, who argued for the election’s invalidation, though courts did not accept these claims. (투표용지 부족은 아니지만 같은 해 11월 미국 정치의 대표적 ‘스윙 스테이트(swing state·경합주)’인 애리조나의 마리코파 카운티에서는 선거 당일 최소 30%의 투표소에서 투표 기계가 고장 나 투표용지를 스캔·인쇄하는 데 문제가 발생했다. 노후화된 일부 기계가 용지를 인식하지 못한 것인데, 예상보다 많은 유권자가 몰린 것이 한 원인이었다. 카운티가 투표소 보관함의 투표용지를 별도로 보관한 뒤 별도로 개표키로 해 선거의 신뢰성을 스스로 갉아 먹었다. 이는 주지사 선거에 출마했다 낙마한 매가(MAGA·미국을 다시 위대하게) 인사인 카리 레이크 자메이카 주재 미 대사 지명자 등이 ‘선거 무효’를 주장하는 결정적인 계기가 됐지만 법원이 이런 주장을 받아들이지 않았다.)

]]>

item.title: Kim Nam-jun, Kim Nam-guk... 'Lee's People' Head to Yeouido in Droves (김남준·김남국... ‘李의 사람들' 줄줄이 여의도로)
item.description:
Kim Nam-jun, Kim Nam-guk... 'Lee's People' Head to Yeouido in Droves (김남준·김남국... ‘李의 사람들' 줄줄이 여의도로)

As a result of the June 3 by-elections for the National Assembly, key ruling camp figures including former Democratic Party leader Song Young-gil and former Gangwon Governor Lee Gwang-jae succeeded in entering Yeouido. Additionally, a large number of President Lee Jae-myung's aides also made their way into the legislature. Four former Cheong Wa Dae aides at the secretary level or higher ran in this by-election: former AI Senior Secretary Ha Jung-woo, former spokespersons Kim Nam-jun and Jeon Eun-soo, and former Digital Communication Secretary Kim Nam-guk. (6·3 국회의원 재·보궐선거 결과, 더불어민주당 송영길 전 대표와 이광재 전 강원지사 등 여권 대표 주자들이 여의도 입성에 성공했다. 여기에 이재명 대통령 참모진도 대거 원내 진출했다. 이번 국회의원 재·보궐선거에 출마한 비서관 이상급 청와대 참모 출신은 4명이다. 하정우 전 AI수석, 김남준·전은수 전 대변인, 김남국 전 국민디지털소통비서관 등이다.)

In Incheon Gyeyang-eul, President Lee's former constituency during his time as a lawmaker, Kim Nam-jun, a close confidant of the president, appears to have secured victory as of 2 p.m. on the 4th. Kim has been a core ally since President Lee's time as mayor of Seongnam. Their relationship is so close that President Lee once said, "If you want to know what I think, ask Kim Nam-jun." As of 2 p.m. (with 24.8% of votes counted), Kim had 78.2% of the vote, leading People Power Party candidate Shim Wang-seop (16.9%). (이 대통령의 국회의원 시절 지역구인 인천 계양을에는 이 대통령의 최측근인 김남준 후보가 4일 2시 현재 당선이 확실한 상황이다. 김 후보는 대통령의 성남시장 시절부터 함께한 복심이다. 이 대통령이 “내 생각을 알려면 김남준에게 물어봐라”고 할 정도로 가까운 사이다. 2시 현재(개표율 24.8%) 득표율 78.2%로, 심왕섭 국민의힘 후보(16.9%)를 앞섰다.)

In the Chungnam Asan-eul by-election, candidate Jeon Eun-soo is leading People Power Party candidate Kim Min-kyung (33.3%) with 64.7% of the vote as of 2 p.m. (with 25.7% counted). Jeon served as deputy spokesperson and spokesperson in the first Cheong Wa Dae of the current administration and is a pro-Lee Jae-myung figure. Asan-eul is the district where Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik served three terms as a lawmaker. (충남 아산을 보궐선거에 출마한 전은수 후보는 2시 현재(개표율 25.7%) 득표율 64.7%로 김민경 국민의힘 후보(33.3%)를 앞섰다. 전 후보는 이번 정부 1기 청와대에서 부대변인·대변인을 맡은 친명(친 이재명)계다. 아산을은 강훈식 대통령 비서실장이 국회의원 시절 3선을 지낸 지역구다.)

Kim Nam-guk, a founding pro-Lee figure and member of the "Group of Seven," won in Gyeonggi Ansan-gap. After serving a single term as a lawmaker in the Ansan area, Kim did not run in the previous election due to allegations of omitting cryptocurrency assets. After being acquitted, he successfully won re-election in this race. Known for a brotherly relationship with the president, Kim served as Digital Communication Secretary in the Lee Jae-myung administration but resigned following the "local sister" text message controversy, later serving as a spokesperson for the Democratic Party leadership under Chung Cheong-rae. (원조 친명계로 ‘7인회’ 중 한 명인 김남국 후보가 경기 안산갑에서 당선됐다. 김 후보는 안산 지역 초선 국회의원 시절 코인 재산 누락 의혹으로 불출마했다가 무죄를 받은 뒤 이번 선거에서 재선에 성공했다. 대통령과 호형호제하는 사이로 알려진 김 후보는 이재명 정부 청와대에서 디지털소통비서관을 지내다 ‘현지 누나’ 문자 파동으로 직을 내려놓고 민주당 정청래 지도부 대변인을 지냈다.)

In this election, major ruling camp figures also succeeded in entering Yeouido. Song Young-gil, running in the Incheon Yeonsu-gap by-election, effectively secured his victory as of 2 p.m. (with 48.6% counted), leading People Power Party candidate Park Jong-jin. Song returns to the National Assembly four years after resigning his seat in Incheon Gyeyang-eul in April 2022 to run for Seoul mayor. Speculation now surrounds Song about a potential party leadership bid or a cabinet position in the Lee Jae-myung administration. (이번 선거에선 여권 빅샷도 여의도 입성에 성공했다. 인천 연수갑 보궐선거에 출마한 송영길 후보는 2시 현재(개표율 48.6%) 박종진 국민의힘 후보를 앞서며 사실상 당선을 확정했다. 2022년 4월 서울시장 출마를 위해 인천 계양을 지역구 의원직을 사퇴한 이후 4년 만에 국회에 재입성했다. 송 후보는 현재 당대표 출마설과 이재명 정부 장관 입각설 등이 나온다.)

In Gyeonggi Hanam-gap, as of 2 p.m. (with 70.7% counted), Democratic Party candidate Lee Gwang-jae (54.5%) is leading People Power Party candidate Lee Yong (43.2%). In the 2024 22nd general election, then-Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae defeated Lee Yong in Hanam-gap by a margin of 1 percentage point (1,100 votes). (경기 하남갑은 2시 현재(개표율 70.7%) 이광재 민주당 후보(54.5%)가 이용 국민의힘 후보(43.2%)를 앞섰다. 2024년 치러진 22대 총선에서 하남갑은 당시 추미애 민주당 후보가 1%포인트(1100표) 차이로 이용 후보를 이겼었다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Jeon Jae-soo Likely to Win Busan Mayor, Kim Sang-wook Likely to Win Ulsan Mayor ([속보] 부산시장 전재수·울산시장 김상욱 당선 유력)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Jeon Jae-soo Likely to Win Busan Mayor, Kim Sang-wook Likely to Win Ulsan Mayor ([속보] 부산시장 전재수·울산시장 김상욱 당선 유력)

In the results of the June 3 local elections, Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, is expected to defeat Park Hyung-joon, the People Power Party candidate, in the Busan mayoral election, one of the key battlegrounds. In the concurrently held Ulsan mayoral election, Kim Sang-wook, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, is ahead of Kim Doo-gyeom, the People Power Party candidate, making his victory all but certain. (6·3 지방선거 결과, 격전지 중 한 곳인 부산시장 선거에서 전재수 더불어민주당 후보가 박형준 국민의힘 후보를 꺾고 당선이 유력시된다. 함께 치러진 울산시장 선거에선 김상욱 더불어민주당 후보가 김두겸 국민의힘 후보에 앞서며 당선이 확실시됐다.)

As of 2:46 a.m. on the 4th (with 90.65% of votes counted), candidate Jeon Jae-soo received 50.52% of the vote, leading candidate Park Hyung-joon (47.92%) by 2.6 percentage points. The vote difference between the two candidates is 41,363 votes. (전재수 후보는 4일 오전 2시 46분(개표율 90.65%) 현재 50.52%를 득표해 박형준(47.92%) 후보를 2.6%포인트(p) 차로 앞서고 있다. 두 후보 간 표차는 4만1363표다.)

Candidate Jeon, who served as a three-term lawmaker in Busan's Buk-gu district, was appointed as the first Minister of Oceans and Fisheries under the Lee Jae-myung administration. He resigned from the ministerial post amid allegations of receiving money and gifts from the Unification Church, but maintained his innocence, ran for Busan mayor, and defeated the incumbent candidate Park. (부산 북갑에서 3선 국회의원을 지낸 전 후보는 이재명 정부 초대 해양수산부 장관으로 임명됐다. 그는 통일교 금품수수 의혹 탓에 장관직에서 중도 사임했지만, 결백을 주장하며 부산시장 선거에 출마해 현직인 박 후보를 꺾었다.)

The Busan mayoral election was considered one of the biggest battlegrounds in this local election. During the campaign period, President Lee Jae-myung of the Democratic Party and former President Lee Myung-bak of the People Power Party each visited Busan to provide side support for their respective candidates. (부산시장 선거는 이번 지방선거 최대 격전지 중 하나로 꼽혔다. 유세 기간 민주당에선 이재명 대통령이, 국민의힘에선 이명박 전 대통령이 각각 부산을 찾아 여야 후보를 측면 지원하기도 했다.)

Meanwhile, in the Ulsan mayoral election, where vote counting was 96.68% complete at the same time, candidate Kim Sang-wook received 49.02% of the vote, defeating candidate Kim Doo-gyeom (45.45%) and making his victory all but certain. The gap between the two candidates is 3.57 percentage points. (한편 같은 시각 개표가 96.68% 완료된 울산시장 선거에선 김상욱 후보가 49.02%를 득표해 김두겸(45.45%) 후보를 꺾고 당선이 확실시됐다. 두 후보 간 격차는 3.57%p다.)

Candidate Kim Sang-wook was elected as a National Assembly member under the People Power Party in the 2024 general election, but left the People Power Party during the martial law crisis and joined the Democratic Party. In this local election, he ran for Ulsan mayor and defeated the incumbent candidate Kim Doo-gyeom. (김상욱 후보는 2024년 총선에서 국민의힘 소속으로 국회의원에 당선됐지만, 비상계엄 정국에서 국민의힘을 탈당한 뒤 민주당에 입당했다. 이번 지방선거에서 울산시장 선거에 출마해 현직인 김두겸 후보를 꺾었다.)

Candidate Kim Sang-wook gained the upper hand after successfully unifying with candidate Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party in the final stages of the election. (김상욱 후보는 선거 막판 김종훈 진보당 후보와 범여권 단일화에 성공하면서 승기를 잡았다.)

item.title: Gap between Jung Won-oh and Oh Se-hoon narrows to 1.6%p... Close contest in final stretch (정원오-오세훈 격차 1.6%p로 좁혀져...막판 접전)
item.description:
Gap between Jung Won-oh and Oh Se-hoon narrows to 1.6%p... Close contest in final stretch (정원오-오세훈 격차 1.6%p로 좁혀져...막판 접전)

In the Seoul mayoral election, the biggest battleground of the June 3 local elections, Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, are engaged in a fierce race in the final stages of vote counting. (6·3 지방선거 최대 격전지인 서울시장 선거에서 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 개표 막판 접전을 펼치고 있다.)

As of 4:58 a.m. on the 4th (with 79.91% of votes counted), candidate Jung Won-oh holds 49.44% of the vote, leading candidate Oh Se-hoon (47.84%) by a margin of 1.6 percentage points (p). <<> Through the middle of the counting, candidate Jung was far ahead of candidate Oh by a margin of over 10%p, but since around 2 a.m., as the vote count from polling stations in the three affluent districts of Gangnam increased, the gap between the two candidates has been narrowing rapidly. <<> As of 5 a.m., the vote counting rates in Dongjak-gu (36.42%), Songpa-gu (45.07%), and Yeongdeungpo-gu (45.14%) remain below the average. <<> In exit polls released at 6 p.m. on the 3rd by three major terrestrial broadcasters, candidate Jung was predicted to lead with 51.4% of the vote over candidate Oh (46.0%). However, as the contest between the two candidates remains tight into the early morning, neither has been able to secure a definitive outcome. (4일 새벽 4시 58분(개표율 79.91%) 현재 정원오 후보가 49.44%를 득표해 오세훈(47.84%) 후보를 1.6%포인트(p) 차로 앞서고 있다.)

item.title: Recapture or Defense of Gangwon: Woo Sang-ho and Kim Jin-tae in a Tight Race (강원 탈환이냐 수성이냐, 우상호·김진태 접전)
item.description:
Recapture or Defense of Gangwon: Woo Sang-ho and Kim Jin-tae in a Tight Race (강원 탈환이냐 수성이냐, 우상호·김진태 접전)

In the Gangwon governor election held on the 3rd, Democratic Party candidate Woo Sang-ho and People Power Party candidate Kim Jin-tae were locked in a close contest. As of 2 p.m. on the 4th, Woo had secured 50.93% of the vote, leading Kim (49.06%) by 1.87 percentage points. (3일 강원지사 선거에서는 더불어민주당 우상호 후보와 국민의힘 김진태 후보가 접전을 벌였다. 우 후보는 4일 2시 현재 50.93%를 득표해 김 후보(49.06%)를 1.87%포인트(p) 앞섰다.)

If Woo wins, the Democratic Party will reclaim the Gangwon governor's office for the first time in four years. In Gangwon Province, the Democratic Party had won four times since 2010, including by-elections, until Kim was elected in the local elections held about 20 days after the launch of the Yoon Seok-yeol administration in 2022. (우 후보가 당선되면 민주당이 4년 만에 다시 강원지사를 탈환하게 된다. 강원도에서는 2010년 이후 민주당이 보궐선거를 포함해 네 번 승리했다가, 2022년 윤석열 정부 출범 20여 일 만에 치러진 지방선거에서 김 후보가 당선됐었다.)

Woo, a native of Cheorwon, Gangwon, received an early single nomination in February. His path was cleared early when former Gangwon Governor Lee Kwang-jae, a strong contender, announced he would not run. Woo, a leading figure of the 86 generation (those who entered university in the 1980s and were born in the 1960s) and from the student activist movement, served four consecutive terms as a lawmaker representing Seodaemun-gu Gap in Seoul. After overseeing the election as co-chair of the Lee Jae-myung campaign's joint election committee and chair of the Gangwon regional committee, he was appointed as senior presidential secretary for political affairs. (강원 철원 출신인 우 후보는 지난 2월 일찌감치 단수 공천을 받았다. 유력 후보로 거론됐던 이광재 전 강원지사가 도지사 불출마 의사를 밝히면서 조기에 교통 정리됐다. 우 후보는 86(1980년대 학번, 1960년대 출생) 운동권 대표 주자로 서울 서대문갑에서만 4선 국회의원을 지냈다. 지난 대선 때 이재명 캠프 공동선대위원장과 강원 지역 선대위원장을 맡아 선거를 지휘한 뒤 청와대 정무수석에 발탁됐다.)

Kim Jin-tae, who served as the head of the Chuncheon District Court's Wonju Branch, highlighted his identity as a "Gangwon candidate,' having served two terms as a lawmaker from his hometown of Chuncheon and as the first governor of Gangwon Special Self-Governing Province, and is running for re-election. Four years ago, Kim was initially cut from the People Power Party's primary for the local elections but eventually became the party's candidate through twists and turns, defeating then-Democratic Party candidate Lee Kwang-jae. (춘천지검 원주지청장을 지낸 김진태 후보는 고향 춘천에서 재선 국회의원, 초대 강원특별자치도지사를 지내는 등 ‘강원 후보’를 부각하며 재선에 도전했다. 김 후보는 4년 전엔 지방선거 국민의힘 공천에서 예비 후보 컷오프(공천 배제)됐다가, 우여곡절 끝에 당 후보로 선출돼 당시 민주당 이광재 후보를 꺾었다.)

Meanwhile, in the Jeju governor election, Democratic Party candidate Wi Seong-gon effectively secured victory by capturing 63.01% of the vote, leading People Power Party candidate Moon Seong-yu, who received 33.67%, by a wide margin of 29.34 percentage points. Wi, who has served three terms as a provincial councilor and three terms as a lawmaker on Jeju Island, stated on the day, "I will become a 'governor of people's livelihoods' who prioritizes the welfare of residents," adding, "I will foster future growth engines centered on renewable energy, AI (artificial intelligence), and data industries." (한편, 제주지사 선거는 민주당 위성곤 후보가 63.01%를 얻어 33.67%를 얻은 국민의힘 문성유 후보를 29.34%p 차로 크게 앞서며 사실상 당선을 확정했다. 제주에서 3선 도의원, 3선 국회의원을 지낸 위 후보는 이날 “도민의 삶을 가장 먼저 챙기는 ‘민생도지사’가 되겠다”며 “재생에너지·AI(인공지능)·데이터 산업을 중심으로 미래 성장동력을 키우겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee's Government, Energized by Local Elections, Likely to Drive Prosecution Withdrawals and Prosecution Reform (지방선거 힘 받은 李정부, 공소취소·검찰개편 드라이브 걸 듯)
item.description:
Lee's Government, Energized by Local Elections, Likely to Drive Prosecution Withdrawals and Prosecution Reform (지방선거 힘 받은 李정부, 공소취소·검찰개편 드라이브 걸 듯)

With the Democratic Party's victory in the June 3 local elections, held one year after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the Blue House and the ruling party are expected to accelerate their policy and legislative drive. In particular, President Lee Jae-myung, having secured administrative and legislative power along with local authority, has gained a strong grip on state affairs, unmatched by any previous administration. (이재명 정부 출범 1년 만에 치러진 6·3 지방선거에서 더불어민주당이 승리하면서, 향후 청와대와 여당의 정책 입법 드라이브가 본격화할 전망이다. 특히 이재명 대통령은 행정·입법 권력에 이어 지방 권력까지 장악하면서 과거 어느 정권도 갖지 못한 강력한 국정 운영 주도권을 확보하게 됐다.)

President Lee invested significant effort in these elections, visiting the fiercely contested Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang regions four times last month alone. While the opposition criticized this as "blatant election interference," a ruling party official stated, "For the president, winning the election was that crucial." A poor election outcome would inevitably undermine the momentum of state affairs for the remaining four years of his term. On election day, the 3rd, President Lee also encouraged voting, asking, "Did you vote to avoid being dominated by the worst scoundrels?" (이 대통령은 지난달에만 최대 접전지인 부산·울산·경남 지역을 4차례 방문하는 등 이번 선거에 공을 들였다. 야권은 “노골적인 선거 개입”이라고 했지만, 여권 관계자는 “대통령으로선 선거 승리가 그만큼 절실했다”고 했다. 선거 결과가 나쁘면 남은 임기 4년의 국정 운영 동력은 타격을 입을 수밖에 없기 때문이다. 이 대통령은 선거날인 3일에도 “최악의 저질들에게 지배당하지 않기 위해 투표하셨느냐”며 투표를 독려했다.)

President Lee is expected to use this victory as a springboard to push forward with issues that had been postponed due to concerns over opposition resistance and public backlash. Notably, the Democratic Party is likely to attempt parliamentary passage of the "Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel Act," which grants the president the authority to withdraw indictments in cases where he has been prosecuted. The party leadership had initially sought to pass this bill before the local elections but delayed it out of concern for a backlash. At the time, the Blue House also requested a postponement, citing the need for further public consultation and deliberation. (이 대통령은 이번 승리를 발판으로 그동안 야당 반대와 여론 역풍을 우려해 미뤄왔던 사안들에 강한 드라이브를 걸 전망이다. 특히 민주당은 대통령이 기소된 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 권한을 특검에 부여한 ‘조작 기소 특검법’의 국회 처리를 시도할 것으로 보인다. 당초 민주당 지도부는 이 법안을 지방선거 전 통과시키려 했다가 역풍을 우려해 선거 뒤로 미뤘다. 당시 청와대도 국민 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 더 거쳐 달라며 보류를 요청했다.)

However, the day before the election, the president remarked regarding the prosecution, "If you do something wrong, you apologize and cancel it," prompting speculation in both ruling and opposition circles that "he is referring to canceling his own trial." A ruling party official said, "The president believes he has been unfairly politically persecuted," adding, "If public sentiment is confirmed through this election, he will proceed with the process of withdrawing the indictment." (하지만 대통령이 선거 하루 전날 검찰을 향해 “잘못하면 사과하고 취소하는 것”이라고 말하면서, 여야 정치권 모두에서 “본인 재판을 공소 취소하란 얘기”란 말이 나왔다. 여권 관계자는 “대통령은 억울하게 정치 탄압을 받았다고 생각한다”며 “이번 선거를 통해 민심이 확인되면 공소 취소 절차를 진행하게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Additionally, the government and ruling party are expected to begin restructuring power institutions, including what is known as "prosecution reform," which they had aimed to finalize after the local elections. A Democratic Party official said, "Hardliners within the party are already calling for leveraging the election victory to immediately push for follow-up measures, such as abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigative powers." (또 정부·여당은 지방선거 이후 매듭지으려 한 이른바 ‘검찰 개혁’ 등 권력기관 개편 작업에도 돌입할 것으로 보인다. 민주당 관계자는 “당 강경파에선 벌써부터 선거 승리 여세를 몰아 검사의 보완 수사권 폐지 등 후속 조치에 곧장 착수하자는 말이 나온다”고 했다.)

Within the Blue House, there are also observations that President Lee will use the local election victory as momentum to drive structural reforms in labor, finance, pensions, public services, regulations, and education in the second half of this year. Last year, President Lee announced these as the "six major reforms." In the labor sector, he has consistently raised sensitive topics for labor unions, such as "securing employment flexibility," while in the financial sector, he has criticized the current system that applies "low interest rates for high-credit borrowers and high rates for low-credit borrowers." A ruling party official said, "There are no major elections until the general election in April of the year after next," adding, "This is the perfect time to push various reforms without worrying about elections." (청와대 내에서는 이 대통령이 지방선거 승리를 동력 삼아 올해 하반기에 노동, 금융, 연금, 공공, 규제, 교육 분야 구조 개혁을 본격 추진할 것이라는 관측도 나왔다. 이 대통령은 지난해 이를 ‘6대 개혁’으로 명명해 추진하겠다고 했다. 이 대통령은 노동 분야에선 ‘고용 유연성 확보’ 등 노동계가 꺼리는 주제를 지속적으로 언급해 왔고, 금융 분야에서는 ‘고신용자에게 낮은 금리, 저신용자에게 높은 금리’를 적용하는 현행 시스템에 문제 제기를 해왔다. 여권 관계자는 “내후년 4월 치러지는 총선까지 큰 선거가 없다”며 “선거를 의식하지 않고 각종 개혁 작업을 밀어붙일 수 있는 절호의 시점”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the Blue House is also reportedly considering a cabinet reshuffle. A ruling party official said, "They are contemplating a second Lee Jae-myung cabinet that can push reform tasks with more force." (이와 함께 청와대는 개각도 고려하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 여권 관계자는 “더 힘 있게 개혁 과제를 밀어붙일 2기 이재명 내각을 고민 중”이라고 했다.)

There are also predictions that President Lee will use this opportunity to push forward sensitive issues such as relocating the administrative capital, constitutional amendment, and moving public institutions to local regions. President Lee has consistently argued that balanced regional development is a task directly linked to the nation's destiny, stating that "completing the administrative capital in Sejong lays the cornerstone for that." The Constitutional Court ruled in 2004 that the plan to relocate the administrative capital to Sejong was unconstitutional, stating that "Seoul is the capital under customary constitutional law." For Sejong, currently a multi-functional administrative city, to gain administrative capital status, a constitutional amendment is needed. (이 대통령이 행정수도 이전과 개헌, 공공기관 지방 이전 등 민감한 이슈를 이번 기회에 밀어붙일 것이라는 전망도 나온다. 이 대통령은 그동안 지역 균형 발전은 나라 운명과 직결된 과제라며 “행정수도 세종 완성은 그 주춧돌을 놓는 일”이라고 했다. 헌법재판소는 2004년 행정 수도의 세종 이전 계획에 대해 “관습 헌법상 수도는 서울”이라며 위헌 결정을 내렸다. 현재 행정중심복합도시인 세종시가 행정 수도 지위를 가지려면 개헌이 필요하다.)

However, there are analyses that the election results also revealed significant public sentiment for "checking the government," given President Lee's approval rating exceeding 60% and the fact that the election was held one year into his administration. In the 2018 local elections, held one year into the Moon Jae-in administration, and the 2022 elections, held shortly after the launch of the Yoon Suk Yeol administration, the ruling party won landslide victories with few close races. In contrast, this election featured numerous fiercely contested races where the outcome remained uncertain until the end. Notably, in the 2018 Seoul mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Park Won-soon led by nearly 10 percentage points over the combined vote share of Liberty Korea Party candidate Kim Moon-soo and Bareunmirae Party candidate Ahn Cheol-soo. As a result, even within the ruling party, there are concerns that "if the president and ruling party drive various issues without heeding the opposition's views, they could face another backlash." (하지만 이번 선거 결과에 대해, 이 대통령의 60%를 웃도는 국정 지지도와 집권 1년 만에 치른 선거라는 점을 감안하면 ‘정부 견제’ 민심도 작지 않게 확인됐다는 분석도 있다. 문재인 정부 1년 만에 치러진 2018년, 윤석열 정부 출범 직후 치러진 2022년 지방선거 때는 접전지가 거의 없는 여당 압승이었다. 하지만 이번 선거에선 막판까지 승패를 알 수 없을 정도로 여야가 맞붙은 초접전지가 많았다. 특히 2018년 서울시장에서 박원순 당시 민주당 후보가 자유한국당 김문수 후보, 바른미래당 안철수 후보의 득표율 합보다 10%p 가까이 앞서며 크게 이겼다. 이 때문에 여권 내에서도 “대통령과 여당이 야당 의견을 듣지 않고 각종 사안에 드라이브를 걸 경우 또다른 역풍에 직면할 수 있다”는 말이 나온다.)

item.title: Heo Tae-jeong Elected Daejeon Mayor... Succeeds in Rematch 'Re-election' (허태정, 대전시장 당선...리턴매치서 설욕 ‘재선 성공’)
item.description:
Heo Tae-jeong Elected Daejeon Mayor... Succeeds in Rematch 'Re-election' (허태정, 대전시장 당선...리턴매치서 설욕 ‘재선 성공’)

Democratic Party of Korea's Daejeon mayoral candidate, former Mayor Heo Tae-jeong, won the rematch against the incumbent mayor, People Power Party candidate Lee Jang-woo, securing re-election. (더불어민주당 대전시장 후보인 허태정 전 대전시장이 현 시장인 국민의힘 이장우 후보와의 리턴 매치에서 승리해 재선에 성공했다.)

Heo, who narrowly lost to Lee Jang-woo by a 2.39% point margin in the Daejeon mayoral election four years ago, avenged that defeat in the rematch after four years. (4년 전 대전시장 선거에서 2.39%포인트 차로 이장우 후보에게 석패했던 허 당선인이 4년 만의 재대결에서 설욕한 것이다.)

According to the Central Election Commission's election statistics system as of 3:10 AM on the 4th, with 99.09% of votes counted, candidate Heo secured 53.49% of the vote, defeating People Power Party candidate Lee Jang-woo, who received 44.15%, by a margin of 9.34 percentage points, confirming his election. He outperformed candidate Lee in all five autonomous districts of Daejeon. (4일 중앙선거관리위원회 선거통계시스템에 따르면, 오전 3시 10분 현재 개표율 99.09% 기준으로 허 후보는 53.49%의 득표율로, 44.15%를 기록한 국민의힘 이장우 후보를 9.34%포인트 차로 따돌리며 당선을 확정지었다. 대전 5개 자치구에서 모두 이 후보를 앞섰다.)

A graduate of Daejeon Daeseong High School and Chungnam National University's Department of Philosophy, Mayor-elect Heo served as an administrative officer at the Roh Moo-hyun administration's Blue House, a policy advisor to the Minister of Science and Technology, and the director of the Welfare Center at the Daedeok Research and Development Special Zone Support Headquarters. (대전 대성고와 충남대 철학과를 졸업한 허 당선인은 노무현 정부 청와대 행정관을 거쳐 과학기술부 장관 정책보좌관, 대덕연구개발특구지원본부 복지센터소장 등을 지냈다.)

In the 2010 local elections, he ran for Yuseong District Office chief in an area where conservative party-affiliated district heads and lawmakers were concentrated, winning the position, and was re-elected in 2014. He then ran for Daejeon mayor in 2018 and won. He failed to secure a second term when he lost the 2022 election. (2010년 지방선거에서 보수 정당 소속 구청장과 국회의원이 포진한 유성구청장 선거에 출마해 유성구청장에 당선됐고, 2014년 재선에 성공했다. 이어 2018년 대전시장에 도전해 당선됐다. 2022년 선거에서 낙선해 시장 연임에 실패했다.)

Leading up to this election, Mayor-elect Heo had consistently outpaced candidate Lee in various polls, often beyond the margin of error. During three televised debates, when candidate Lee attacked him as "incompetent and irresponsible" over delays in the construction of the Daejeon Urban Railway Line 2 tram, Heo countered by questioning Lee's whereabouts on the day of the December 3 insurrection. (허 당선인은 이번 선거를 앞두고 실시한 여러 여론조사에서 이 후보를 오차 범위 밖에서 따돌리며 앞서왔다. 세 차례 이뤄진 TV 토론회에선 도시철도 2호선 트램 건설 지연을 놓고 이 후보에게 ‘무능·무책임’하다는 공격을 받자, 허 당선인은 12·3 내란 당일 이 후보의 행적 등을 추궁하며 맞섰다.)

In the final stages of the campaign, former President Park Geun-hye visited candidate Lee Jang-woo's election office to offer support. However, analysis suggests that Mayor-elect Heo's appeal, based on high approval ratings for President Lee Jae-myung's administration, to "choose the ruling party candidate to work in sync with the president," proved effective. (선거전 막판 박근혜 전 대통령이 이장우 후보 선거사무소를 찾아 지원에 나섰다. 하지만 이재명 대통령에 대한 높은 국정 운영 지지도를 기반으로 “대통령과 호흡을 맞출 여당 후보를 선택해 달라”는 허 당선인의 호소가 주효했다는 분석이다.)

Mayor-elect Heo stated, "I extend my deepest gratitude to the citizens who gave me their support. I will prioritize creating a safe city and revitalizing the people's livelihood economy." (허 당선인은 “지지를 보내주신 시민께 무한한 감사를 드린다”며 “안전한 도시를 만들고 민생 경제를 살리는 데 최우선으로 매진하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, during the campaign, Mayor-elect Heo expressed positions that projects promoted by candidate Lee during his tenure—such as the Bomunsan development project funded by the issuance of municipal bonds, and the '0 O'clock Festival' held under a full closure of Jungang-ro—should be reviewed or revised. Consequently, with Heo taking office as mayor, the future continuation of these projects has become uncertain. (한편, 허 당선인은 선거 기간 이 후보가 시장 재임 중 추진한 도시공사채 발행을 통한 보문산 개발 사업, 중앙로를 전면 통제한 채 열리는 ‘0시 축제’ 등에 대해 재검토하거나 보완해야 한다는 입장을 밝힌 바 있다. 이에 허 당선인이 시장에 취임하면 해당 사업의 지속 여부가 불투명해진 상황이다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Leads in 13 Regions, People Power Party in 3... Seoul and South Gyeongnam in Tight Race (지선 민주 13곳·국힘 3곳 1위... 서울·경남 초접전)
item.description:
Democratic Party Leads in 13 Regions, People Power Party in 3... Seoul and South Gyeongnam in Tight Race (지선 민주 13곳·국힘 3곳 1위... 서울·경남 초접전)

As of 4:30 a.m. on the 4th, during the vote counting for the June 3 local elections, the Democratic Party of Korea is leading in 13 of the 16 metropolitan and provincial governor races, while the People Power Party holds an advantage in 3. This marks the ruling Democratic Party also gaining control of local governments. However, in the Seoul mayoral and South Gyeongsang gubernatorial elections, the ruling and opposition parties are locked in a tight race until the final stages, leaving the possibility of a reversal in outcomes. (6·3 지방선거 개표 진행 중인 4일 오전 4시 30분 현재, 전국 16곳의 시·도지사 선거 중 더불어민주당이 13곳, 국민의힘이 3곳에서 우위를 기록하고 있다. 집권여당인 민주당이 지방정부까지 거머쥐게 된 것이다. 다만 서울시장과 경남시장 선거는 여야가 막판까지 초접전을 벌이고 있어 승패가 뒤집힐 가능성도 있다.)

As of 4:30 a.m., 88.03% of the nationwide local election vote counting has been completed. Among these, the Democratic Party is leading in 13 regions, including Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Gangwon, South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong, Sejong, Daejeon, North Jeolla, South Jeolla/Gwangju, Busan, Ulsan, and Jeju. The People Power Party is in first place in 3 regions: Daegu, North Gyeongsang, and South Gyeongsang. (오전 4시 30분 기준 전국 지방선거 개표는 88.03% 완료됐다. 이중 민주당은 서울, 경기, 인천, 강원, 충남, 충북, 세종, 대전, 전북, 전남광주, 부산, 울산, 제주 등 13곳에서 앞서고 있다. 국민의힘은 대구, 경북, 경남 등 3곳에서 1위를 기록 중이다.)

In Seoul, with 74.97% of the vote counted, Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh and People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon are in a tight race with a margin of less than 3 percentage points (p). Currently, Jeong holds 49.87% and Oh 47.43%, with a gap of just 2.44%p. Notably, since around 2 a.m., the gap between the two candidates has been narrowing rapidly. (서울의 경우, 개표가 74.97% 완료된 시점까지 정원오 민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 3%포인트(p) 미만의 초접전을 벌이고 있다. 현재 정 후보가 49.87%, 오 후보가 47.43%으로 두 후보 간 격차는 2.44%p에 불과하다. 특히 새벽 2시쯤부터 양 후보 간 격차가 빠른 속도로 줄고 있다.)

In South Gyeongsang, where 78.8% of the vote has been counted, People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo is leading with 51.18%, ahead of Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyung-soo (48.81%) by a margin of 2.37%p. South Gyeongsang also sees a small difference in votes between the two candidates, raising the possibility of a comeback. (개표율 78.8%을 기록 중인 경남에선 박완수 국민의힘 후보가 51.18%를 기록해 김경수 민주당 후보(48.81%)를 2.37%p 차로 앞서고 있다. 경남 역시 두 후보 간 표차가 적어 역전이 일어날 가능성이 있다.)

In the Daegu mayoral race, considered a key battleground, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho defeated Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum and confirmed his victory. In the Busan mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo outpaced People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon and secured victory. (격전지로 꼽힌 대구시장 선거에선 추경호 국민의힘 후보가 김부겸 민주당 후보를 누르고 당선을 확정지었다. 부산시장 선거에선 전재수 민주당 후보가 박형준 국민의힘 후보를 앞서며 당선을 확정했다.)

In Gangwon, where the ruling and opposition candidates were in a close contest until the end, Democratic Party candidate Woo Sang-ho defeated People Power Party candidate Kim Jin-tae. In the North Jeolla gubernatorial election, which drew attention due to internal competition within the ruling party, Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek took the lead over independent candidate Kim Kwan-young. (막판까지 여야 후보가 접전을 벌인 강원에선 우상호 민주당 후보가 김진태 국민의힘 후보를 꺾었다. 여권 내 경쟁으로 주목받았던 전북지사 선거에선 이원택 민주당 후보가 김관영 무소속 후보를 앞섰다.)

Meanwhile, in the National Assembly by-elections held alongside the local elections, the Democratic Party is leading in 9 seats, the People Power Party in 4, and an independent in 1. Considering that during the last general election, 13 of the 14 seats were Democratic Party constituencies, the People Power Party has performed relatively well. (한편 지방선거와 함께 치러진 국회의원 재·보궐선거에선 민주당이 9곳, 국민의힘이 4곳, 무소속이 1곳에서 선두를 달리고 있다. 지난 총선 당시 14곳 중 13곳이 민주당 지역구였던 점을 감안하면 국민의힘이 상대적으로 선전한 것이다.)

In Busan North Gap, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon defeated Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and confirmed his election win. In Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek B, People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong overcame Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party to secure victory. (부산 북갑에선 한동훈 무소속 후보가 하정우 민주당 후보를 꺾고 당선을 확정지었다. 경기 평택을에선 유의동 국민의힘 후보가 김용남 민주당 후보, 조국 조국혁신당 후보를 앞서며 당선됐다.)

In Gyeonggi Hanam Gap, Democratic Party candidate Lee Kwang-jae was elected, and in Ulsan Nam Gap, People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-gyu secured his seat. (경기 하남갑에선 이광재 민주당 후보가, 울산 남갑에선 김태규 국민의힘 후보가 각각 당선됐다.)

item.title: Democratic Party 'Sweeps' All 5 District Offices in Daejeon…A Complete Reversal of the 1-to-4 Disadvantage from 4 Years Ago (민주, 대전 5구청장 ‘싹쓸이’…4년 전 ‘1대 4’ 열세와는 딴판)
item.description:
Democratic Party 'Sweeps' All 5 District Offices in Daejeon…A Complete Reversal of the 1-to-4 Disadvantage from 4 Years Ago (민주, 대전 5구청장 ‘싹쓸이’…4년 전 ‘1대 4’ 열세와는 딴판)

The landscape of basic local government heads in the Daejeon region has been overturned in four years. (대전 지역 기초단체장 지형도가 4년 만에 뒤집혔다.)

In the June 3 local elections, the Democratic Party of Korea secured all five district mayor seats in Daejeon City, achieving a landslide victory that completely reversed the 1-to-4 defeat it suffered against the People Power Party four years ago. This marks the first time in eight years, since 2018, that the Democratic Party has swept all five district mayor positions. <<> According to the Central Election Commission's election statistics system on the 4th, the Democratic Party swept all five district mayoral posts, including Jung-gu (Kim Je-seon), Dong-gu (Hwang In-ho), Seo-gu (Jeon Moon-hak), Daedeok-gu (Kim Chan-sul), and Yuseong-gu (Jung Yong-rae). <<> This contrasts sharply with the 2022 local elections, when the party was overwhelmingly pushed back by the People Power Party and managed to elect a district mayor only in Yuseong-gu. <<> In the Daejeon basic local government head elections, the People Power Party aimed to retain its hold by leveraging the incumbency advantage of current heads in Dong-gu, Seo-gu, and Daedeok-gu. However, the vote counting results showed public sentiment tilting toward the Democratic Party. <<> An analysis suggests that amid the frozen local economy and livelihoods, Daejeon citizens showed expectations for revitalizing the regional economy through the strong synergy of the government and ruling party working as a unified team. <<> The public sentiment in Daejeon favored Democratic Party candidates who prioritized "economic revival" over the People Power Party's argument for "checking concentrated power." <<> A local political source commented, "It seems the People Power Party, which rode the conservative wave four years ago to take control of Daejeon's district administrations, could not escape the 'wave of judgment' triggered by the December 3 martial law and the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol." (6·3 지방선거에서 더불어민주당이 대전시 5개 구청장 자리를 석권하면서, 국민의힘에 1대 4로 참패했던 4년 전과 정반대로 압승을 거뒀다. 민주당이 5개 구청장 자리를 모두 석권한 것은 지난 2018년에 이어 8년 만이다.)

item.title: No Ballot Papers… Unprecedented Voting Suspension at 17 Locations Including Seoul’s Gangnam District (용지 없어… 서울 강남 등 17곳 초유의 투표 중단 사태)
item.description:
No Ballot Papers… Unprecedented Voting Suspension at 17 Locations Including Seoul’s Gangnam District (용지 없어… 서울 강남 등 17곳 초유의 투표 중단 사태)

On the 3rd, when the main voting for the 9th nationwide local elections was underway, an unprecedented incident occurred where voting was temporarily suspended at over a dozen polling stations in Seoul and other areas due to a shortage of ballot papers. At some polling stations, voters waited over an hour and a half for ballot papers, while others gave up and left. Some polling stations extended the voting deadline from 6 PM to 10 PM. The People Power Party described this as "a serious incident infringing on voters' political rights," demanding a halt to the vote counting and arguing that a re-election should be held based on the results of the investigation. <<> As of 8 PM that day, the People Power Party identified a ballot paper shortage at 17 polling stations, including 14 locations across five districts in Seoul—Gangnam, Gwangjin, Dongjak, Seocho, and Songpa—2 in Incheon's Yeonsu District, and 1 in Hwaseong City, Gyeonggi Province. In Seoul's Songpa District, it was reported that voting had been impossible since around 1 PM. <<> In this local election, each voter cast ballots for metropolitan city and provincial governors, education superintendents, mayors, county heads, district chiefs, and local councilors (including metropolitan, basic, and proportional representatives). Given that outcomes in basic-level races often hinge on differences of hundreds to thousands of votes, analysts suggest this incident could spark disputes over the infringement of voting rights and the validity of the election. <<> The National Election Commission stated, "The turnout was higher than in the 2022 local elections, leading to a shortage of prepared ballot papers at some polling stations." For example, in Songpa District, ballot papers were prepared for 50% of the eligible voters, but the actual turnout exceeded that, causing the shortage. The provisional turnout for this local election was 61%, 10.1 percentage points higher than the previous local election's 50.9%. <<> In response, Heo Cheol-hoon, Secretary-General of the National Election Commission, held a briefing at 9 PM and said, "We deeply apologize for the inconvenience caused to citizens who came to polling stations to exercise their precious sovereignty and for undermining trust." <<> However, Jang Dong-hyuk, a spokesperson for the People Power Party, stated, "The Seoul election is already tainted, and a tainted election is invalid. The vote counting should be halted immediately, and the Seoul election should be re-held based on the investigation results." Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party's candidate for Seoul Mayor, said, "The Election Commission must take responsible preliminary measures on how to restore citizens' political rights." Cho Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Korea, expressed "strong regret over the Election Commission's election preparations" but added that "calls to halt vote counting and hold a re-vote are utterly baseless." Kang Yoo-jung, Senior Deputy Spokesperson for the Presidential Office, said, "We are strictly monitoring the situation," and urged, "The Election Commission should take responsible measures to ensure no disruptions occur in the exercise of voting rights and vote-counting management in some regions." (제9회 전국 동시 지방선거 본투표가 진행된 3일 서울 등 투표소 10여 곳에서 투표 용지가 부족해 투표가 일시 중단되는 초유의 사태가 벌어졌다. 일부 투표소에선 유권자들이 투표 용지가 없어 1시간 30분 이상 기다렸고, 일부 유권자는 투표를 포기하고 돌아갔다. 오후 6시인 투표 마감 시간을 오후 10시로 연장한 투표소도 있었다. 국민의힘은 “유권자의 참정권을 침해한 중대한 사태”라며 개표 중단을 요구하고, 진상 파악 결과에 따라 재선거를 해야 한다고 주장했다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh and Oh Se-hoon in a Tight 0.5%p Race Until the Final Stretch (정원오·오세훈 0.5%p차 막판 초박빙)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh and Oh Se-hoon in a Tight 0.5%p Race Until the Final Stretch (정원오·오세훈 0.5%p차 막판 초박빙)

In the Seoul mayoral election, the biggest battleground of the June 3 local elections, Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party of Korea and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party are engaged in an ultra-tight contest with a 0.5 percentage point (p) gap even in the final stages of vote counting. (6·3 지방선거 최대 격전지인 서울시장 선거에서 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 개표 막판까지 0.5%포인트(p) 격차의 초박빙 승부를 벌이고 있다.)

As of 6:08 a.m. on the 4th (with 89.39% of votes counted), candidate Jung leads with 48.89% of the vote, barely ahead of candidate Oh (48.39%). However, the gap between the two candidates continues to narrow, making it difficult to predict the outcome. While Jung has maintained the lead for 12 hours since counting began, attention is focused on whether Oh can reclaim the top spot before counting concludes. (4일 오전 6시 8분 현재(개표율 89.39%), 정 후보가 48.89%를 득표해 오 후보(48.39%)를 간발의 격차로 앞서 있다. 다만 두 후보 간 격차가 계속 줄고 있어 승패 예측이 어려운 상황이다. 정 후보가 개표 직후부터 12시간째 1위를 유지 중인 가운데, 오 후보가 개표 종료 전 선두를 탈환할 수 있을지 주목된다.)

The gap between the two candidates widened to as much as 30%p early in the counting process, but Oh has been closing the gap since around midnight. As of 6:08 a.m., the difference between the two candidates is a mere 23,180 votes. (두 후보 간 격차는 개표 초반 최대 30%p까지 벌어졌지만, 자정쯤부터 오 후보가 격차를 좁혀왔다. 6시 8분 기준 두 후보 간 격차는 2만3180표에 불과하다.)

item.title: 10–12 Races Solidify for Ruling Party, 2–3 for Opposition (與 10~12곳.. 野 2~3곳 확실시)
item.description:
10–12 Races Solidify for Ruling Party, 2–3 for Opposition (與 10~12곳.. 野 2~3곳 확실시)

As of 2 a.m. on the fourth day of the 9th nationwide local elections, the Democratic Party of Korea appears certain to win in 10 out of 16 metropolitan government head races nationwide, including Gyeonggi, Incheon, North Jeolla, and South Chungcheong. The People Power Party has effectively secured victory in Daegu and North Gyeongsang. The two parties are locked in fierce battles in Seoul, Busan, South Gyeongsang, and Gangwon. (제9회 전국동시지방선거에서 4일 오전 2시 현재 더불어민주당이 전국 16개 광역단체장 선거 가운데 경기·인천·전북·충남 등 10곳에서 승리가 확실시되고 있다. 국민의힘은 대구·경북에서 당선을 사실상 확정했다. 양당은 서울, 부산, 경남, 강원에서 치열한 접전을 벌였다.)

According to the National Election Commission, as of 2 a.m. (with 63.21% of votes counted), the Democratic Party has widened its lead in Ulsan, Daejeon, North Chungcheong, Sejong, Jeju, South Jeolla, and Gwangju. The People Power Party has confirmed the election of candidate Lee Cheol-woo in the North Gyeongsang gubernatorial race. In the Daegu mayoral election, candidate Chu Kyung-ho has also entered the winning zone. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면, 이날 오전 2시 현재(개표율 63.21%) 민주당은 울산·대전·충북·세종·제주·전남광주 등에서 격차를 벌렸다. 국민의힘은 경북지사 선거에서 이철우 후보의 당선을 확정 지었다. 대구시장 선거에서도 추경호 후보가 당선권에 들었다.)

In the fiercely contested Seoul mayoral election, with 43.75% of votes counted, Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh leads People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon by 13.84 percentage points. In the Busan mayoral race, with 82% of votes counted, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo leads People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon by 2.39 percentage points. Meanwhile, in the South Gyeongsang gubernatorial election, with 64.74% of votes counted, People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo leads Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyung-soo by 2.7 percentage points. (최대 승부처로 꼽힌 서울시장 선거에서는 개표율 43.75% 상태에서 민주당 정원오 후보가 국민의힘 오세훈 후보를 상대로 13.84%포인트 차로 앞섰다. 부산시장 선거에서는 개표율 82%에서 민주당 전재수 후보가 국민의힘 박형준 후보를 2.39%포인트 차로 앞섰으나, 경남지사 선거에서는 개표율 64.74%에서 국민의힘 박완수 후보가 민주당 김경수 후보를 2.7%포인트 차 우위를 보였다.)

Having won 12 out of 17 metropolitan government heads in the 2022 local elections, the People Power Party is now losing parts of the Seoul metropolitan area, Chungcheong, and Yeongnam regions to the Democratic Party in this election. The Lee Jae-myung administration has secured a third consecutive victory—following the 2024 general election and last year's early presidential election—thereby gaining local government power in addition to executive and legislative authority. The Democratic Party stated on this day, "The people have bolstered the stable governance of the Lee Jae-myung government, which has been in office for a year." (2022년 지방선거에서 광역단체장 17곳 중 12곳을 차지했던 국민의힘은 이번 선거에서 수도권과 충청·영남권 일부를 민주당에 내주게 됐다. 이재명 정권은 2024년 총선과 지난해 조기 대선에 이어 이번 지방선거까지 3연승을 거두면서 행정·입법 권력에 지방 권력도 확보하게 됐다. 민주당은 이날 “국민들이 출범 1년이 된 이재명 정부의 안정적인 국정 운영에 힘을 실어준 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

According to the National Election Commission, the final voter turnout for this local election is provisionally tallied at 61.0%. Of the total 44,649,908 eligible voters, 27,249,586 cast ballots. This is 10.1 percentage points higher than the final turnout of 50.9% in the 8th local elections in 2022. It is the third time local election turnout has exceeded 60%, following the first local elections in 1995 (68.4%) and the seventh local elections in 2018 (60.2%). (중앙선관위에 따르면 이번 지방선거 최종 투표율은 61.0%로 잠정 집계됐다. 전체 선거인 4464만9908명 가운데 2724만9586명이 투표에 참여했다. 이는 2022년 제8회 지방선거 최종 투표율(50.9%)보다 10.1%포인트 높은 수치다. 지방선거 투표율이 60%를 넘은 것은 1995년 제1회 지방선거(68.4%)와 2018년 제7회 지방선거(60.2%)에 이어 세 번째다.)

item.title: In the First Jeonnam-Gwangju Unified Mayoral Election, the Ruling Party's Min Hyung-bae Defeats Lee Jung-hyun (초대 전남·광주통합시장, 與 민형배가 이정현 누르고 당선)
item.description:
In the First Jeonnam-Gwangju Unified Mayoral Election, the Ruling Party's Min Hyung-bae Defeats Lee Jung-hyun (초대 전남·광주통합시장, 與 민형배가 이정현 누르고 당선)

In the Jeonbuk Governor election, Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek is leading independent Kim Kwan-young and appears likely to win. Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae, who expelled Kim from the party amid allegations of "proxy fee payments" and has been in conflict with him, has at least relieved some pressure. (전북지사 선거에선 더불어민주당 이원택 후보가 무소속 김관영 후보에 앞서며 당선이 유력하다. ‘대리비 지급 의혹’으로 김 후보를 민주당에서 제명한 뒤 김 후보와 대립해 온 정청래 민주당 대표는 일단 부담을 덜게 됐다.)

As of 2:00 p.m. on the 4th (vote count rate 63.07%), candidate Lee Won-taek leads with 51.4%, ahead of Kim Kwan-young (41.77%) by 9.63 percentage points (p). This Jeonbuk Governor election has been considered the biggest battleground set to shake the future leadership landscape of the Democratic Party. This is because Kim, who was expelled from the Democratic Party over the "proxy fee payment" allegations, framed this election as a "Jung Cheong-rae vs. Kim Kwan-young" showdown and positioned himself as the vanguard of the "anti-Jung Cheong-rae" faction. With Lee, backed by the full support of the party, predicted to win against Kim, party leader Jung has also eased the burden on his path to re-election. (4일 2시 현재(개표율 63.07%) 이원택 후보가 51.4%로 김관영 후보(41.77%)를 9.63%포인트(p) 앞서고 있다. 이번 전북지사 선거는 향후 민주당의 리더십 지형을 뒤흔들 최대 승부처로 꼽혀왔다. ‘대리비 지급 의혹’으로 민주당에서 제명된 김 후보가 이번 선거를 ‘정청래 대 김관영’ 대결 구도로 규정하며 ‘반청(반정청래)계 선봉’을 자처했기 때문이다. 당의 전폭적 지원을 업은 이 후보가 김 후보를 상대로 승리할 것으로 예측되면서, 정 대표도 연임 가도에 대한 부담을 덜게 됐다.)

In the first unified mayoral election for the Jeonnam-Gwangju Unified Special City, Democratic Party candidate Min Hyung-bae secured 79.23% of the vote as of 2:00 p.m. on the 4th, defeating People Power Party candidate Lee Jung-hyun (11.38%) and securing his victory. (첫 통합시장을 선출하는 전남·광주통합특별시에선 민형배 민주당 후보가 4일 2시 기준 79.23%를 득표해 이정현(11.38%) 국민의힘 후보를 누르고 당선이 확실시됐다.)

Meanwhile, as of 2:00 p.m. on the 4th, among the 41 basic local government heads in Gwangju, Jeonnam, and Jeonbuk, the Democratic Party is leading in 37 areas. The Fatherland Innovation Party is leading in one area, Sinan, while independent candidates are leading in three areas, including Gangjin, Gwangyang, and Wando. Although polls initially predicted strong performances from the Fatherland Innovation Party and independent candidates, the vote count reaffirms the Democratic Party's overwhelming dominance. (한편 4일 2시 현재 광주·전남·전북 지역 기초단체장 41곳 중 민주당은 37곳에서 1위를 차지하고 있다. 조국혁신당은 신안 1곳에서, 무소속 후보는 강진·광양·완도 등 3곳에서 1위를 기록 중이다. 당초 여론조사에선 조국혁신당과 무소속 후보들의 선전이 점쳐졌으나, 개표 결과 민주당의 절대 우위가 다시 확인됐다.)

item.title: Kim Se-hun of the Democratic Party Wins Hwacheon County Mayor Election... Ruling Party Also Leads in Gangneung Mayor Race (민주당 김세훈 화천군수 당선… 강릉시장 선거서도 與 우세)
item.description:
Kim Se-hun of the Democratic Party Wins Hwacheon County Mayor Election... Ruling Party Also Leads in Gangneung Mayor Race (민주당 김세훈 화천군수 당선… 강릉시장 선거서도 與 우세)

In the vote counting for the Gangwon Hwacheon County mayor election, Democratic Party candidate Kim Se-hun was confirmed victorious as of 2 a.m. on the 4th, recording a 57.35% vote share, defeating People Power Party candidate Choi Myung-soo (42.64%). Hwacheon County, a border region with strong conservative tendencies, had seen its county mayors consistently elected from the People Power Party since an independent candidate won in 1995. Kim becomes the first county mayor from the Democratic Party. (강원 화천군수 선거 개표 결과 더불어민주당 김세훈 후보가 4일 오전 2시 현재 57.35% 득표율을 기록해 국민의힘 최명수 후보(42.64%)를 누르고 당선이 확정됐다. 접경 지역으로 보수세가 강한 화천군은 1995년 무소속 후보가 당선된 이후 줄곧 국민의힘 소속 군수가 당선됐었다. 김 후보가 첫 민주당 소속 군수가 된 것이다.)

Kim had previously run for county mayor in 2018 and 2022 but faced defeat, and this marks his third bid. Local political circles analyzed, "Kim seems to have boosted his name recognition by running for a third time, and the high approval ratings for President Lee Jae-myung also appear to have played a role." (김 후보는 2018년, 2022년 군수 선거에 도전했으나 고배를 마셨고, 이번이 세 번째 군수 도전이다. 지역 정치권에선 “김 후보가 세 번째 출마에 나서며 인지도를 높였고, 이재명 대통령 지지율이 높은 상황도 반영된 것 같다”는 분석이 나왔다.)

In the Gangwon Gangneung mayor election, the Democratic Party candidate took first place as of 2 a.m. on the 4th, drawing attention to whether the 'first Democratic Party mayor' will emerge. Democratic Party candidate Kim Jung-nam led with a 52.84% vote share (with 73.14% of votes counted). People Power Party candidate Kim Hong-kyu had a 40.97% share, and independent candidate Kim Dong-ki garnered 6.18%. (강원 강릉시장 선거에서도 민주당 후보가 4일 오전 2시 현재 1위를 기록하면서 ‘첫 민주당 시장’이 나올지 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 민주당 김중남 후보는 득표율 52.84%(개표율 73.14%)로 1위를 달렸다. 국민의힘 김홍규 후보는 득표율 40.97%, 무소속 김동기 후보는 6.18%였다.)

Gangneung has also consistently elected mayors from the People Power Party lineage. However, following last year's drought crisis, calls for accountability arose against incumbent mayor Kim Hong-kyu. Along with the fragmentation of the conservative camp after the impeachment of President Yoon Seok-yeol, there were predictions that the Democratic Party candidate would make gains. (강릉도 줄곧 국민의힘 계열 후보가 시장에 당선됐던 곳이다. 그러나 지난해 가뭄 사태를 겪은 이후 현직 시장인 김홍규 후보 책임론이 불거졌다. 여기에 윤석열 대통령 탄핵 이후 보수 진영이 분열 양상을 보이면서 민주당 후보가 약진할 것이란 관측이 나왔었다.)

In the Gyeongnam Jinju mayor election, where conservative party candidates have historically won, attention is also on whether a Democratic Party candidate will be elected for the first time. As of 2 a.m. on the 4th (with 27.7% of votes counted), Democratic Party candidate Gal Sang-don (41.06%) and independent candidate Cho Gyu-il (39.21%) are in a close race. People Power Party candidate Han Kyung-ho's vote share was 19.71%. Local political sources remarked, "Regardless of which candidate wins—Gal or Cho—the title of 'first' will be attached." Incumbent mayor Cho, who was cut off during the People Power Party primaries, left the party and ran as an independent. (보수 정당 후보들이 승리해왔던 경남 진주시장 선거에서도 처음으로 민주당 후보가 당선될지 관심이다. 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 27.7%) 민주당 갈상돈 후보(41.06%)와 무소속 조규일 후보(39.21%)가 경합 중이다. 국민의힘 한경호 후보 득표율은 19.71%였다. 지역 정가에선 “조·길 후보 중 누가 당선되더라도 ‘최초’라는 타이틀이 붙게 된다”고 했다. 현직 시장인 조 후보는 국민의힘 경선에서 컷오프돼 탈당 후 무소속으로 출마했다.)
