item.title: Lee Dong-seok of People Power Party Breaks through Democratic Party Stronghold… Sets Record as North Chungcheong’s Youngest Mayor (민주당 강세 뚫은 국민의힘 이동석…충북 최연소 시장 기록 썼다)
item.description:
Lee Dong-seok of People Power Party Breaks through Democratic Party Stronghold… Sets Record as North Chungcheong’s Youngest Mayor (민주당 강세 뚫은 국민의힘 이동석…충북 최연소 시장 기록 썼다)

“By just 124 votes.” (“단 124표.”)

In the 9th Local Elections held on the 3rd, candidate Lee Dong-seok (age 40) of the People Power Party was elected as the mayor of Chungju City. (지난 3일 치러진 제9회 전국동시지방선거 충주시장 선거에서 국민의힘 이동석(40) 후보가 당선됐다.)

The outcome of the Chungju mayoral election remained uncertain until the very end. Mayor-elect Lee Dong-seok garnered 52,962 votes (50.05%), defeating Democratic Party candidate Maeng Jeong-seop, who received 52,838 votes (49.94%), by a margin of 124 votes. The difference in vote share was merely 0.11 percentage points. (충주시장 선거 승부는 마지막까지 안갯속이었다. 이동석 당선인은 5만2962표(50.05%)를 얻어 5만2838표(49.94%)를 얻은 더불어민주당 맹정섭 후보를 124표 차로 꺾었다. 득표율 차이는 0.11%포인트에 불과했다.)

This election was one of the most fiercely contested battles in North Chungcheong Province and across the nation. From the early stages of vote counting, Maeng Jeong-seop maintained the lead, but around 4 a.m. on the 4th, Lee Dong-seok managed to overtake him. (이번 선거는 충북은 물론 전국에서도 손꼽히는 초접전 승부였다. 개표 초반부터 맹정섭 후보가 우위를 이어갔지만,4일 새벽 4시쯤 이동석 후보가 역전에 성공했다.)

What made it even more dramatic was the pre-election landscape. Various opinion polls had shown Maeng leading with a margin outside the margin of error. However, once the ballot boxes were opened, the results turned out differently. Despite the Democratic Party’s strong momentum, the voters of Chungju ultimately chose Lee of the People Power Party. (더욱 극적인 것은 선거 전 판세였다. 각종 여론조사에서 맹 후보가 오차범위 밖 우세를 보이며 앞서는 것으로 나타났었다. 하지만 투표함을 열자 결과는 달라졌다. 민주당 강세 흐름 속에서도 충주 유권자들은 결국 국민의힘 이 후보를 선택했다.)

This election was held to select a new mayor for the first time in 12 years due to term limits preventing incumbent Mayor Jo Gil-hyeong from seeking a third consecutive term. While the Democratic Party showed strength in most areas of North Chungcheong Province, Chungju remained a fiercely contested region that the People Power Party managed to hold onto. (이번 선거는 조길형 시장의 3선 연임 제한으로 12년 만에 새 시장을 선출하는 선거였다. 충북 대부분 지역에서 민주당이 강세를 보인 가운데 충주는 국민의힘이 지켜낸 격전지로 남게 됐다.)

Born in 1985, Mayor-elect Lee Dong-seok attended Chungju’s Gyohyeon Elementary School and Chungil Middle School before majoring in Political Science at the University of California, Santa Barbara (UCSB) in the United States and pursuing graduate studies in International Politics at New York University. After working as an MBN reporter, he served as a presidential secretary at the Blue House and as a policy adviser to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, gaining experience in central politics and administration. (1985년생인 이동석 당선인은 충주 교현초와 충일중을 졸업한 뒤 미국 캘리포니아대 산타바버라(UCSB)에서 정치학을 전공하고, 뉴욕대 대학원에서 국제정치학을 공부했다. MBN 기자를 거쳐 청와대 행정관과 해양수산부 장관 정책보좌관 등을 지내며 중앙 정치와 행정 경험을 쌓았다.)

A virtual political newcomer, he emphasized generational change during the election campaign, championing the slogan "A Young Chungju, A New Chungju." He proposed key pledges such as establishing the Chungju Tourism Corporation, attracting semiconductor and high-tech industries, and developing the region as a medical hub for the central area. He promised to create a city that draws young populations by expanding youth jobs and improving living conditions. (정치 신인에 가까운 그는 선거 과정에서 ‘젊은 충주, 새로운 충주’를 내세우며 세대 교체를 강조했다. 충주관광공사 설립과 반도체·첨단 산업 유치, 중부권 의료 거점 육성 등을 핵심 공약으로 제시했다. 청년 일자리 확대와 정주 여건 개선을 통해 젊은 인구가 모이는 도시를 만들겠다고 약속했다.)

Additionally, leveraging his experience working at the Blue House and central government agencies, he highlighted himself as a candidate with strengths in securing national funding and attracting businesses to sway voter sentiment. (또 청와대와 중앙부처 근무 경험을 바탕으로 국비 확보와 기업 유치에 강점을 가진 후보임을 부각하며 유권자 표심을 공략했다.)

Mayor-elect Lee Dong-seok also set a new record in North Chungcheong’s local governance history. At the age of 40, he was elected mayor of Chungju, becoming the youngest head of a local government in the province's history. The previous record was held by current lawmaker Eom Tae-yeong, who was 44 when elected mayor of Jecheon in the 3rd Local Elections in 2002. (이동석 당선인은 충북 지방자치 역사에 새로운 기록도 썼다. 만 40세 나이로 충주시장에 당선돼 충북의 역대 최연소 기초자치단체장이 됐다. 종전 기록은 2002년 제3회 지방선거에서 44세에 제천시장에 당선된 엄태영 현 국회의원이 보유하고 있었다.)

Political circles view this outcome as a reflection of local public sentiment calling for generational change. Analysts suggest that despite the Democratic Party’s strong performance, voters chose change and new leadership. (정치권에서는 이번 결과를 세대 교체를 바라는 지역 민심이 반영된 것으로 보고 있다. 민주당 강세 속에서도 유권자들이 변화와 새로운 리더십을 선택한 것이라는 분석이다.)

Mayor-elect Lee stated, "This is not my personal victory but the choice of citizens who desire change for Chungju," adding, "I accept this moment with a heavy sense of responsibility." (이 당선인은 “저 개인의 승리가 아니라 충주의 변화를 바라는 시민 여러분의 선택”이라며 “무거운 책임감으로 이 순간을 받아들인다”고 말했다.)

He continued, "I will create a city administration that prioritizes the lives of citizens, one that proves itself by fulfilling promises and moves with youthful and clean energy," and added, "Immediately after taking office, I will activate a Chungju Future Strategy Task Force to personally oversee issues such as medical service gaps, corporate attraction, regulations and permits, downtown regeneration, and improving living conditions in Seochungju." (이어 “시민의 삶을 먼저 살피는 시정, 약속을 실행해 증명하는 시정, 젊고 깨끗한 에너지로 움직이는 시정을 만들겠다”며 “취임 즉시 충주 미래전략 TF를 가동해 의료 공백과 기업 유치, 규제·인허가, 원도심 재생, 서충주 정주여건 개선 등 여러과제를 직접 챙기겠다”고 말했다.)

Mayor-elect Lee said, "Starting from worries about hospitals, jobs, children, and the elderly, I will begin with changing the daily lives of citizens," as he concluded. (이 당선인은 “병원 걱정, 일자리 걱정, 아이들 걱정, 어르신들의 걱정까지 시민의 하루를 바꾸는 일부터 시작하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Hwaseong and Pyeongtaek in the 'Semiconductor Belt' Likely to Win for Democratic Party (‘반도체 벨트’ 화성·평택, 민주당 당선 유력)
item.description:
Hwaseong and Pyeongtaek in the 'Semiconductor Belt' Likely to Win for Democratic Party (‘반도체 벨트’ 화성·평택, 민주당 당선 유력)

As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, the results of the June 3rd elections for mayors of Yongin, Hwaseong, and Pyeongtaek in Gyeonggi Province showed candidates Lee Sang-il (People Power Party, Yongin), Jeong Myeong-geun (Democratic Party, Hwaseong), and Choi Won-yong (Democratic Party, Pyeongtaek) leading. Yongin, Hwaseong, and Pyeongtaek, home to semiconductor factories like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, are known as the 'semiconductor belt.' These areas were considered the biggest battlegrounds in the Gyeonggi region for this June 3rd local election. (6·3 경기 용인·화성·평택시장 선거 개표 결과 4일 오전 2시 현재 국민의힘 이상일(용인), 더불어민주당 정명근(화성), 민주당 최원용(평택) 후보가 1위를 달렸다. 용인·화성·평택은 삼성전자, SK하이닉스 등 반도체 공장이 몰려 있어 ‘반도체 벨트’로 불리는 지역이다. 이번 6·3 지방선거에서 경기 지역 최대 격전지로 꼽혔다.)

According to the National Election Commission's vote counting, as of 2 a.m. on the 4th, in the Yongin mayoral election (73.79% counted), incumbent mayor Lee Sang-il of the People Power Party led with 51.98% of the vote, ahead of Democratic Party candidate Hyeon Geun-taek (46.62%). If elected, Lee would secure a second term. (중앙선거관리위원회 개표 결과, 4일 오전 2시 현재 용인시장 선거(개표율 73.79%)에서는 현직 시장인 국민의힘 이상일 후보가 득표율 51.98%로 민주당 현근택 후보(46.62%)에 앞섰다. 이 후보가 당선되면 재선 시장이 된다.)

Lee, a former newspaper reporter, was elected as a proportional representative lawmaker for the Saenuri Party (predecessor of the People Power Party) in the 2012 19th general election. He became Yongin's mayor in the 2022 local elections. In this election, he highlighted achievements such as attracting the semiconductor national industrial complex and expanding road and railway networks. (이 후보는 신문 기자를 하다 2012년 19대 총선 때 새누리당(국민의힘의 전신) 비례대표 의원에 당선됐다. 2022년 지방선거 때 용인시장에 당선됐다. 이번 선거에선 반도체 국가산단 유치와 도로·철도망 확충 등 성과를 내세웠다.)

Candidate Hyeon, a lawyer by background, served as deputy spokesperson for the Democratic Party's central party and vice director of the Democratic Research Institute. Hyeon pledged to transform the city into a semiconductor industry hub and expand transportation and housing infrastructure. (현 후보는 변호사 출신으로 민주당 중앙당 부대변인과 민주연구원 부원장 등을 지냈다. 현 후보는 반도체 산업 중심 도시로 전환과 교통·주거 인프라 확충을 공약했다.)

In the Hwaseong mayoral election, as of 2 a.m. on the 4th (67.94% counted), incumbent mayor Jeong Myeong-geun of the Democratic Party secured 58.55% of the vote, leading People Power Party candidate Park Tae-gyeong (35.55%). If elected, Jeong would achieve a second term. (화성시장 선거에선 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 67.94%) 현직 시장인 민주당 정명근 후보가 득표율 58.55%를 얻어 국민의힘 박태경 후보(35.55%)에 앞섰다. 정 후보가 당선되면 재선에 성공하게 된다.)

Hwaseong was elevated to a 'special case city with a population of 1 million' last year. The population is rapidly growing, centered around Samsung Electronics' Hwaseong campus and Dongtan New Town. (화성은 지난해 ‘100만 특례시’로 승격했다. 삼성전자 화성캠퍼스와 동탄신도시를 중심으로 인구가 빠르게 증가하고 있다.)

Jeong, during his tenure as mayor, campaigned for reelection by highlighting achievements such as the city's elevation to a special case city, expansion of the metropolitan transportation network, and attraction of high-tech industries. He pledged to expand transportation and living infrastructure and foster high-tech industries. Jeong stated, "I will strive to hear evaluations like 'Since Jeong Myeong-geun became mayor, Hwaseong has truly improved,'" adding, "I will dramatically upgrade Hwaseong." (정 후보는 시장 재임 중 특례시 승격과 광역 교통망 확충, 첨단 산업 유치 등을 주요 성과로 내세우며 재선에 도전했다. 교통·생활 인프라 확충과 첨단 산업 육성 등을 공약했다. 정 후보는 “‘정명근이 시장이 되니 화성이 정말 좋아졌다’는 평가를 듣도록 노력하겠다”며 “화성을 획기적으로 업그레이드하겠다”고 했다.)

In the Pyeongtaek mayoral election, as of 2 a.m. on the 4th (52.85% counted), Democratic Party candidate Choi Won-yong received 63.80% of the vote, ahead of People Power Party candidate Cha Hwa-yeol (36.19%). Choi, a former deputy mayor of Pyeongtaek, proposed pledges to expand the semiconductor industry ecosystem and build transportation networks. Pyeongtaek has grown around Samsung Electronics' Pyeongtaek campus and Godeok International New Town. This Pyeongtaek mayoral election drew attention as the Pyeongtaek district, where a by-election for a National Assembly seat was also held, was considered a battleground. (평택시장 선거에서는 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 52.85%) 민주당 최원용 후보가 득표율 63.80%를 얻어 국민의힘 차화열 후보(36.19%)에 앞섰다. 최 후보는 평택 부시장 출신으로 반도체 산업 생태계 확대와 교통망 구축을 공약으로 제시했다. 평택은 삼성전자 평택캠퍼스와 고덕국제신도시를 중심으로 성장했다. 이번 평택시장 선거는 국회의원 재·보궐 선거가 치러지는 평택을 선거구도 격전지로 꼽히며 이목을 모았다.)

In the 2022 local elections, the People Power Party candidate won in Yongin, while Democratic Party candidates won in Hwaseong and Pyeongtaek. As of the 2 a.m. count on the 4th, the top two vote-getters in this local election followed the same party lineup as in the previous local election. Election experts commented, "With the semiconductor industry booming, both parties are engaged in a battle to defend their semiconductor belt constituencies." (2022년 지방선거 때는 용인에선 국민의힘 후보가, 화성·평택에선 민주당 후보가 승리했다. 4일 오전 2시 개표율 기준 이번 지방선거 1·2위 득표자도 지난 지방선거 때와 같은 정당 구도였다. 선거 전문가들은 “반도체 산업이 호황을 구가하는 상황에서 양당이 반도체 벨트 선거구 사수전을 벌이는 양상”이라고 했다.)

In the Seongnam mayoral election in Gyeonggi Province, Democratic Party candidate Kim Byeong-wook and incumbent mayor Shin Sang-jin of the People Power Party were in a tight race as of 2 a.m. on the 4th (69.05% counted), with vote shares of 49.01% and 50.02%, respectively. Seongnam, with a population of 900,000, is where President Lee Jae-myung served as mayor from 2010 to 2018. The Seongnam mayoralty was held by Democratic Party members (Lee Jae-myung and Eun Soo-mi) for 12 years from 2010 to 2022. In the 2022 local elections, candidate Shin Sang-jin was elected. Shin, a medical doctor who graduated from Seoul National University's College of Medicine, served as a four-term National Assembly member for the Seongnam Jungwon district. Kim, a two-term lawmaker for the Seongnam Bundang-eul district in the 20th and 21st National Assemblies, is a member of the 'Group of Seven,' considered key pro-Lee figures. He served as the first chief presidential secretary for political affairs under the Lee Jae-myung administration. Local political analysts observed, "This area can be seen as President Lee's political stronghold, and the all-out campaigns by both party candidates are reflected in the vote counting results." (경기 성남시장 선거에서는 민주당 김병욱 후보와 현직 시장인 국민의힘 신상진 후보가 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 69.05%) 득표율 49.01% 대 50.02%로 접전을 벌였다. 인구 90만명인 성남시는 이재명 대통령이 2010~2018년 시장을 한 곳이다. 성남시장은 2010~2022년 12년간 민주당 소속(이재명·은수미)이 맡았다. 2022년 지방선거에서 신상진 후보가 당선됐었다. 신 후보는 서울대 의대를 졸업한 의사 출신으로 성남 중원 선거구에서 4선 국회의원을 했다. 김 후보는 20·21대 국회 때 성남 분당을 선거구에서 의원을 했다. 친명계 핵심 인사들로 불리는 ‘7인회’ 멤버다. 이재명 정부의 첫 대통령 정무비서관을 맡았다. 지역 정가에선 “이 대통령의 정치적 아성이라 할 수 있는 곳이라 양당 후보가 총력전을 벌인 게 개표 결과에서도 나타나고 있다”는 분석이 나왔다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon Elected in Busan North Gap... Yoo Ui-dong's Victory Confirmed in Pyeongtaek B (부산 북갑 한동훈 당선... 평택을 유의동 당선 확실)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon Elected in Busan North Gap... Yoo Ui-dong's Victory Confirmed in Pyeongtaek B (부산 북갑 한동훈 당선... 평택을 유의동 당선 확실)

In the by-election for the Busan North Gap National Assembly seat, held alongside the June 3 local elections, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon defeated Democratic Party candidate Ha Jeong-woo to win the election. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러진 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에서 한동훈 무소속 후보가 하정우 더불어민주당 후보를 꺾고 당선됐다.)

As of 2:07 AM on the 4th (with a vote count rate of 99.51%), Candidate Han secured 43.0% of the vote, beating Candidate Ha, who received 41.24%, by a margin of 1.75 percentage points (p), confirming his victory. The difference in votes between the two candidates was 1,425 votes. (4일 오전 2시 7분(개표율 99.51%) 현재, 한 후보는 43.0%를 득표해 41.24%를 득표한 하 후보를 1.75%포인트(p) 차로 꺾고 당선이 확정됐다.두 후보간 표 차이는 1425표다.)

Around 2 AM that day, Candidate Han stated at his campaign office in Buk-gu, Busan, "I sincerely thank the great citizens of Buk-gu for opening the path to the future of Buk-gu and the reconstruction of conservatism through this historic victory." He added, "I will develop Buk-gu, rebuild conservatism, and curb the runaway of the Lee Jae-myung administration to balance the Republic of Korea," and pledged, "I will become a politician who only follows the will of the people." (한 후보는 이날 오전 2시쯤 부산 북구에 위치한 선거사무소에서 “역사적 승리로 북구의 미래, 보수 재건의 길을 열어주신 북구의 위대한 시민들께 진심으로 감사드린다”고 말했다. 한 후보는 “북구를 발전시키고, 보수를 재건하고, 이재명 정권의 폭주를 제어해 대한민국의 균형추를 맞추겠다”면서 “민심만 보고 가는 정치인이 되겠다”고 말했다.)

Candidate Ha also visited his campaign office around the same time and said, "I humbly accept the result. I also extend my congratulations to Candidate Han Dong-hoon, who has won." He continued, "Though I now step down as a candidate, the development direction for Buk-gu that I spoke of must continue," and added, "I will do my best to keep my promises no matter where I am." (하 후보도 비슷한 시각 자신의 선거사무소를 찾아 “결과를 겸허하게 받아들인다. 승리하신 한동훈 후보께도 축하의 말씀을 전한다”고 했다. 하 후보는 “이제 후보로서 자리 내려놓게 되지만, 제가 말씀드렸던 북구의 발전 방향은 계속돼야 한다”면서 “어느 자리에서도 약속을 지키기 위해 최선을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, in the Pyeongtaek B by-election held that day, the election of People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong appears certain. As of 2:13 AM (with a vote count rate of 78.9%), Candidate Yoo is leading with 34.13% of the vote, ahead of Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam (29.03%) by a margin of 5.11 percentage points. The gap between the two candidates is 3,886 votes. (한편 이날 치러진 경기 평택을 재선거에선 국민의힘 유의동 후보의 당선이 확실시된다. 유 후보는 오전 2시 13분(개표율 78.9%) 현재 34.13%의 득표율로 김용남(29.03%) 더불어민주당 후보를 5.11%p 차로 앞서있다. 두 후보 간 격차는 3886표다.)

Pyeongtaek B was contested in a five-way race involving Candidate Yoo, Candidate Kim, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Candidate Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, and Candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Freedom and Innovation Party. Initially, polls indicated a 'two-horse race' between Candidate Kim and Candidate Cho, with Candidate Yoo as a 'mid-tier' contender trailing them, but when the ballot boxes were opened, Candidate Yoo's support turned out to be stronger. (평택을은 유 후보, 김 후보, 조국 조국혁신당 후보, 김재연 진보당 후보, 황교안 자유와혁신 후보의 5자 구도로 치러졌다. 당초 여론조사에선 김 후보와 조 후보가 ‘2강’ 구도를 형성하고 유 후보가 ‘1중’으로 두 명을 따라가는 구도였지만, 막상 투표함을 열어보니 유 후보의 지지세가 더 강했던 것으로 나타났다.)

item.title: People Power Party's Kang Ki-yoon elected as mayor of Changwon, the only special-case city outside the capital area (비수도권 유일 특례시 창원시장에 국민의힘 강기윤 당선)
item.description:
People Power Party's Kang Ki-yoon elected as mayor of Changwon, the only special-case city outside the capital area (비수도권 유일 특례시 창원시장에 국민의힘 강기윤 당선)

In the June 3 election for the mayor of Changwon, South Gyeongsang Province, Kang Ki-yoon (66), the candidate of the People Power Party, defeated Song Soon-ho of the Democratic Party of Korea by a margin of 2.59 percentage points, becoming the head of the 9th popularly elected Changwon city administration. (6·3 경남 창원시장 선거에서 국민의힘 강기윤(66) 후보가 더불어민주당 송순호 후보를 2.59%포인트 차로 앞서며 민선 9기 창원 시정을 이끌 수장이 됐다.)

With all vote counting completed as of 9 a.m. on the 4th, candidate Kang secured a 49.32% vote share, surpassing candidate Song, who received 46.73%, and confirmed his election victory. (4일 오전 9시 개표가 모두 끝난 상황에서 강 후보는 49.32%의 득표율로, 46.73%를 얻은 송 후보를 제치고 당선을 확정 지었다.)

Mayor-elect Kang stated, "I believe the citizens' choice of me is a stern order to make Changwon, which has been stagnant, leap forward again." He added, "I will set aside the joy of being elected and become a mayor who immediately gets to work," and "I will go to the field and first listen to the voices of small business owners and companies facing difficulties and stalled projects." (강 당선인은 “시민들께서 저를 선택해 주신 것은 멈춰 선 창원을 다시 뛰게 하라는 준엄한 명령이라고 생각한다”고 소감을 밝혔다. 이어 “당선의 기쁨을 내려놓고 바로 일하는 시장이 되겠다”며 “현장으로 가 멈춰 선 사업과 어려움을 겪는 소상공인, 기업의 목소리부터 듣겠다”고 말했다.)

The vote counting process was extremely close. Up to the 70-80% counting mark, it was a tight race with candidate Song, but Kang succeeded in a late-stage comeback. During the election, he faced attacks from rival candidates over allegations that he mobilized public enterprise personnel and budgets for early campaigning while serving as president of Korea Southern Power Company, but he ultimately secured victory by rallying conservative forces in the final stage. (개표 과정은 초접전 양상이었다. 개표율 70~80%대까지 송 후보와 엎치락뒤치락하다 막판 뒤집기에 성공했다. 선거 과정에서 한국남동발전 사장 시절 공기업 인력과 예산을 동원해 사전 선거운동을 했다는 의혹이 터지면서 경쟁 후보에게 공세를 받았지만, 막판에 보수 세력 결집을 이뤄내 당선됐다.)

Candidate Kang is a former two-term member of the National Assembly and two-term provincial council member. He challenged for the mayor of Changwon in the 2018 local elections but lost in the party primary. This was his first bid for the mayor of Changwon. Most recently, he served as president of Korea Southern Power Company. (강 후보는 재선 국회의원, 재선 도의원 출신이다. 2018년 지방선거 때 창원시장에 도전했으나 당내 경선에서 고배를 마셨다. 창원시장 도전은 이번이 처음이었다. 직전에는 한국남동발전 사장을 지냈다.)

Upon taking office, Kang plans to focus on economic and job recovery. He said, "I will surely make Changwon the best city for doing business and Korea's top job-creating city," and "I will definitely realize the pledges of creating 100,000 jobs, paying 1 million won in energy pensions, and making the Machang Bridge free of charge." He also promised, "I will revive the pride of each region—Masan, Changwon, and Jinhae—and achieve balanced development," and "I will become a mayor who transcends regional and ideological conflicts." (강 후보는 취임과 함께 경제와 일자리 회복에 주력한다는 방침이다. 그는 “창원을 기업하기 가장 좋은 도시, 대한민국 1등 일자리 도시로 반드시 만들겠다”며 “일자리 10만개 창출, 에너지 연금 100만원 지급, 마창대교 무료화 공약을 반드시 현실로 만들겠다”고 했다. 또 “마산·창원·진해 각 지역의 자존심을 살리고 균형 발전을 이루겠다”며 “지역 간, 이념 간 갈등을 넘어서는 시장이 되겠다”고 약속했다.)

For citizens of Masan and Jinhae, who have complained of regional underdevelopment and alienation since the integration, he plans to relocate some departments or agencies of the main city hall to the Masan and Jinhae municipal buildings and establish a new Balanced Development Division at the main city hall to systematically promote regional balance. (통합 후 오히려 지역 낙후와 소외감을 호소하는 마산과 진해 지역 시민을 위해 마산청사와 진해청사에 본청 일부 국 또는 사업소를 이전하고, 본청에 균형발전과를 신설해 지역 균형 발전을 체계적으로 추진할 계획이다.)

Changwon is the seat of the South Gyeongsang Provincial Government and a city where one-third of the province's population (about 3.2 million) resides. It is the only special-case city with a population of 1 million outside the capital area. <<>> (창원은 경남도청 소재지이자 경남 인구(약 320만)의 3분의 1이 사는 도시다. 비수도권 유일의 인구 100만 특례시다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon overtakes Jung Won-oh... Seoul race neck-and-neck until the very end (오세훈, 정원오에 역전... 서울 막판까지 초박빙)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon overtakes Jung Won-oh... Seoul race neck-and-neck until the very end (오세훈, 정원오에 역전... 서울 막판까지 초박빙)

<<>> As vote counting nears the final stages for the Seoul mayoral election, the biggest battleground in the June 3 local elections, People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon has overtaken Democratic Party candidate Jung Won-oh for the first time. ()

As of 8:15 a.m., with about 96% of the votes counted, Oh Se-hoon secured 48.79% of the vote, edging out Jung Won-oh (48.49%) to take the lead. The margin between the two candidates stands at 14,923 votes. (6·3 지방선거 최대 격전지인 서울시장 선거 개표가 막바지에 접어든 가운데, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보가 더불어민주당 정원오 후보를 처음으로 역전했다.)

This marks the first time Oh has pulled ahead of Jung since vote counting began around 6:20 p.m. on the 3rd. In the early stages of counting, Jung led Oh by as much as 30 percentage points, but the gap began to narrow rapidly after midnight. By around 2 a.m., the difference had shrunk to within 5 percentage points, and Oh continued to close the gap until a golden cross occurred at 7:17 a.m., flipping the rankings. (개표가 96% 가까이 진행된 오전 8시 15분 현재, 오세훈 후보는 48.79%를 득표해 정원오(48.49%)를 누르고 1위를 차지했다. 두 후보 간 표차는 1만4923표다.)

Currently, approximately 340,000 votes remain uncounted. Among the districts, Songpa-gu has the largest number of remaining votes, followed by Yeongdeungpo-gu and Dongjak-gu. (오 후보가 정 후보에게 앞서는 결과가 나온 것은 3일 오후 6시 20분쯤 지방선거 개표가 시작된 이후 이번이 처음이다. 개표 초반에는 정 후보가 오 후보에게 최대 30%포인트(p) 차이로 앞서 있었지만, 자정 이후 두 후보 간 표차가 급격히 줄어들기 시작했다. 새벽 2시쯤 정 후보와 오 후보 간 격차는 5%p 안쪽으로 줄어들었고, 이후에도 계속 오 후보가 격차를 좁히다가 7시 17분에는 급기야 두 후보의 순위가 뒤집히는 골든 크로스가 일어났다.)

As the Seoul mayoral election remains exceptionally tight even in the final stages of vote counting, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae postponed a briefing on the local election results originally scheduled for 7 a.m. Candidate Jung Won-oh has also canceled his planned statement, originally set for 7:30 a.m. (현재 미개표된 잔여표 수는 약 34만표다. 자치구별로는 송파구의 잔여표가 가장 많고, 이어 영등포구와 동작구 순이다.)

item.title: Independent Kim Gwan-young Loses Election: "I Respect the Results... I Will Carry the Aspirations of Jeonbuk in My Heart" (‘무소속’ 김관영 낙선 “결과 존중…전북의 열망 가슴에 품겠다”)
item.description:
Independent Kim Gwan-young Loses Election: "I Respect the Results... I Will Carry the Aspirations of Jeonbuk in My Heart" (‘무소속’ 김관영 낙선 “결과 존중…전북의 열망 가슴에 품겠다”)

Kim Gwan-young, a former candidate for the governor of North Jeolla Province who was expelled from the Democratic Party and ran as an independent, confirmed his defeat on the 4th, stating, "I respect this outcome," and "I will hold the aspirations of the people of the province who seek Jeonbuk’s development close to my heart until the end." (더불어민주당에서 제명됐다가 무소속으로 출마했던 김관영 전북도시자 후보가 4일 낙선이 확정되자 “이번 결과를 존중한다”며 “전북의 발전을 바라는 도민 여러분의 열망을 끝까지 가슴에 품겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Candidate Kim wrote on Facebook, "I humbly accept the choice of the residents," expressing the same sentiment. (김 후보는 페이스북에 “도민의 선택을 겸허히 받아들인다”며 이같이 적었다.)

He continued, "First, I sincerely thank all the residents who believed in and supported me. Although we lost the election, through this campaign I was able to clearly confirm how strong the will of the people of Jeonbuk is." (그는 “먼저 저를 믿고 지지해주신 모든 도민 여러분께 진심으로 감사드린다”며 “비록 선거에서는 패배했지만, 이번 선거를 통해 전북도민의 뜻이 얼마나 강한지 분명히 확인할 수 있었다”고 썼다.)

Candidate Kim added, "An unexpectedly powerful surge of public desire arose, and voices from all over Jeonbuk echoed that the future of the province must be decided by its people. Though Kim Gwan-young has lost, the will of the people has never been defeated." (김 후보는 “누구도 예상하지 못했던 큰 도민의 바람이 일어났고 전북의 미래는 도민이 결정해야 한다는 목소리가 전북 곳곳에서 울려 퍼졌다”며 “비록 김관영은 패배했지만, 도민의 뜻은 결코 패배하지 않았다”고 했다.)

He concluded, "Going forward, I will fulfill my role for the success of Jeonbuk and the happiness of its residents. Once again, I thank everyone who stood with me. The choice of Jeonbuk is always made by its people." (김 후보는 “앞으로도 전북의 성공과 도민의 행복을 위해 제가 해야 할 역할을 다하겠다”며 “함께해 주신 모든 분께 다시 한번 감사드린다. 전북의 선택은 언제나 도민이 한다”고 했다.)

According to the National Election Commission, as of 7 a.m., Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek secured 51.22% (473,436 votes), defeating independent candidate Kim Gwan-young (41.78%, 386,152 votes) and confirming his victory. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면 오전 7시 기준 이원택 민주당 후보는 51.22%(47만3436표)를 얻어 김관영 무소속 후보(41.78%·38만6152표)를 제치고 당선을 확정지었다.)

item.title: Ulsan Dong-gu Mayor Race: People Power Party vs. Progressive Party in Tight Contest (울산 동구청장, 국힘·진보당 접전)
item.description:
Ulsan Dong-gu Mayor Race: People Power Party vs. Progressive Party in Tight Contest (울산 동구청장, 국힘·진보당 접전)

As of 2 a.m. on the 4th (with 91.83% of votes counted), the Ulsan Dong-gu mayoral election sees a close race between People Power Party candidate Cheon Ki-ok (43.27% of the vote) and Progressive Party candidate Park Mun-ok (42.49%). (울산 동구청장 선거에서는 4일 오전 2시 현재(개표율 91.83%) 국민의힘 천기옥 후보(득표율 43.27%)와 진보당 박문옥 후보(42.49%)가 접전을 벌였다.)

This is Cheon's third bid for the Dong-gu mayoral position. In the 2011 by-election for Dong-gu mayor, she ran as an independent and placed third. In the 2022 election, she lost to Progressive Party candidate Kim Jong-hoon. She has previously served as a Ulsan city councilor. (천 후보는 이번 동구청장 선거가 세 번째 도전이다. 2011년 동구청장 재보궐선거 때 무소속으로 출마해 3위를 했다. 2022년 동구청장 선거에서는 진보당 김종훈 후보에게 밀려 낙선했다. 울산시의원을 지냈다.)

Park is a former Dong-gu district councilor, running for mayor for the first time. If Park wins, the Progressive Party would produce a second consecutive mayor in this district. (박 후보는 울산 동구의원 출신이다. 이번에 처음 동구청장 선거에 출마했다. 박 후보가 당선되면 진보당은 이곳에서 두 차례 연속 구청장을 배출하게 된다.)

Ulsan Dong-gu is home to HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' headquarters and numerous shipbuilding-related small and medium-sized enterprises. With a large number of shipyard workers, it is considered a "progressive stronghold." Local political circles analyze that "the unification of progressive candidates influenced voters in Dong-gu." The Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party confirmed Park as the unified candidate for Dong-gu mayor on the 15th of last month. (울산 동구는 HD현대중공업 본사와 조선 관련 중소기업이 밀집한 지역이다. 조선업 노동자가 많아 ‘진보 강세 지역’으로 분류된다. 지역 정가에선 “진보 진영 후보 단일화가 동구 표심에 영향을 미쳤다”는 분석이 나온다. 더불어민주당과 진보당은 지난달 15일 박 후보를 동구청장 단일 후보로 확정했다.)

Cheon has pledged to strengthen worker support centers to enhance safety at industrial sites like shipbuilding and support worker welfare, and to establish a "life-cycle complex cultural center" to care for children, adolescents, and parents. Park has promised to lower tolls on the Ulsan Bridge connecting Dong-gu and Nam-gu, and to introduce a Dong-gu-style public bus system. (천 후보는 노동자 지원센터를 강화해 조선업 등 산업 현장의 안전과 노동자 복지를 지원하고, ‘생애주기 복합문화센터’를 건립해 아동부터 청소년, 부모까지 챙기겠다고 공약했다. 박 후보는 동구와 남구를 잇는 울산대교 통행료 인하, 동구형 공공버스 도입 등을 공약으로 내걸었다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Takes Control of Jeju Provincial Council...Securing 34 Out of 45 Seats (제주도의회 장악한 민주당...전체 45석 중 34석 차지)
item.description:
Democratic Party Takes Control of Jeju Provincial Council...Securing 34 Out of 45 Seats (제주도의회 장악한 민주당...전체 45석 중 34석 차지)

<<>> In the June 3rd local elections for the Jeju Provincial Council, the Democratic Party of Korea achieved a landslide victory, securing an overwhelming position as the top party in the assembly. ()

According to the final vote count, the Democratic Party won 34 out of the total 45 seats. The People Power Party secured 8 seats. Additionally, the Rebuilding Korea Party won 1 seat, the Progressive Party took 1 seat, and an independent candidate secured 1 seat. (6·3 지방선거 제주도의회 의원 선거에서 더불어민주당이 압승을 거두며 압도적인 원내 제1당의 지위를 차지하게 됐다.)

The Democratic Party won 27 out of 32 district seats and 7 proportional representation seats. The People Power Party won 3 district seats but secured 5 proportional representation seats, surpassing the threshold for forming a negotiation group (5 seats). (최종 개표 결과 전체 45석 중 더불어민주당은 34석을 차지했다. 이어 국민의힘은 8석을 확보한 것으로 나타났다. 이 밖에 조국혁신당 1석, 진보당 1석, 무소속 1석으로 집계됐다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party failed to secure any district seats but gained 1 proportional representation seat, successfully entering the provincial council. (민주당은 지역구 32석 가운데 27석을, 비례대표는 7석을 각각 차지했다. 국민의힘은 지역구에서 3석을 확보했으나, 비례대표에서 5석을 확보하며 원내 교섭단체 기준(5석)을 넘어섰다.)

Compared to the 27 seats it held in the 12th Provincial Council, the Democratic Party increased its seat count by 7, allowing it to maintain significant influence over the formation of the assembly and its operations. In contrast, the People Power Party saw its seats drop from 11 to 8, weakening its ability to check the council's operations and the provincial government. (조국혁신당은 지역구를 확보하지 못했으나, 비례대표에서 1석을 확보하며 도의회 입성에 성공했다.)

The Justice Party and the Green Party failed to produce any winners in district seats. Furthermore, they did not meet the minimum threshold (5%) for proportional representation seat allocation. (민주당은 제12대 의회 27석과 비교해 7석이 늘어나면서, 앞으로도 원 구성과 의회 운영에 있어 막강한 영향력을 행사할 수 있게 됐다. 반면 국민의힘은 11석에서 8석으로 줄어들며 의회 운영과 도정에 대한 견제력이 약화됐다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Poised to Retake ‘Nakdong River Belt’ After Eight Years (민주, 8년 만에 ‘낙동강 벨트’ 탈환하나)
item.description:
Democratic Party Poised to Retake ‘Nakdong River Belt’ After Eight Years (민주, 8년 만에 ‘낙동강 벨트’ 탈환하나)

In the elections for the mayors of Yangsan and Gimhae in South Gyeongsang Province, as well as the district head of Gangseo-gu in Busan, as of 2 a.m. on the 4th, candidates from the Democratic Party of Korea were leading the incumbent heads from the People Power Party. These three areas are part of the so-called ‘Nakdong River Belt,’ a region where support for the Democratic Party and the People Power Party has traditionally been closely contested. Analysts suggest that the Democratic Party is now in a strong position to sweep all three seats—eight years after it last achieved a full victory in the 2018 local elections. (경남 양산·김해시장 선거와 부산 강서구청장 선거에선 개표 결과 4일 오전 2시 기준 더불어민주당 후보들이 국민의힘 소속 현직 단체장을 앞섰다. 세 곳은 전통적으로 민주당과 국민의힘 지지세가 팽팽한 이른바 ‘낙동강 벨트’ 지역이다. 2018년 지방선거 때 민주당 후보들이 전부 당선된 지 8년 만에 민주당이 석권할 가능성이 커졌다는 분석이 나왔다.)

As of 2 a.m. on the 4th, based on the National Election Commission’s tally, in the Yangsan mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Cho Mun-gwan led with 51.48% of the vote, outpacing People Power Party candidate Na Dong-yeon, who received 48.51%, with 36.84% of the votes counted. Candidate Cho, a former businessman, has served as a provincial councilor in South Gyeongsang Province and as vice president of the Democratic Research Institute. This is his first bid for the Yangsan mayoralty. Candidate Na, who is locked in a tight race until the end, is the incumbent mayor, seeking what is known as a ‘stepping-stone fourth term.’ In local political circles, there is analysis that “With former President Moon Jae-in’s private residence in Yangsan, the Democratic Party’s support base is formidable, and the high approval ratings of the ruling party are also having an impact.” (4일 오전 2시 현재 중앙선거관리위원회 집계 결과, 양산시장 선거에선 민주당 조문관 후보가 51.48% 득표율로 48.51%를 얻은 국민의힘 나동연 후보에 앞섰다. 개표율은 36.84%다. 조 후보는 기업인 출신으로 경남도의원, 민주연구원 부원장 등을 지냈다. 양산시장 선거에는 처음 출마했다. 막판까지 경합을 벌이고 있는 나 후보는 이른바 ‘징검다리 4선’에 도전한 현직 시장이다. 지역 정가에선 “양산에는 문재인 전 대통령 사저가 있어 민주당 지지세가 만만치 않은데다 여당의 높은 지지도가 영향을 미치고 있다”는 분석이 나온다.)

In the Gimhae mayoral election, at the same time (with 20.99% of votes counted), Democratic Party candidate Jeong Young-du secured 63.8% of the vote, leading incumbent mayor and People Power Party candidate Hong Tae-yong (36.19%). Gimhae, the hometown of former President Roh Moo-hyun, has a population of 530,000, making it the second-largest city in South Gyeongsang Province after Changwon. Candidate Jeong, who holds the lead, stated, “If elected, I will remember the reprimands and scoldings longer and more heavily than the cheers of support,” adding, “I will dedicate all my efforts to flawlessly accomplish Gimhae’s key tasks.” (김해시장 선거에서는 같은 시각(개표율 20.99%) 민주당 정영두 후보가 득표율 63.8%를 얻어 현직 시장인 국민의힘 홍태용 후보(36.19%)를 앞섰다. 노무현 전 대통령의 고향인 김해는 인구 53만명으로 경남에서 창원에 이어 둘째로 큰 도시다. 선두를 달리고 있는 정 후보는 “당선되면 응원의 함성보다 질책과 꾸지람을 더 오래, 더 무겁게 기억하겠다”며 “모든 역량을 쏟아부어 김해의 핵심 과제들을 차질 없이 완수하겠다”고 했다.)

In the Busan Gangseo-gu district head election, which had 65.92% of votes counted at the same time, Democratic Party candidate Park Sang-joon led with 55.41% of the vote, surpassing incumbent district head and People Power Party candidate Kim Hyung-chan (44.58%) to hold first place. Gangseo-gu was the only one of Busan’s 16 districts and counties where Democratic Party candidate Lee Jae-myung topped the vote in last year’s presidential election. Candidate Park, a former three-term Gangseo-gu councilor, was elected as a Liberty Korea Party candidate in the 2017 by-election and ran as an independent in 2018 and 2022. Candidate Park said, “If elected, I will leverage the power of the ruling party and bring the full budget of Busan city to Gangseo-gu,” adding, “I will attract the new Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries building and ocean-related public institutions to create new growth engines.” (같은 시각 개표율 65.92%를 기록한 부산 강서구청장 선거에서도 민주당 박상준 후보가 55.41% 득표율로 현직 구청장인 국민의힘 김형찬 후보(44.58%)를 제치고 1위를 달리고 있다. 강서구는 지난해 대선에서 이재명 민주당 후보가 부산 16개 구·군 중 유일하게 1위를 차지한 곳이다. 박 후보는 3선 강서구의원 출신이다. 2017년 재선거엔 자유한국당 후보로, 2018년과 2022년엔 무소속으로 당선됐다. 박 후보는 “당선되면 집권 여당의 힘과 부산시의 전폭적인 예산을 강서구로 끌어오겠다”며 “해양수산부 신청사와 해양 관련 공공기관을 유치해 새로운 성장 동력으로 삼겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Won-taek of the Democratic Party Confirmed to Win Jeonbuk Governor Election… Proving Strength of 'Number 1' in the Party's Stronghold (민주당 이원택, 전북지사 당선 확실…민주당 텃밭서 ‘1번’ 힘 증명)
item.description:
Lee Won-taek of the Democratic Party Confirmed to Win Jeonbuk Governor Election… Proving Strength of 'Number 1' in the Party's Stronghold (민주당 이원택, 전북지사 당선 확실…민주당 텃밭서 ‘1번’ 힘 증명)

In the June 3 Jeonbuk Province Governor election, Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek (56) recorded a vote share of 51.5% as of 00:40 on the 4th, leading independent candidate Kim Kwan-young (57), who received 41.8%, with his victory all but certain. Although incumbent Governor Kim Kwan-young was abruptly expelled from the Democratic Party ahead of the election and ran as an independent, Candidate Lee is expected to secure victory by leveraging organizational strength and the local sentiment of the Democratic Party's stronghold. <<> The process of this Jeonbuk governor election was tumultuous. This was because incumbent Governor Kim Kwan-young, who had been preparing for a re-election bid, was abruptly expelled from the Democratic Party on April 1, completely overturning the entire race. <<> The catalyst was an incident captured on a security camera (CCTV) on November 30 last year at a restaurant in Jeonju, where cash was seen changing hands during a meal involving over 20 people, including young party members. Kim explained that "he handed over 680,000 won as payment for a designated driver and recovered the full amount the next day," but the Democratic Party leadership deemed the act of an incumbent regional head providing money as inexcusable and expelled him. <<> After the expulsion, the primary was reorganized into a two-way race between lawmakers Lee Won-taek and Ahn Ho-young, with Lee Won-taek ultimately selected as the Democratic Party's final nominee. However, the election landscape shifted again when Kim officially declared his independent candidacy on the 7th of last month, creating a "Democratic Party versus independent incumbent" dynamic. <<> During the campaign period, various opinion polls showed a tight race between independent candidate Kim Kwan-young and Lee Won-taek, indicating fierce competition. Internal strife also emerged, with former Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil publicly criticizing the party leadership, stating that "the decision to expel Kim has angered Jeonbuk residents." <<> Nevertheless, Candidate Lee appealed for support, arguing that "expelling a candidate with clear ethical issues was a justified measure, and the residents of Jeonbuk will ultimately agree with that judgment." As the election entered its later stages, analysis suggests that the appeal that "for regional development, a Democratic Party governor capable of stably drawing budgets is needed" won over voters' hearts. A local political source commented, "In the end, residents chose the sturdy umbrella and political stability of the Democratic Party over the breakthrough capability of an independent incumbent." <<> Coming from a civic group background, Candidate Lee has served as a Jeonju city councilor, a Blue House administrator, the political affairs deputy governor of Jeonbuk Province, and a 21st and 22nd-term National Assembly member. He is considered close to Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae, part of the 'pro-Jung faction'. <<> During the election, he championed 'endogenous development' as his core slogan. He emphasized a region-led, self-sustaining growth model, including the establishment of a pension city utilizing renewable energy like solar and wind power, and fostering 100 Jeonbuk-style star companies. A significant shift is expected from the previous paradigm of provincial administration focused on attracting external businesses. <<> Upon the announcement that his victory was "confirmed," Candidate Lee stated, "Today's victory is not the personal victory of Lee Won-taek, but a great victory for the residents who believed in the future of Jeonbuk and trusted the Democratic Party and President Lee Jae-myung." He added, "Now, Jeonbuk must open the door to a great leap forward through AI, renewable energy, agricultural and life sciences bio, K-Food, and K-Culture," and pledged, "I will create 'real growth, tangible growth' where the fruits of growth return to the lives of the residents and the region." (6·3 전북도지사 선거에서는 더불어민주당 이원택(56) 후보가 4일 오전 0시 40분 현재 51.5% 득표율을 기록하며, 41.8%를 얻은 무소속 김관영(57) 후보를 앞서며 당선이 확실시된다. 선거를 앞두고 김관영 현역 지사가 민주당에서 전격 제명돼 무소속으로 출마했지만, 이 후보는 조직력과 민주당 텃밭이라는 지역 정서를 등에 업고 승리를 거머쥘 것으로 보인다.)

]]>

item.title: From National Assembly Member to District Council Member… Son Hye-won Elected to Mokpo City Council (국회의원에서 기초의원으로…손혜원, 목포시의원 당선)
item.description:
From National Assembly Member to District Council Member… Son Hye-won Elected to Mokpo City Council (국회의원에서 기초의원으로…손혜원, 목포시의원 당선)

Former lawmaker Son Hye-won, who was a member of the Democratic Party of Korea, was elected as an independent to the Mokpo City Council in the June 3 local elections. (더불어민주당 의원이었던 손혜원 전 의원이 6·3지방선거에서 무소속으로 전남 목포시의원에 당선됐다.)

The former lawmaker ran as an independent in the 9th National Simultaneous Local Elections for the Mokpo City Council's L district (Bokwon, Dongmyeong, Manho, Yudaldong), a constituency electing three members, and won. (손 전 의원은 제9회 전국동시지방선거에서 3명을 선출하는 목포시의원 라 선거구(복원·동명·만호·유달동)에 무소속으로 출마해 당선됐다.)

In the Mokpo City Council L district, only the top three candidates are elected, and Son placed among the top three with a vote share of 24.37% (2,057 votes). (목포시의원 라 선거구는 상위 3인까지 당선인데 손 전 의원은 24.37%(2057표) 득표율로 상위 득표자 3인에 포함됐다.)

This district, encompassing Mokpo's old downtown, saw five candidates run, including Son, three from the Democratic Party of Korea, and one from the Fatherland Innovation Party. (목포 원도심을 아우르는 이 선거구에는 손 전 의원을 비롯한 더불어민주당 3명, 조국혁신당 1명 등 5명이 출마한 바 있다.)

Son, the elected councilor, is a former brand designer who worked on various brands such as 'Cheoeumcheoreom', 'Chamisul', 'Jeonggwanjang', and 'Angel-in-us'. (손 당선인은 ‘처음처럼’, ‘참이슬’, ‘정관장’, ‘엔제리너스’ 등 다수의 브랜드 작업에 참여한 브랜드 디자이너 출신이다.)

She served as the public relations chair of the New Politics Alliance for Democracy in 2015 and was involved in selecting the current party name 'Democratic Party of Korea'. She entered the National Assembly in the 20th general election after being strategically nominated for Seoul's Mapo-eul district. (그는 2015년 새정치민주연합 홍보위원장을 맡아 현재의 ‘더불어민주당’ 당명 선정 과정에 관여했으며 제20대 총선에서 서울 마포을에 전략 공천돼 국회에 입성했다.)

Later, in 2019, she became embroiled in suspicions over property purchases in Mokpo's old downtown. While she was acquitted of charges related to using non-public information on cultural heritage designations to buy properties, she was found guilty of charges related to purchasing properties under borrowed names and was ordered to pay a fine. (이후 2019년 목포 원도심 부동산 매입 의혹에 휩싸이기도 했다. 그는 문화재 지정 관련 비공개 정보를 이용해 부동산을 사들였다는 혐의에 대해서는 무죄가 확정됐지만, 차명 부동산 매입과 관련한 혐의는 유죄로 인정돼 벌금형을 선고받았다.)

Immediately after her election, Son stated, "I have earned the right to work. This is just the beginning. Please watch what I do." She added, "I will figure out where to start and how to begin." (손 당선인은 당선 직후 “일할 수 있는 자격을 얻었다. 이제부터 시작이다. 하는 모습을 지켜봐 달라”며 “어떤 일부터 어떻게 시작해야 하는지 알아보겠다”고 밝혔다.)

She also said, "I will make tourism overflow in Mokpo's old downtown," and added, "I will work to produce visible results within this year." <<>> (그러면서 “목포 원도심에 관광객들이 흘러넘치게 하겠다”며 “올해 안에 가시적인 효과가 나오도록 해 보겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

]]>

item.title: Lee Jin-sook Enters the National Assembly on Third Attempt (3번째 도전 끝에 이진숙 국회 입성)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook Enters the National Assembly on Third Attempt (3번째 도전 끝에 이진숙 국회 입성)

<<>> ()

In the by-election for the Dalseong District of Daegu, People Power Party candidate Lee Jin-sook defeated Democratic Party candidate Park Hyung-ryong to win the seat. ()

Candidate Lee Jin-sook succeeded on her third electoral attempt. Previously, she ran as a candidate for the Dong-gu Gap district of Daegu in the 2020 general election but lost in the party primary to former lawmaker Ryu Seong-gol. In 2022, she sought to run for Mayor of Daegu but was eliminated during the primary process. In this local election, she initially declared her candidacy for Daegu mayor, was cut off again in the party primary, and even considered running as an independent. Subsequently, persuaded by party figures, she gave up her mayoral bid and was single-nominated for the Dalseong District by-election. (대구 달성 국회의원 보궐선거에서 국민의힘 이진숙 후보가 더불어민주당 박형룡 후보를 제치고 당선됐다.)

After graduating from Kyungpook National University with a degree in English Education, Lee worked as an MBC reporter and served as CEO of Daejeon MBC. She was appointed Chairperson of the Korea Communications Commission under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration. Just two days into her tenure, she was impeached by the Democratic Party, but the Constitutional Court dismissed the impeachment motion. (이진숙 후보는 세 번째 선거 도전 끝에 당선됐다. 앞서 2020년 총선에서 대구 동구갑 국회의원 후보로 출마했지만 당내 경선에서 류성걸 전 의원에게 패했고, 2022년 대구시장 후보로 나섰지만 컷오프(공천 배제)됐다. 이번 지방선거에서도 대구시장 출마를 선언했다가 당내 경선에서 컷오프되고 무소속 출마까지 검토했다. 이후 당내 인사들의 설득으로 대구시장 출마를 포기하고 대구 달성 국회의원 보궐선거에 단수 공천됐다.)

In October of last year, police arrested Lee, sparking controversy over excessive investigation, but she was released after a court granted her petition for review of arrest legality. During her tenure as KCC chair, she engaged in heated debates with Democratic Party lawmakers in the National Assembly's Science, Technology, Information, Broadcasting, and Communications Committee, drawing attention to her potential entry into the legislature. (이 후보는 경북대 영어교육학과 졸업 후 MBC 기자, 대전 MBC 사장 등을 지냈다. 윤석열 정부에서 방송통신위원장에 임명됐다. 취임 이틀 만에 민주당에 의해 탄핵소추됐지만 헌법재판소가 탄핵안을 기각했다.)

In the by-election for the Nam-gu Gap district of Ulsan, Democratic Party candidate Chun Tae-jin, a lawyer, faced off against People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-kyu, a former vice chair of the KCC under the Yoon administration. With 57% of the votes counted by 2 a.m. on the 4th, Chun received 46% and Kim received 47.9%. (작년 10월엔 경찰이 이 후보를 체포해 ‘과잉 수사’ 논란이 일었다가 법원의 체포적부심 인용으로 석방됐다. 이 후보는 방통위원장 재임 시절 국회 과학기술정보방송통신위원회에서 민주당 의원들과 격렬한 논쟁을 주고받았고, 이 때문에 국회 입성 여부에 관심이 쏠렸다.)

Candidate Chun Tae-jin graduated from Ulsan Haksung High School and Seoul National University's Political Science Department. He completed the 33rd class of the Judicial Research and Training Institute and worked as a lawyer. Candidate Kim Tae-kyu graduated from Ulsan Haksung High School and Yonsei University's Law School, completed the 28th class of the Judicial Research and Training Institute, and served as a senior judge at the Daegu, Ulsan, and Busan District Courts. He also held positions as Deputy Chair of the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission, Vice Chair of the KCC, and Acting Chairperson. (울산 남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에선 변호사 출신인 민주당 전태진 후보와 윤석열 정부 방통위 부위원장을 지낸 국민의힘 김태규 후보가 경합을 벌였다. 4일 오전 2시 57%를 개표한 가운데, 전태진 후보가 46%, 김태규 후보가 47.9%를 득표했다.)

item.title: “Congratulations to Gyeongnam’s Park Wan-soo on His Election”... Kim Kyoung-soo Concedes Defeat (“경남 박완수 당선 축하드린다”... 김경수 승복 선언)
item.description:
“Congratulations to Gyeongnam’s Park Wan-soo on His Election”... Kim Kyoung-soo Concedes Defeat (“경남 박완수 당선 축하드린다”... 김경수 승복 선언)

Kim Kyoung-soo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Gyeongnam Province Governor, conceded defeat in the election on the morning of the 4th, the day after the local elections. (김경수 더불어민주당 경남지사 후보가 지방선거 다음 날인 4일 오전 선거 승복 선언을 했다.)

According to the National Election Commission, with 96.64% of votes counted in Gyeongnam, People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo recorded 51.52%, leading Kim (48.47%) by a margin of 3.05 percentage points. The vote gap between the two candidates was narrow, and after a close contest through the night, Park began to pull ahead. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면 개표율 96.64%를 기록 중인 경남에서 박완수 국민의힘 후보가 51.52%를 기록해 김 후보(48.47%)를 3.05%p 차로 앞서고 있다. 두 후보 간 표차가 적어 밤새 접전을 벌이다 박 후보가 앞서기 시작했다.)

In a statement released that day, Kim said, “Respected citizens of Gyeongnam, I humbly accept the election results you have created. I apologize for failing to meet the support and expectations so many of you showed during the campaign. It is all due to my shortcomings.” (김 후보는 이날 입장문에서 “존경하는 경남도민 여러분, 도민 여러분께서 만들어 주신 선거 결과를 겸허히 받아들인다”며 “선거운동 기간 많은 분들께서 보내주신 성원과 기대에 부응하지 못해서 죄송하다. 모두가 저의 부족함 탓”이라고 했다.)

Kim added, “I congratulate my competitor, Park Wan-soo, on his election. I hope he will successfully navigate the difficult realities facing our Gyeongnam region.” (김 후보는 “함께 경쟁했던 박완수 후보의 당선을 축하드린다. 우리 경남의 어려운 현실을 잘 헤쳐 나가시기를 부탁드린다”라고 했다.)

Kim stated, “Citizens, although we lost this election, we cannot give up on the dream of a country where every region prospers equally and achieves balanced development. I earnestly ask that Busan, Ulsan, and Gyeongnam join forces to lead local-driven growth.” (김 후보는 “도민 여러분, 우리는 비록 선거에서 패배했지만 전국 어디서나 골고루 잘 사는 나라, 지역 균형발전의 꿈까지 포기할 수는 없습다”며 “부울경이 힘을 모아서 지방주도 성장을 앞장서서 이끌어 나가주시기를 간곡히 부탁드린다”고 했다.)

He continued, “I sincerely thank everyone who has been with me. You worked so hard under difficult circumstances. I also extend my heartfelt gratitude to all my supporters. I will not forget your kindness. Thank you.” <<>> (이어 “그동안 함께해 주신 모든 분들께 진심으로 감사드린다. 힘든 여건에서 정말 수고 많으셨다”며 “지지자 여러분들께도 진심으로 감사드린다. 그 고마움 잊지 않겠다. 감사하다”고 했다.)

]]>

item.title: Ruling Party Accepts Defeat in Seoul Mayoral Election, Saying "We Take the Public's Will Seriously" (與, 서울시장 패배에 “민의 무겁게 받아들인다”)
item.description:
Ruling Party Accepts Defeat in Seoul Mayoral Election, Saying "We Take the Public's Will Seriously" (與, 서울시장 패배에 “민의 무겁게 받아들인다”)

On April 4, Democratic Party floor leader Han Byung-do commented on the results, including the defeat in the Seoul mayoral election, stating, "The Democratic Party takes the public's will seriously." (한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표는 4일 서울시장 선거 패배 등 결과에 “민주당은 민의를 무겁게 받아들인다”고 말했다.)

At a policy coordination meeting that morning, Floor Leader Han said, "Voter interest and participation were high enough to record the highest turnout since the first local elections in 1995," adding, "The public has given us a stern reprimand to be more humble before their sentiment and a grave task to swiftly improve people's livelihoods." He also said, "The Democratic Party will fully uphold the public sentiment." (한 원내대표는 이날 오전 정책조정회의에서 “1995년 제1회 지방선거 이후 가장 높은 투표율을 기록할 만큼 유권자의 관심과 참여가 높았다”며 “민심 앞에 더 겸손하라는 질책, 신속하게 민생을 개선해내라는 국민의 준엄한 명령 또한 무거운 과제로 주셨다”고 했다. 또 “민주당은 민심을 오롯이 받들겠다”고도 했다.)

He further stated, "We will deeply engrave the voices of the people who did not spare harsh criticism for the Democratic Party and strive to be reborn as a more capable party focused on people's livelihoods." (그러면서 “민주당의 뼈아픈 쓴소리를 아끼지 않은 국민의 목소리도 가슴 깊이 새기고, 더 유능한 민생 정당으로 거듭날 수 있도록 노력하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the National Election Commission, which triggered the ballot shortage incident, he said, "We strongly denounce the Election Commission for causing public inconvenience due to the ballot shortage," adding, "We urge that the cause of this incident be immediately investigated and preventive measures be established to ensure that the trust in elections is not damaged again." (투표용지 부족 사태를 촉발한 중앙선관위에 대해서는 “투표용지 부족으로 국민 불편을 초래한 선거관리위원회를 강력히 규탄한다”며 “선거 신뢰가 훼손되는 일이 반복되지 않도록 즉각 이번 사태의 원인을 규명하고, 재발 방지 대책을 수립하시기 바란다”고 했다.)

]]>

item.title: Ruling Party Wins 12 Areas vs. Opposition’s 4, Seoul Handed Over in Half Victory…By-election Result 9 to 4 (與 12곳 vs 野 4곳, 서울 내줘 절반의 승리…재보선은 9 대 4)
item.description:
Ruling Party Wins 12 Areas vs. Opposition’s 4, Seoul Handed Over in Half Victory…By-election Result 9 to 4 (與 12곳 vs 野 4곳, 서울 내줘 절반의 승리…재보선은 9 대 4)

In the 9th nationwide local elections for metropolitan government heads, the Democratic Party of Korea won in 12 areas, while the People Power Party won in 4 areas. (제9회 전국동시지방선거 광역단체장 선거에서 더불어민주당이 12곳, 국민의힘이 4곳에서 승리했다.)

According to the vote count results from the National Election Commission, the Democratic Party secured 12 areas including Gyeonggi, Incheon, Gangwon, North Chungcheong, South Chungcheong, Daejeon, Sejong, North Jeolla, the Integrated Special City of South Jeolla-Gwangju, South Jeolla, and Jeju, while the People Power Party secured 4 areas: Seoul, Daegu, North Gyeongsang, and South Gyeongsang. In the 8th local elections in 2022, the People Power Party won in 12 areas and the Democratic Party in 5 areas. <<> Han Byeong-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader, said at a policy coordination meeting that morning regarding the results, including the loss in the Seoul mayoral election, "The Democratic Party takes the people's will seriously." He added, "Voter interest and participation were so high that it recorded the highest turnout since the 1st local elections in 1995," and "The people have given us a stern command to be more humble before public sentiment and to swiftly improve livelihoods, which is also a heavy task." He further stated, "The Democratic Party will fully uphold the people's will." <<> In the Seoul mayoral election, People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon received 48.94%, while Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh received 48.34%. As of 9:30 AM, the vote count rate was 97.7%, and the gap between the two candidates was 0.60 percentage points (30,359 votes). <<> In the Gyeonggi Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae received 55.04%, while People Power Party candidate Yang Hyang-ja received 39.37%. In the Incheon mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Park Chan-dae received 52.84%, while People Power Party candidate Yoo Jeong-bok received 46.06%. <<> In the Busan mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo received 50.52%, while People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon received 47.90%. In the Ulsan mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Kim Sang-wook received 48.73%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Doo-gyeom received 45.74%. In the South Gyeongsang Province governor election, People Power Party candidate Park Wan-soo received 51.52%, while Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo received 48.47%. <<> In the Daegu mayoral election, People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho received 53.92%, while Democratic Party candidate Kim Boo-kyum received 45.05%. In the North Gyeongsang Province governor election, People Power Party candidate Lee Cheol-woo received 67.24%, while Democratic Party candidate Oh Jung-ki received 32.75%. <<> In the North Chungcheong Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Shin Yong-han received 54.57%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Young-hwan received 45.42%. In the South Chungcheong Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun received 52.53%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum received 47.46%. In the Daejeon mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Heo Tae-jeong received 53.48%, while People Power Party candidate Lee Jang-woo received 44.15%. In the Sejong mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Jo Sang-ho received 61.03%, while People Power Party candidate Choi Min-ho received 36.01%. <<> In the Gangwon Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Woo Sang-ho received 51.81%, while People Power Party candidate Kim Jin-tae received 48.18%. In the North Jeolla Province governor election, Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek received 51.22%, while independent candidate Kim Gwan-young received 41.78%. In the Integrated Special City of South Jeolla-Gwangju mayoral election, Democratic Party candidate Min Hyeong-bae received 79.01%, while People Power Party candidate Lee Jeong-hyeon received 11.68%. In the Jeju governor election, Democratic Party candidate Wi Seong-gon received 63.11%, while People Power Party candidate Moon Seong-yu received 33.56%. <<> In the by-elections for National Assembly members, the Democratic Party won in 9 areas, while the People Power Party won in 4 areas. In Busan's Buk-gu Gap district, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon won with 42.96%, defeating Democratic Party candidate Ha Jeong-woo (41.26%) by a margin of 1,392 votes. <<> Regarding the election results, Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae said, "I deeply thank the people who gave the Democratic Party a great victory. I am grateful and respect the wise choices of the people. However, it pains me that we could not reclaim Seoul." <<> (중앙선거관리위원회 개표 결과 민주당은 경기·인천·강원·충북·충남·대전·세종·전북·전남광주통합특별시·전남·제주 등 12곳을 차지했고, 국민의힘은 서울·대구·경북·경남 등 4곳을 확보했다. 2022년 제8회 지방선거에서는 국민의힘이 12곳, 민주당이 5곳에서 승리했다.)

]]>

item.title: Prime Minister Kim on Local Election Results: "Central and Local Governments Must Cooperate to Deliver Results"… Cancels Site Visit to "Rebar Omission" Site (金총리, 지선 결과에 “중앙·지방 협력해 성과 만들어야”… ‘철근 누락’ 현장 방문은 취소)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim on Local Election Results: "Central and Local Governments Must Cooperate to Deliver Results"… Cancels Site Visit to "Rebar Omission" Site (金총리, 지선 결과에 “중앙·지방 협력해 성과 만들어야”… ‘철근 누락’ 현장 방문은 취소)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said on the 4th, "Now is the time to demonstrate through action the policies we have promised the people," adding, "The central government and local governments must cooperate to produce tangible results that the people can feel." (김민석 국무총리는 4일 “이제 국민께 약속드린 정책을 실행으로 보여드려야 할 때”라며 “중앙정부와 지방정부가 서로 협력해 국민이 체감할 수 있는 성과를 만들어야 한다”고 말했다.)

At the emergency economic cabinet meeting held at the Seoul Government Complex that morning, Prime Minister Kim stated, "Now, local officials who will lead local governments for the next four years have been newly elected," delivering these remarks. (김 총리는 이날 오전 정부서울청사에서 열린 비상경제본부 회의에서 “이제 4년간 지방정부를 이끌어갈 지역 일꾼들이 새롭게 선출됐다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Addressing senior government officials attending the meeting, Prime Minister Kim said, "I ask you to expand communication with local governments so that the government's national tasks, regional pledges, and major issues of local governments can create synergy, and also to review the progress of key projects." (김 총리는 회의에 참석한 정부 고위 관계자들에게 “정부의 국정 과제와 지역 공약, 지방정부의 주요 현안이 서로 시너지가 날 수 있도록 지방정부와의 소통을 확대하고, 주요 사업의 추진 상황도 점검해 주기 바란다”고 했다.)

Although the Democratic Party of Korea achieved nationwide victories but lost the Seoul mayoral election in the June 3 local elections, Prime Minister Kim did not assess the results. However, the Prime Minister had planned to visit the GTX (Great Train Express)-A Samsung Station construction site in Gangnam-gu, Seoul, where the "rebar omission" incident occurred, on the afternoon of that day, but canceled the visit immediately after the Democratic Party's defeat in the Seoul mayoral election was confirmed. (김 총리는 더불어민주당이 전국적으로 승리를 거뒀지만 서울시장 선거에서는 패한 6·3 지방선거 결과에 대해 평가하지는 않았다. 다만 김 총리는 이날 오후 ‘철근 누락’ 사태가 벌어진 서울 강남구의 GTX(수도권광역급행철도)-A 삼성역 공사 현장을 방문할 예정이었으나, 민주당의 서울시장 선거 패배가 확정된 직후 이를 취소했다.)

Regarding the economic situation, Prime Minister Kim said, "Negotiations to end the war between the U.S. and Iran, along with armed conflicts, continue," adding, "The problem is that even if the war ends, it is expected to take a considerable amount of time—possibly several months or more—for the actual recovery of the supply chain, such as the normalization of oil product supply." (김 총리는 한편 경제 상황과 관련해 “미국·이란 전쟁의 종전 협상과 무력 충돌이 계속되고 있다”며 “문제는 종전이 되더라도 석유 제품 수급 정상화 등 실질적인 공급망 회복에 상당한 시일, 경우에 따라서는 수개월 이상이 소요될 것으로 예상된다는 점”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "The Consumer Price Index for May, announced this week, rose 3.1% year-on-year, marking the first time it has risen to the 3% range in 26 months since March 2024," and said, "I ask relevant ministries to do their utmost to stabilize prices, especially for everyday items." (이어 “이번 주에 발표된 5월 소비자물가지수는 전년 동월 대비 3.1% 상승하면서 지난 2024년 3월 이후 26개월 만에 3%대로 올라섰다”며 “민생 품목을 중심으로 해서 물가가 안정될 수 있도록 관계 부처가 최선을 다해 주기 바란다”고 했다.)

Regarding the explosion at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon plant and the fire at SK hynix's Cheongju plant, Prime Minister Kim said, "I ask that relevant agencies ensure there is no negligence in supporting victims' families or treating the injured." He added, "The government and local governments must jointly conduct on-site inspections of high-risk processes, including the facilities involved in the accidents, and verify whether improvements have been implemented." (김 총리는 또 한화에어로스페이스 대전공장 폭발 사고, SK하이닉스 청주공장 화재 사고와 관련해 “피해자 가족 지원과 부상자 치료에서 관계 기관이 한 치의 소홀함이 없도록 해주기 바란다”고 했다. 그는 “사고 시설을 포함한 각종 고위험 공정에 대해 정부와 지방자치단체가 함께 현장 중심으로 점검하고 개선 이행 여부까지 확인해야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Yoo Ui-dong, Winner in Pyeongtaek B District: “Jang Dong-hyuk Will Naturally Contemplate His Next Steps” (평택을 당선 유의동 “장동혁, 당연히 거취 고민할 것”)
item.description:
Yoo Ui-dong, Winner in Pyeongtaek B District: “Jang Dong-hyuk Will Naturally Contemplate His Next Steps” (평택을 당선 유의동 “장동혁, 당연히 거취 고민할 것”)

Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party candidate who won the June 3 by-election for the Pyeongtaek B National Assembly district, stated on the 4th regarding Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk’s future after the local elections, “I believe he will naturally be contemplating his next steps.” With this victory, Yoo becomes a four-term lawmaker in the Seoul metropolitan area. (6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 당선된 국민의힘 유의동 후보는 4일 지방선거 이후 장동혁 대표의 거취와 관련해 “당연히 고민을 하실 것이라고 생각한다”고 했다. 유 후보는 이번 선거 당선으로 수도권 4선 의원이 됐다.)

Yoo-elect responded this way during an SBS radio interview on the morning of the same day when the host asked about his stance on Leader Jang’s deliberation over his position. When the host questioned, “Do you think Leader Jang will handle his own decisions regarding his future?” Yoo-elect replied, “Yes.” (유의동 당선인은 이날 오전 SBS 라디오에서 장 대표의 거취 고민에 대한 입장을 묻는 사회자 질문에 이같이 답했다. 사회자가 ‘장 대표가 알아서 거취 고민을 할 것이라고 보는가’라고 묻자 유 당선인은 “네”라고 말했다.)

Regarding the possibility that Leader Jang might not reconsider his position, Yoo-elect said, “This isn’t something I alone can push for,” but added, “I will closely consult with my fellow lawmakers and party members.” (유 당선인은 장 대표가 거취 고민을 하지 않을 경우에 대해선 “저 혼자 (촉구) 할 수 있는 문제는 아니겠다”면서도 “주변에 있는 동료 의원들과 당원 동지 여러분하고 긴밀하게 상의를 하도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

Commenting on the election results, Yoo-elect stated, “While I haven’t seen the overall outcome, I believe (from the People Power Party’s perspective) we received challenging results,” and emphasized the need for party reform. He further noted, “There is a need to objectively assess how far the current leadership’s direction has strayed from public sentiment.” (유 당선인은 이번 선거 결과에 대해 “전체적인 선거 결과를 보지는 못했지만 (국민의힘 입장에서) 어려운 결과를 받았다고 생각한다”면서 당 개혁이 필요하다고 했다. 이어 그는 “현재 지도부가 가려고 했었던 방향이 민심으로부터 얼마나 멀어져 있는지를 냉정하게 측정할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Thank the People for the Democratic Party's Big Win... Regretful We Couldn't Retake Seoul" (정청래 “민주당 큰 승리 국민께 감사...서울 탈환 못해 아프다”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "Thank the People for the Democratic Party's Big Win... Regretful We Couldn't Retake Seoul" (정청래 “민주당 큰 승리 국민께 감사...서울 탈환 못해 아프다”)

At a press conference on the morning of June 4, the day after the June 3 local elections, Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said, "I deeply thank the people across the nation for granting the Democratic Party a great victory. I thank and respect the wise choices of the people." He added, "However, I am pained that we could not retake Seoul." <<> Earlier that morning, the Democratic Party's Seoul mayoral candidate, Jung Won-oh, conceded defeat at a press conference, stating, "I congratulate candidate Oh Se-hoon on his victory." <<> Jung said, "I deeply thank the people who have shown support for the Democratic Party. The masters of the Republic of Korea are the people. All power comes from the people. The people are always right. Once again, I extend my deep gratitude to the people." <<> Jung then proceeded to call out the names of the Democratic Party candidates elected nationwide, one by one, congratulating them. (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 6·3 지방선거 다음 날인 4일 오전 기자회견을 갖고 “전국적으로 더불어민주당 큰 승리를 안겨주신 국민께 깊이 감사드린다. 국민 현명한 선택에 감사드리고 존중한다”면서도 “다만 서울을 탈환하지 못해 아프다”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party’s Song Eon-seok: “Humbly Accept the People’s Will... Neither Party Got the Upper Hand” (국힘 송언석 “국민 뜻 겸허히 수용... 여야 어느 한 편 손 안들어”)
item.description:
People Power Party’s Song Eon-seok: “Humbly Accept the People’s Will... Neither Party Got the Upper Hand” (국힘 송언석 “국민 뜻 겸허히 수용... 여야 어느 한 편 손 안들어”)

People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok said on the 4th regarding the results of the June 3 local elections, “The true winners are the wise people. They did not give an edge to either the president or any political party.” (국민의힘 송언석 원내대표는 4일 6·3 지방선거 결과에 대해 “진정한 승자는 현명한 국민이다. 대통령과 여야 정당 어느 한 편의 손도 들어주지 않으셨다”고 했다.)

In a statement released that morning, Floor Leader Song Eon-seok said, “The People Power Party will humbly accept the people’s demands and warnings.” He added, “(The people) have sternly called for restoring the politics of checks and balances across the entire political spectrum, including the president, ruling and opposition parties, central and local governments, and metropolitan and basic governments.” (송언석 원내대표는 이날 오전 입장문을 내고 “국민의힘은 국민의 요구와 경고를 겸허하게 수용하겠다”면서 이같이 밝혔다. 이어 그는 “(국민은) 대통령과 여야, 중앙·지방정부, 광역·기초단체 등 정치권 전반에 견제와 균형의 정치를 복원할 것을 엄중하게 주문했다”고 했다.)

Floor Leader Song said, “We sincerely thank all those who showed support and encouragement to our People Power Party candidates, and offer deep condolences to those in our party who unfortunately failed to achieve their goals.” (송 원내대표는 “우리 국민의힘 일꾼들에게 지지와 성원을 보내주신 모든 분들께 진심으로 감사드리며, 아쉽게 목표를 이루지 못한 우리 당의 낙선자들께 깊은 위로의 뜻을 올린다”고 했다.)

Furthermore, regarding the ‘ballot shortage incident’ that occurred at some polling stations in Seoul, Floor Leader Song stated, “Regardless of the election results, the ballot shortage incidents in Seoul, Incheon, and Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province, are serious events that severely violated the people’s right to vote.” He continued, “We strongly condemn the irresponsible attitude of the National Election Commission, which began counting votes before voting was completed and shifted responsibility to the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission without stopping the count,” adding, “We will seek strong preventive measures, including a thorough investigation of the incident, punishment of those responsible, and plans for external control over the Election Commission.” (또 송 원내대표는 서울 일부 투표소에서 벌어진 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’와 관련해 “선거 결과와 무관하게 서울, 인천, 경기 화성 등지에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태는 국민의 투표권을 심각하게 침해한 중대한 사건”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “투표가 마무리되지 않은 상황에서 개표를 개시하고, 개표를 중단하지 않으면서 서울시선관위에 책임을 전가한 중앙선관위의 무책임한 태도를 강력히 규탄한다”며 “사건의 진상규명과 책임자 처벌 그리고 선관위에 대한 외부통제 방안 등 강력한 재발방지책을 강구하겠다”고 했다.)

]]>

item.title: Democratic Party Scores Landslide Victory, Claiming 8 of 11 Incheon Local Government Head Seats (민주당, 인천 기초단체장 11석 중 8석 차지 ‘압승’)
item.description:
In the June 3 elections for heads of Incheon's local governments, the Democratic Party of Korea achieved a landslide victory. (6·3 인천 기초단체장 선거에선 더불어민주당이 압승했다.)

According to the National Election Commission on the 4th, in this election to select all 11 county mayors and district heads in the Incheon area, 8 candidates from the Democratic Party and 3 from the People Power Party were elected. (4일 중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면 전체 11명의 인천지역 군수·구청장을 뽑은 이번 선거에서 민주당 소속 후보는 8명, 국민의힘 소속 후보는 3명이 각각 당선됐다.)

The areas where Democratic Party candidates won include Ongjin County, Yeongjong District, Michuhol District, Namdong District, Bupyeong District, Gyeyang District, Seo District, and Geomdan District. (민주당 소속 후보가 당선된 곳은 옹진군, 영종구, 미추홀구, 남동구, 부평구, 계양구, 서구, 검단구 등이다.)

In the Ongjin County mayoral election, winning Democratic Party candidate Jang Jeong-min (57) defeated incumbent county mayor, People Power Party candidate Moon Gyeong-bok (71), returning to the county mayor position after four years. (옹진군수 선거에서 당선된 민주당 장정민(57) 후보는 현직 군수인 국민의힘 문경복(71) 후보를 누르고 4년 만에 군수 자리에 복귀하게 됐다.)

In the election for the newly established autonomous district of Yeongjong, Democratic Party candidate Son Hwa-jeong (56), a former Cheong Wa Dae administrative officer, defeated incumbent Jung-gu District head, People Power Party candidate Kim Jeong-heon (60), to become the first Yeongjong District head. (신설 자치구인 영종구청장 선거에선 청와대 행정관 출신 민주당 손화정(56) 후보가 현직 중구청장인 국민의힘 김정헌(60) 후보를 제치고, 초대 영종구청장을 맡게 됐다.)

In Michuhol District, Democratic Party candidate Kim Jeong-sik (57), who previously served as district head in 2018, defeated incumbent People Power Party candidate Lee Yeong-hun (58), avenging his defeat from four years ago. In Namdong District, Democratic Party candidate Lee Byeong-rae (64) defeated incumbent district head, People Power Party candidate Park Jong-hyo (57). (미추홀구에선 2018년 구청장 당선 경험이 있는 민주당 김정식(57) 후보가 현직인 국민의힘 이영훈(58) 후보에게 이겨 4년 전 패배를 설욕했다. 남동구에선 민주당 이병래(64) 후보가 현직 구청장인 국민의힘 박종효(57) 후보를 이겼다.)

In Bupyeong District, Democratic Party candidate Cha Jun-taek (58) was elected, becoming the first three-term district head in Bupyeong. In Gyeyang District, Democratic Party candidate Park Hyeong-woo (69), a former three-term district head returning after a four-year gap, was elected, becoming Incheon's first "bridging four-term district head." (부평구에선 민주당 차준택(58) 후보가 당선돼 부평구 최초 3선 구청장에 이름을 올렸다. 계양구에선 3선 구청장을 지내고 4년의 공백을 가진 민주당 박형우(69) 후보가 당선돼 인천의 첫 ‘징검다리 4선 구청장’이 됐다.)

In Seo District, Democratic Party candidate Gu Jae-yong (61), a former aide to National Assembly member Kim Gyo-heung, won, while in the newly established autonomous district of Geomdan, Democratic Party candidate Kim Jin-gyu (60), a former Incheon city councilor, emerged victorious. (서구에선 김교흥 국회의원 보좌관 등을 지낸 민주당 구재용(61) 후보가, 신설 자치구인 검단구에선 인천시의원 등을 지낸 민주당 김진규(60) 후보가 각각 승리했다.)

The areas where People Power Party candidates won include Ganghwa County, Jemulpo District, and Yeonsu District. All are incumbent county mayors or district heads. (국민의힘 후보가 당선된 곳은 강화군과 제물포구, 연수구 등이다. 모두 현직인 군수·구청장들이다.)

In Ganghwa County, a traditional conservative stronghold in Incheon, incumbent People Power Party candidate Park Yong-cheol (62) defeated Democratic Party candidate Han Yeon-hee (67), who was making her fourth attempt, securing re-election. (인천의 대표적 ‘보수 텃밭’인 강화군에선 현직인 국민의힘 박용철(62) 후보가 4번째 도전에 나선 민주당 한연희(67) 후보에 승리해 연임에 성공했다.)

In Jemulpo District, formed by merging inland Jung-gu and Dong-gu, incumbent Dong-gu district head and People Power Party candidate Kim Chan-jin (59) beat Democratic Party candidate Namgung Hyeong (46) by a margin of about 220 votes to be elected. (중구 내륙 지역과 동구가 통합된 제물포구에선 현직 동구청장인 국민의힘 김찬진(59) 후보가 민주당 남궁형(46) 후보를 220여 표 차로 이기고 당선됐다.)

In Yeonsu District, home to Songdo International City, incumbent district head and People Power Party candidate Lee Jae-ho narrowly defeated Democratic Party candidate Jeong Ji-yeol (67) in a tight race, reaching the milestone of a third term. (송도국제도시가 있는 연수구에서는 현직 구청장인 국민의힘 이재호 후보가 접전 끝에 민주당 정지열(67) 후보를 꺾고 3선 고지에 올랐다.)

In the Incheon local government head elections held four years ago, the People Power Party secured 8 out of 10 seats (including one conservative-leaning independent), while the Democratic Party won 2, a result reversed this time. (4년 전 치러진 인천 기초단체장 선거에선 전체 10석 중 국민의힘이 8석(보수계열 무소속 당선인 1명 포함)을, 민주당이 2석을 각각 차지해 이번과 상반된 결과가 나왔었다.)

Political commentator Park Sang-byeong said, "This appears to be a result of Incheon voters' perception that empowering the current administration can more effectively drive regional development, which influenced this Incheon local government head election." (박상병 정치평론가는 “현 정권에 힘을 실어줘야 지역 발전도 더욱 효과적으로 이뤄질 수 있다는 인천 유권자들의 인식이 이번 인천 기초단체장 선거에 영향을 준 결과로 보인다”고 했다.)

item.title: Victory in the 'Third Face-Off'... Lee Wan-seop, Seosan Mayor, Achieves Fourth Term (‘3번째 맞대결’서 승리... 4선 고지 오른 이완섭 서산시장)
item.description:
Victory in the 'Third Face-Off'... Lee Wan-seop, Seosan Mayor, Achieves Fourth Term (‘3번째 맞대결’서 승리... 4선 고지 오른 이완섭 서산시장)

In the June 3 Seosan mayoral election in South Chungcheong Province, People Power Party candidate Lee Wan-seop (69) defeated former Democratic Party Mayor Maeng Jeong-ho (58), claiming the milestone of a 'staggered fourth term.' (6·3 충남 서산시장 선거에서 국민의힘 이완섭(69) 후보가 더불어민주당 맹정호(58) 전 시장과 대결에서 승리하며 ‘징검다리 4선’ 고지에 올랐다.)

As of the morning of the 4th, with vote counting concluded, Lee secured 50.18% of the vote, defeating Maeng, who received 46.93%, by a margin of 3.25 percentage points. (4일 오전 개표가 종료된 상황에서 이 후보는 50.18%를 얻어 46.93%를 얻은 맹 후보를 3.25%포인트 차이로 이겼다.)

The mayor-elect stated, "I will do my utmost to address issues directly linked to citizens' lives, such as local economic recovery, responding to industrial crises, expanding transportation networks, and improving welfare and educational environments." (이 당선인은 “지역 경제 회복과 산업 위기 대응, 교통망 확충, 복지와 교육 환경 개선 등 시민 삶과 직결된 현안 해결에 최선을 다하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

This Seosan mayoral election drew attention as the third face-off between Lee and Maeng. They previously competed for the Seosan mayor position in 2018 and 2022. Maeng won in 2018, while Lee won in 2022, resulting in a 1-1 record. (이번 서산시장 선거는 이 후보와 맹 후보의 세 번째 맞대결로 관심을 모았다. 앞서 이들은 2018년과 2022년에 서산시장 자리를 놓고 대결을 펼쳤다. 2018년엔 맹 후보가, 2022년엔 이 후보가 이겨 1대1의 승부를 기록했었다.)

This election also saw a tight race, with opinion polls showing fluctuating support between the top two candidates. (이번 선거에서도 여론조사에서 지지율 1·2위 자리가 뒤바뀌는 혼전 양상을 보이기도 했다.)

Lee was first elected in the 2011 Seosan mayoral by-election and won re-election in 2014. With this victory following his 2022 win, he has successfully secured a fourth term as mayor. (이 당선인은 2011년 서산시장 재선거에서 당선돼 2014년 재선에 성공했다. 2022년에 이어 다시 승리하면서 4선 시장 당선에 성공했다.)

Seosan faces the challenge of a sluggish local economy due to the downturn in the Daesan Petrochemical Complex, one of South Korea's top three petrochemical hubs. The mayor-elect has pledged to reshape Seosan's industrial structure into a high-tech one, linking to initiatives pursued during his tenure, such as attracting a sustainable aviation fuel demonstration center and breaking ground on a core parts testing and evaluation center for future air mobility. (서산시는 국내 3대 석유화학 단지인 대산 석유화학단지 침체로 인한 지역 경기 악화가 과제다. 이 당선인은 재임 기간 추진한 지속 가능 항공유 실증 센터 유치, 미래 항공 모빌리티 핵심 부품 시험 평가 센터 착공 등과 연계해 서산의 산업 구조를 첨단 산업으로 재편하겠다고 약속했다.)

The mayor-elect stated, "I will turn the industrial crisis into an opportunity, increase good jobs, and create a city where transportation, education, welfare, and culture are more developed—a Seosan where everyone, from children to the elderly, can be happy." (이 당선인은 “산업 위기를 기회로 바꾸고, 좋은 일자리를 늘리고, 교통·교육·복지·문화가 더 발전하는 도시, 아이부터 어르신까지 모두가 행복한 서산을 만들겠다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: People Power Party's Lee Min-keun Becomes 'First Re-elected Mayor' in Ansan, a Democratic Party Stronghold (국민의힘 이민근, 민주당 우세 안산서 ‘최초 연임 시장’ 됐다)
item.description:
People Power Party's Lee Min-keun Becomes 'First Re-elected Mayor' in Ansan, a Democratic Party Stronghold (국민의힘 이민근, 민주당 우세 안산서 ‘최초 연임 시장’ 됐다)

In the June 3 local election for the mayor of Ansan, Gyeonggi Province, People Power Party candidate Lee Min-keun was elected. This marks the first time a sitting mayor of Ansan has successfully won re-election in the city's history. (6·3 지방선거 경기 안산시장 선거에서 국민의힘 이민근 후보가 당선됐다. 현직 안산시장이 재선에 성공한 것은 안산시정 사상 처음이다.)

According to the final vote count from the National Election Commission on the 4th, Lee secured 50.44% (150,393 votes), defeating Democratic Party candidate Chun Young-mi, who garnered 49.55% (147,762 votes). (4일 중앙선거관리위원회 최종 개표 결과에 따르면 이 후보는 50.44%(15만393표)의 득표율을 얻으며 49.55%(14만7762표)의 득표율을 기록한 더불어민주당 천영미 후보를 제치고 당선됐다.)

Around 8 p.m. on the 3rd, Chun initially led in the early vote counting. However, from around 1 a.m. on the 4th, Lee-elect narrowed the gap, trailing by about 1 percentage point. By around 6 a.m., Lee-elect secured victory with a margin of 2,631 votes. (3일 오후 8시쯤 개표 초반에는 천 후보가 앞섰다. 그러나 4일 오전 1시쯤부터 이민근 당선인이 1%포인트 안팎의 격차를 보이며 바짝 따라붙었다. 이어 6시쯤 2631표 차이를 보이며 이 당선인이 당선을 확정지었다.)

Previously, no sitting mayor in Ansan had succeeded in winning a second term. Lee-elect becomes the first to achieve re-election as mayor. (그동안 안산에서는 현직 시장이 재선에 성공한 사례가 없었다. 이 당선인이 최초로 연임 시장이 됐다.)

Lee-elect stated, "I will be a mayor of unity," adding, "I will not be distracted by superficial politics, but will repay you with actions that change citizens' lives and with substantial results." (이 당선인은 “통합의 시장이 되겠다”며 “보여주기식 정치에 한눈팔지 않고, 오직 시민의 삶을 바꾸는 실천과 묵직한 결과물로 보답하겠다”고 했다.)

In light of this election outcome, locals are calling it an upset. Ansan has been considered a stronghold for the Democratic Party, with its candidates winning the mayoral election three consecutive times since 2010. In the concurrent by-election for the Ansan Gap district, Democratic Party candidate Kim Nam-guk was also elected. (이번 선거 결과를 두고 지역에서는 이변이라는 말이 나온다. 안산은 2010년 시장 선거부터 더불어민주당 계열 후보가 내리 3번 승리해 민주당 지지세가 강한 곳이라고 평가받았다. 이번 선거와 함께 치러진 안산 갑 재선거에서도 더불어민주당 김남국 후보가 당선됐다.)

Lee-elect previously won the 2022 local election by a narrow margin of 178 votes. At that time, the Democratic Party's incumbent mayor was eliminated during the nomination process, leading to a split in votes when a candidate ran as an independent, which allowed Lee-elect to secure victory. (이 당선인은 2022년 지방선거 때 178표 차이로 신승을 거뒀다. 당시 민주당 현역 시장이 공천에서 탈락하자, 무소속으로 출마해 표가 갈리면서 이 당선인이 승리할 수 있었다.)

Meanwhile, Chun candidate, who aimed to become the 'first female mayor of Ansan,' was defeated. During the party primary process, Chun faced controversy when a video surfaced on social media in which she explained her past drunk driving offense, saying, "I have one drunk driving offense. President Lee Jae-myung also has a criminal record. Didn't you vote for President Lee Jae-myung?" (한편, 천 후보는 ‘최초 여성 안산시장’에 도전했지만 패했다. 천 후보는 당내 경선 과정 중 자신의 음주 운전 전과를 설명하는 과정에서 “저 음주 전과 한 번 있다. 이재명 대통령도 전과가 있다. 이재명 대통령 안 찍었느냐”고 말하는 영상이 소셜미디어를 통해 퍼지면서 논란이 되기도 했다.)

item.title: Busan Gangseo District Office Chief Elected: Park Sang-jun of the Democratic Party of Korea (부산 강서구청장에 더불어민주당 박상준 당선 )
item.description:
In the June 3 by-election for Busan Gangseo District Office Chief, Park Sang-jun (45), the candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, defeated Kim Hyung-chan (58), the incumbent District Office Chief and candidate of the People Power Party, by a margin of 5.33 percentage points. (6·3 부산 강서구청장 선거에서 더불어민주당 박상준(45) 후보가 현직 구청장인 국민의힘 김형찬(58) 후보를 5.33%포인트 차로 제치고 당선됐다.)

This area is part of the so-called 'Nakdong River Belt' region, where support for the Democratic Party and the People Power Party is closely contested. In past elections, candidates affiliated with the People Power Party mostly became district office chiefs, but in the 2018 local elections, Noh Gi-tae, a Democratic Party candidate, was elected. Eight years later, the Democratic Party has successfully reclaimed the position. (이곳은 민주당과 국민의힘 지지세가 팽팽한 이른바 ‘낙동강 벨트’ 지역이다. 과거 선거에선 국민의힘 계열 후보가 대부분 구청장이 됐지만 2018년 지방선거 때는 민주당 소속 노기태 후보가 당선된 적이 있다. 8년 만에 민주당이 탈환에 성공했다.)

Gangseo District is a place where, in last year's presidential election, Lee Jae-myung, the Democratic Party candidate, was the only one to rank first among the 16 districts and counties in Busan. The average age of residents is 40.6 years, the lowest among Busan's 16 districts and counties. This is similar to Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province (average age 40), the youngest city in the country. (강서구는 지난해 대선에서 이재명 민주당 후보가 부산 16개 구·군 중 유일하게 1위를 차지한 곳이다. 주민 평균 연령이 40.6세로 부산 16개 구·군 중 가장 낮다. 전국에서 가장 젊은 도시인 경기 화성(평균 40세)과 비슷한 수준이다.)

President-elect Park is a three-term Gangseo District council member. He was elected as a candidate for the Liberty Korea Party in the 2017 by-election and as an independent in 2018 and 2022. (박 당선인은 3선 강서구의원 출신이다. 2017년 재선거엔 자유한국당 후보로, 2018년과 2022년엔 무소속으로 각각 당선됐다.)

President-elect Park cited resolving traffic issues as his No. 1 pledge. He announced goals for the 'Metro Hadan~Noksan Line' to begin construction within the year, and for the early opening of the Busan-Masan double-track railway, as well as the Daejeo, Eomgung, and Jangnak bridges. The Hadan~Noksan Line is a 13.47 km metro line connecting Hadan Station of Busan Subway Line 1 with Eulsukdo, Myeongji International New City, and Noksan National Industrial Complex. The total project cost is 1.4845 trillion won. As the first metro line to pass through Myeongji International New City, it draws high interest from local residents. (박 당선인은 1호 공약으로 교통 문제 해결을 꼽았다. ‘도시철도 하단~녹산선’ 연내 착공, 부전~마산 복선 전철과 대저·엄궁·장낙대교 조기 개통을 목표로 밝혔다. 하단~녹산선은 부산 지하철 1호선 하단역과 을숙도, 명지국제신도시, 녹산국가산업단지 등을 잇는 13.47㎞ 길이 도시철도다. 총사업비가 1조4845억원이다. 명지국제신도시를 관통하는 첫 번째 도시철도로 지역 주민들의 관심이 높다.)

He stated, "I will leverage the strength of the ruling party and Busan City's full budget to bring them to Gangseo District," and "I will attract the new headquarters of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and ocean-related public institutions to turn them into new growth engines." (그는 “집권 여당의 힘과 부산시의 전폭적인 예산을 강서구로 끌어오겠다”며 “해양수산부 신청사와 해양 관련 공공기관을 유치해 새로운 성장 동력으로 삼겠다”고 했다.)
